DSH Crew

A DeepSeek Harness plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok, without giving up the host's native subagent UI.
Native Progress UI • Tier Policy & Escalation • Dispatch Guardrails • Jobs Board • In-Host DSH Sessions • Vision & Image Gen (Native-First) • One-Click Install

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-crew · Current plugin release: 0.1.0-rc.11 · Tested with DSH 0.1.1-rc.1

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The DSH Crew settings page — host integrations, dispatch policy, execution and the multimodal bridge

## Why DSH Crew DSH Crew is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) — an open-source agent harness. It makes DSH agents dispatchable from Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok: the orchestrator keeps its own model, the work runs on a real DSH agent with that harness's tools, sandbox, presets and session history, and the host still shows it as a native subagent with live progress. What runs the work is a DSH agent, not a bare model call. Tiers (`flash` / `pro`) select how much capability that agent gets from the harness's configured roster — DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro today — so a change of model in DSH needs no change here.
### 🧵 Native Progress UI Workers appear as regular subagents in Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok — dispatch count, running step, tool calls and token usage all show up in the host's own task panel, plus a claude-hud statusline segment: `⚙dsh 1▶pro 2m14s 21.7k/606 ✓3`. ### 🎚️ Tier Policy and Escalation `flash` for mechanical work, `pro` for reasoning, `effort` from `off` to `max`. `tier_policy` can clamp every dispatch to one tier at the tool layer, and `escalate_on_failure` retries a failed flash run once on pro — based on evidence, not on guessing difficulty up front.
### 🏛️ In-Host DSH Sessions With the bundle installed in a DSH profile, each worker is a first-class DSH session: visible in the Web UI, grouped by working directory, mounted with the Agent preset you choose per tier. Without DSH running, dispatch falls back to a standalone DSH runtime, so CI and headless environments still work. ### 👁️ Vision and Image Generation DSH's models are text-only. `describe_image` now prefers DeepSeek's own VL model (`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) whenever a key is available, then falls back to the CLIs you already have — Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity — or any OpenAI-compatible API you configure. `generate_image` borrows the same CLIs' brush. Pasted images stay visible in the conversation and reach the model as text.
### 🛡️ Dispatch Guardrails Every dispatch is checked before anything spawns. Worker→worker nesting is capped at origin-chain depth 3 and cycles are refused; a second worker on a workspace another job already holds is refused with the holder's info — never silently queued. Refusals are readable errors: wait or re-scope, don't bypass. ### 📋 Jobs Board The DSH Crew panel doubles as a jobs board: every worker job — running or finished — is listed with tier, effort, live progress and tokens, held workspaces show their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (e.g. a hub restart) is surfaced as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.
### 🔌 Custom Providers Bring your own endpoint (Base URL + API key + models) or a local command template. Each provider has a connectivity test that checks reachability and auth, then makes one real vision call so you find out now, not mid-task. ### 📦 One-Click Install The settings page installs and updates the Claude Code plugin, the Codex role files and the Antigravity / Grok agents, skills and commands for you — marketplace registration, permission allowlist, HUD wiring, absolute paths rendered for this machine — and restores them just as easily. Every settings file is backed up first.
## How it works ``` Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok (orchestrator, keeps its own model) └─ ds-flash / ds-pro ← native subagent shell (progress shows in the host's task UI) └─ MCP: dsh_run_worker(tier, effort, cwd, worker=) ├─ worker="agy"/"grok" → that external CLI runs the task (explicit opt-in) ├─ hub reachable → session inside DSH (visible in the Web UI, grouped by cwd) └─ otherwise → dsh-jsonrpc-agent runtime (worker.cordis.yml) └─ DeepSeek V4 Flash / Pro (DSH SDK, event stream → progress and token stats) ``` ## One run, two views Dispatch fans out. Below, eighteen workers translate this README in parallel: the host counts them as its own subagents, while the harness runs them as real sessions.

Claude Code sees dsh-crew workers as native subagents, with a statusline segment tracking running tiers, elapsed time and tokens.

The DSH Crew panel sees the same run from the harness side: which host dispatched each job, its tier and effort, live progress and token usage.

The panel is also the jobs board: running and finished jobs stay listed with tier, progress and tokens, held workspaces name their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (a hub restart) surfaces as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.

## Install Install into a DSH profile from npm: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-crew@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-crew dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately. ### Configure DeepSeek credentials (standalone only) In hub mode — the installation above — workers run inside the DSH instance and use the DeepSeek credentials it is already configured with. Nothing else to set up. Only the standalone fallback needs a key of its own: dispatching from a host with no DSH instance running launches a worker runtime as a separate process. Obtain an API key from [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com) and write it to `~/.config/dsh-crew/.env`: ``` DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-... ``` ### Verify ```bash node scripts/smoke.mjs ``` The smoke test dispatches one cheap job through whichever path is available — the hub when a DSH instance is running, s

plugins.description: Time-shifting task delegation for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): plan tasks at leisure, they run unattended off-peak, come back to a report. Human-adjudicated, desktop + web.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lowtide **Queue tasks when it's busy. They run on their own when it's cheap.** Semi-auto or full-auto, off the model's peak hours and peak prices. A must-have plugin for DeepSeek Harness. **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) | [繁體中文](./README.zh-HK.md) | [العربية](./docs/README.ar.md) | [Deutsch](./docs/README.de.md) | [Español](./docs/README.es.md) | [Français](./docs/README.fr.md) | [Italiano](./docs/README.it.md) | [한국어](./docs/README.ko.md)
--- ![hero](./assets/screenshots/hero.png)

Three tasks waiting in the queue, the price status glowing in the session header, auto-run when your window opens

## Introduction lowtide is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh). The problem it solves is plain and perfectly natural: Usually, when you want an agent to do some work, you sit at the computer, send the agent an instruction, wait for the reply, and then review it by hand. But this workflow seems to forget that you have plenty of idle time — and a chance to dodge the peak/off-peak pricing that some models charge. With lowtide installed, the day goes like this: whenever a job crosses your mind during the day, toss it in the queue, glance at it, release it. The tasks pile up until the time you set (say, after 7 PM — that's when DeepSeek is at valley pricing), then run by themselves. Next morning you open the report: keep what went well, send back what didn't. That's all it is. But use it for a week and your working rhythm genuinely slows down — and don't forget, "time is money, efficiency is life"... A few key capabilities: - Four execution strategies: single, iterative, sampling, review — from "one pass is enough" to "run five candidates and I'll pick" - 168 unit tests + 10 end-to-end specs, CI green across ubuntu / windows × node 22 / 24 - One build artifact serves both desktop and web — install once, works on both - Off-peak execution lands in DeepSeek's valley hours: the same batch costs about half of what peak would ## A normal day with an agent might look like this… **Ten minutes before clocking out.** You've finished reviewing code, so you file three tickets for tomorrow: a refactor (iterative, 3 rounds), a weekly report (single), and a design you're unsure about (sampling, 4 candidates). Release them all, shut down, leave. Tomorrow at your desk, the morning report says: the refactor's done, the report's drafted, and four candidate designs sit side by side, each with its cost written out. **Friday night.** Queue a week's worth of chores in one go: dependency cleanup, missing tests, data scripts. Weekends are valley price around the clock. You go out; it works from home. Monday you check the report — retry what failed, merge what's good. **A 10 AM brainwave.** You're mid-conversation with the agent about an urgent bug when you think "hey, update the docs too." The intercept card pops up: running now costs peak price, tonight it's about half — the difference is spelled out. Click "queue for off-peak"; your draft survives untouched, and you go back to the bug. **An always-on server.** You've got a machine running dsh 24/7. Switch to L3 full-auto, then file tasks from anywhere through the API (`POST /ds-lowtide/tasks`). It runs them on schedule and writes the report. Nobody's watching, but the sandbox, the daily budget, and the file locks are all still there. **Deliverables for a client.** Use the review strategy: run once, then automatically open an independent session that tears the result apart through your chosen focus (say, "hunt for data-source errors"). In the morning you don't get a bare result — you get a result plus a critical review. **Living abroad.** You're in San Francisco; DeepSeek's peak is Beijing time, which for you lands in the evening and night before. Settings converts the official hours to your local clock, one click to adopt. You set windows by your own schedule, and the books always stay aligned with the official table. ## How lowtide works ``` ① Intake ② Adjudicate ③ Execute ④ Accept Whenever you have The queue dock When the off-peak When you're back: a moment: one-click groups tasks by window opens: five open the report — from the intercept workspace; triage preflight gates pass, results + diff card, or file a → line by line: → then sandboxed runs → + actual spend ticket (4 strategies) ✓approve ⏸defer one batch per window + money saved ✕drop / approve-all ``` A task's life: `pending-review → queued → preflight → running → done / failed / stale / timeout`, plus `deferred` (postponed) and `dropped` (soft-deleted, restorable). Step two is where lowtide differs from a "fully automated script": **every task must be released by your hand before it runs** (in L2, you release the whole batch at once, 30 minutes before the window). The machine cannot move itself into the run queue. Execution is automated; decisions are not. That's why you can safely be absent. ## A tour of the lowtide interface **The new-task modal.** Four strategies side by side, each with a plain-language hint; rounds, priority, and run mode ride along per task — no trip back to settings. Tasks land as "pending review". Nothing enters the queue without passing you. ![new-task-modal](./assets/screenshots/new-task-modal.png) **Advanced options.** Model, reasoning effort, priority from 0 to 9, fresh session or continue-previous, and the locked-files list — all in one small pane. Locked files, briefly: anything on the list gets sha256-checked before execution, and if it doesn't match what you filed, the task goes stale and refuses to run. Otherwise the file you queued against could be rewritten by another task while waiting, and this one would blindly stomp on it. ![advanced-options](./assets/screenshots/advanced-options.png) **Pick any model.** Batch runs default to the official `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; the retired `deepseek-v4-flash` name still routes there at Flash prices), but each task can pick its own model — anything connected to your Harness is in the dropdown, grouped by provider. Private providers work too. Non-official models have no public price table, so the ledger honestly says "price unknown"; add a price override in settings if you want the bookkeeping exact. ![model-picker](./assets/screenshots/model-picker.png) **The window editor.** Multi-segment, overnight, per-weekday — all fine. Underneath is a live 24-hour price band: red for peak, green for valley, and a marker showing where you are right now. Outside UTC+8, one click on "adopt official peak hours" converts Beijing time to your local clock. ![window-editor](./assets/screenshots/window-editor.png) **The settings page.** Window hours, tasks per batch, per-task duration cap, concurrency, daily budget, report history, autonomy level, price overrides — all graphical, no config files. The official pricing rules (including the new all-weekend valley) are explained in human language on the same page. ![settings](./assets/screenshots/settings.png) Three more pieces of UI appear in daily use: the **price pill** (session header — busy/idle, queue size; click it to edit windows), the **peak-hours intercept card** (type at peak, it appears; the price difference is spelled out; your draft survives), and the **execution report** (the morning briefing: savings first, anomalies pinned, candidates awaiting your pick, one-click Markdown copy). ## About lowtide workspaces Every task runs inside a workspace. That single dropdown decides three things. **Which files it can touch.** Tasks run in a sandbox whose boundary is the workspace directory. Pick wrong and at best it can't find the files; at worst it edits something it shouldn't. **Who it queues with.** Tasks in the same workspace run serially (two tasks never fight over one repo); different workspaces run in paralle

plugins.description: Full-screen SAO-inspired startup animation for DeepSeek Harness with adjustable beam, dial, language and character settings. Original high-fidelity rendering by default; optional compatibility mode for low-end GPUs and a tunnel-only intro.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH SAO Link Start

[中文](#中文说明) · [English](#english)

An unofficial, procedural recreation of an SAO-style login sequence for
DeepSeek Harness. It plays as a full-screen overlay when the Harness UI starts,
then removes itself automatically.

The plugin contains no anime footage, images, fonts, or game assets. Its tunnel,
HUD dials, panels, and sound cues are generated with Canvas, CSS, SVG, and Web
Audio.

| Beam tunnel | Character confirmation |
| --- | --- |
| ![Perspective beam tunnel](media/beam-tunnel.png) | ![Character confirmation dialog](media/character-dialog.png) |

## English

### Features

- Perspective capsule-beam tunnel with near-camera clipping to prevent flashes.
- Five animated cyan HUD dials followed by language, login, and character
  registration panels.
- A dedicated **Settings → SAO Link Start** page.
- Adjustable beam speed, beam length, beam density, and HUD dial size.
- Editable language and character labels; defaults are `Japanese` and
  `Kirito(M)`.
- Click or press `Escape` to skip. Press `Ctrl+Alt+L` to replay while the
  Harness page has keyboard focus.
- Respects reduced-motion preferences.
- The original rendering path is the default; an optional **Compatibility mode**
  (off by default) gives low-end GPUs a compositor-friendly fallback; see
  [Compatibility mode](#compatibility-mode).
- An optional **Tunnel only** intro (off by default) that plays just the beam
  fly-through and skips the rest; see [Tunnel only](#tunnel-only).

### Install

Replace `desktop` with the profile you use:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:liyansong0015/dsh-sao-link-start
```

Restart Harness after installation. Open the account menu, choose **Settings**,
then select **SAO Link Start** in the left navigation.

### Configuration

| Field | Range/default | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Beam speed | `0.4–2.5`, default `1` | Fly-through speed |
| Beam length | `0.4–2.5`, default `1` | Capsule trail length |
| Beam density | `0.4–2`, default `1` | Number of visible beams |
| Dial size | `0.35–1.2`, default `0.65` | Scale of the five HUD dials |
| Language name | default `Japanese` | Label beside the Language pill |
| Character name | default `Kirito(M)` | Name in the registration dialog |
| Compatibility mode | off by default | Low-end GPU fallback that avoids per-frame layout; see below |
| Tunnel only | off by default | Play just the beam fly-through; see below |

Save settings and restart Harness to preview the new values.

### Compatibility mode

**Settings → SAO Link Start → Compatibility mode** is **off by default**: the
default state uses the original 1.3.x rendering, i.e. the high-fidelity
performance path (2x device pixel ratio, exact per-frame layout). Both states
look identical.

Check the box only when the overlay stutters (typically on integrated or older
GPUs). The fallback then keeps the overlay out of the layout pipeline:

- the five HUD dials animate with a compositor-only `transform: scale()` on a
  fixed 200×200 box instead of rewriting `width`/`height`/`font-size` every frame;
- per-dial style writes are cached, so `filter`, `z-index`, and the chip text are
  only written when they actually change;
- the beam canvas caps the device pixel ratio at 1.5 and falls back to 1x with
  fewer capsule details when frame times stay long;
- the `AudioContext` is created on the first user gesture, and sound cues that
  would already be in the past are skipped instead of replayed late.

The choice is stored in the page's `localStorage`
(`dsh:sao-link-start:compatibility-mode`) and applies on the next replay
(`Ctrl+Alt+L`) or the next Harness start; toggling it does not require a restart.

Measured with a replay-isolated headless Chromium run of one overlay
(`Ctrl+Alt+L`, same environment), original → compatibility: layout count
37 → 9, layout time 0.087 s → 0.028 s, style-recalculation time
0.979 s → 0.252 s.

### Tunnel only

**Settings → SAO Link Start → Tunnel only** is **off by default**. Check it to
play just the perspective beam fly-through and skip everything after it:

- the five-sense HUD dials, the language pill, the login panel and the character
  registration dialog are not rendered at all;
- the overlay fades out at ~3.7 s and unmounts at ~4.3 s instead of 14.4 s;
- only the opening whoosh and a short exit whoosh play — no dial/panel cues;
- the beam/dial/language settings above only affect the full sequence.

The preference is stored in `localStorage`
(`dsh:sao-link-start:tunnel-only`) and applies on the next replay
(`Ctrl+Alt+L`) or the next Harness start. Compatibility mode and Tunnel only are
independent: if the full sequence stutters, use Compatibility mode.

### Permissions and network use

The plugin adds a startup overlay and a settings section. It does not request
credentials, read conversations or workspace files, or make network requests.

## 中文说明

这是一个非官方的 DeepSeek Harness 启动动画插件，以程序绘制方式重现
SAO 风格的登录流程。Harness 界面启动时会显示全屏动画，播放结束后自动卸载。

插件不包含动画原片、图片、字体或游戏素材。光束隧道、HUD 圆盘、界面和音效均由
Canvas、CSS、SVG 与 Web Audio 实时生成。

### 功能

- 带近相机裁剪的透视胶囊光束隧道，避免光束穿过镜头时闪屏。
- 五个青色 HUD 圆盘，以及语言、登录、角色确认界面。
- 独立的 **设置 → SAO 连结开始动画** 页面。
- 可调光束速度、光束长度、光束数量与圆盘大小。
- 可编辑语言名称和人物名称，默认分别为 `Japanese` 与 `Kirito(M)`。
- 点击画面或按 `Escape` 跳过；Harness 页面获得键盘焦点时，可按
  `Ctrl+Alt+L` 重播。
- 支持系统的减少动态效果偏好。
- 默认使用原版渲染（即性能模式）；另提供可选的**兼容模式**（默认关闭），
  给核显/低配机器一个更省主线程的回退路径；见[兼容模式](#兼容模式)。
- 可选**仅光束穿行**片头（默认关闭）：只播放光束穿行，跳过后面所有动画；
  见[仅光束穿行](#仅光束穿行)。

### 安装

把 `desktop` 换成你实际使用的配置名称：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:liyansong0015/dsh-sao-link-start
```

安装后重启 Harness。从账号菜单打开**设置**，在左侧选择
**SAO 连结开始动画**即可调节参数。

### 兼容模式

**设置 → SAO 连结开始动画 → 兼容模式**，**默认关闭**：默认状态就是原版渲染，
也就是性能模式（2x DPR、逐帧精确布局），两种状态画面完全一致。

只有在动画卡顿时（常见于核显/较旧的 GPU）才需要勾选。开启后改用合成器友好的
精简路径：

- 五块 HUD 圆盘改为对固定 200×200 盒子做合成器 `transform: scale()`，
  不再每帧重写 `width`/`height`/`font-size`；
- 每个圆盘的样式写入会做缓存，`filter`、`z-index` 与 chip 文本只在真正变化时写入；
- 光束 canvas 的 device pixel ratio 上限为 1.5，帧时间持续偏长时自动降到 1x
  并减少胶囊细节；
- `AudioContext` 延迟到首个用户手势才创建，已经错过的音效不再补播。

选择保存在页面 `localStorage`（`dsh:sao-link-start:compatibility-mode`），
在下次重播（`Ctrl+Alt+L`）或下次启动 Harness 时生效——单纯切换开关不需要重启。

实测（重放隔离的无头 Chromium，一次完整动画，同一环境，原版 → 兼容模式）：
布局次数 37 → 9，布局耗时 0.087 s → 0.028 s，样式重算耗时 0.979 s → 0.252 s。

### 仅光束穿行

**设置 → SAO 连结开始动画 → 仅光束穿行**，**默认关闭**。勾选后只播放最前面的
透视光束穿行，后面全部跳过：

- 五感 HUD 圆盘、语言标签、登录面板、角色注册界面对话框完全不渲染；
- 遮罩约 3.7 秒开始淡出、约 4.3 秒卸载（完整序列是 14.4 秒）；
- 只保留开场音效和一段收尾音效，没有圆盘/面板提示音；
- 上面的光束/圆盘/语言参数只影响完整序列。

选择保存在 `localStorage`（`dsh:sao-link-start:tunnel-only`），
在下次重播（`Ctrl+Alt+L`）或下次启动 Harness 时生效。兼容模式与仅光束穿行是
两个独立开关：完整序列卡顿时再开兼容模式。

### 权限与联网

插件只注册启动遮罩和设置栏目，不读取对话或工作区文件，不请求凭据，也不会发起
网络请求。

## Attribution

The beam concept and palette were adapted from
[unixzii/SAOLinkStart](https://github.com/unixzii/SAOLinkStart), released under
The Unlicense. This project is also released under The Unlicense.

Sword Art Online and related names are trademarks of their respective owners.
This fan project is not affiliated with or endorsed by the rights holders.

# 学习模式 · dsh-learning-mode

输入框工具栏的「学习模式」开关：打开后为**当前会话**注入一套固定教学提示词——问题引入 → 讲解与交互探索 → 测试 → 反馈纠错。测验、参数滑块、交卷判分都由 GenUI 直接画在回答里，点选即时出结果，判分不发模型请求。

> Learning Mode for DeepSeek Harness: a toggle next to the input box that injects a teaching prompt into the current session (introduce the idea, teach it, test it, correct it) and renders quizzes, sliders and local grading through GenUI. No course library, no progress storage, no extra pages.

## 长什么样

学习模式本身不画界面。它负责的是"教什么、什么时候停、什么时候反馈"，画面交给 **GenUI** 渲染。
下面三张不是设计稿，是同一套渲染器实时画出来的真实组件：

**单题测验：点选即判，选错了也有针对该选项的解释**

![单题测验](docs/assets/quiz.png)

**交卷判分：三题一起交，分数、每题对错和解析当场出现（全部在浏览器里算）**

![交卷判分](docs/assets/paper.png)

**参数探索：先猜结论，再拖滑块看曲线怎么变**

![参数探索](docs/assets/plot.png)

开关本身在输入框工具栏左侧，是一个小图标按钮：点亮＝本会话已开启，再点一次关闭。

## 一次完整的学习循环

| 阶段 | 你做什么 | 插件和模型做什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 引入 | 说一句想学什么，比如「我想学概率，从条件概率开始」 | 用一个真实问题引出为什么值得学，并说明这轮学完能做到什么 |
| 学习 | 看解释、跟着预测、拖滑块验证 | 直觉解释 → 具体例子 → 准确术语或公式；只在值得动手的地方安排探索 |
| 测试 | 点选项、或把几题都选完点「交卷」 | GenUI 本地判分：对错、解析、得分立刻显示，不额外请求模型 |
| 反馈 | 说哪里没懂，或点「继续学习」「换个例子」 | 针对具体误区换反例重讲，再给一道等价题确认 |

### 哪些交互留在本地，哪些会回到模型

- **纯本地**：判题、交卷打分、拖滑块、展开与切换——浏览器即时完成，不产生请求。
- **会回传**：带 `action` 的单题测验、带 `groups` 的交卷按钮、以及「换个例子」「再讲一遍」「继续学习」这类按钮，会以 `[genui-action]` 把真实作答与选择送回模型，模型据此补讲或推进。
- 分界由内置提示词约束：没有真实提交时，模型不会声称看到了分数或选择。

## 前置条件：先装 GenUI（必装）

本插件只负责"教什么"，画面交给 **GenUI** 渲染。它不是一个库，而是另一个独立插件，必须单独安装：

| | |
| --- | --- |
| npm 包 | `@changfenhuang/dsh-genui` |
| 源码仓库 | [omdsh-dev/dsh-genui](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-genui) |
| 许可 | MIT |
| 插件市场里 | 搜 `dsh-genui`，作者 `omdsh-dev`，分类 ui |
| 本插件实测版本 | `0.12.0`（市场当前已到 `0.13.0`） |

安装（市场里点安装，或命令行）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @changfenhuang/dsh-genui
```

> ⚠️ 市场里有三个名字相近的插件，只有第一个是本插件依赖的那个：
> - `@changfenhuang/dsh-genui`（作者 omdsh-dev）✅ 本插件需要的就是它
> - `dsh-genui`（作者 lhuans，OpenTiny / schemaJson 路线）❌ 不兼容
> - `dsh-plugin-genui`（作者 pengyue-polaron，React 任务应用）❌ 不兼容

**怎么确认真的生效**：插件装好后，profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里会出现 `@changfenhuang/dsh-genui`；刷新客户端后，让它输出一段 ```dsh-ui 代码块——能渲染成卡片/测验即为生效。

**没装 GenUI 会怎样**：按钮照常可用，提示词照常注入，但 `dsh-ui` 围栏只会显示成一段原始代码块——测验点不了、滑块拖不动、本地判分不存在，教学退化成纯文字问答。所以这是"必装前置"，不是可选项。

**为什么本插件不把 GenUI 打进包里**：GenUI 安装后是 215 个文件 / 8.5 MB，自带宿主入口、浏览器渲染器和 katex / mermaid / three / echarts 资产。DSH 只加载 profile `bundles` 列表里的插件——把它写成我们的 `dependencies` 只会让 pnpm 多下一份，却不会被注册成 bundle，渲染器依然不工作，还可能和用户已装的版本互相打架。因此两个插件各自安装、各自升级；`package.json` 里只用 `peerDependencies`（`optional`）说明这层关系，不参与安装。

## 安装

插件市场里搜「学习模式」即可；或命令行一次装齐（两条命令，按顺序执行，各自只装一个插件）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @changfenhuang/dsh-genui
dsh plugin --profile web add @yushui/dsh-learning-mode
```

第一条是渲染器（见上节），第二条才是本插件。已经装过 GenUI 的跳过第一条即可。

### 这两条命令是什么，不是什么

- 是宿主自带的插件管理器：等价于在市场里点两次「安装」，装到本机 profile 的 `node_modules` 并登记进 `dsh.profile.bundles`。
- 不是 `curl … | sh` 之类的远程脚本：命令不下载执行任何安装脚本，包本身也没有 `postinstall` / `preinstall` / `prepare`，只有 `prepack`（`node --check` 语法检查，只在打包时跑）。`pnpm` 默认也不执行依赖的构建脚本。
- 想撤销：在插件市场里点卸载（推荐，会同时清掉 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里的登记）；也可以用 `dsh plugin --profile web remove <包名>`，若那行登记还在，手动删掉即可。

## 使用

打开或新建一个会话，点击输入框工具栏的「学习模式」，确认按钮高亮。输入「我想学概率，先从条件概率开始」等主题即可。关闭后，从下一次模型请求起不再加入这套提示词，历史对话仍保留。

学习模式不替代 GenUI，不创建其他网页，不改变模型或权限。

## 生命周期

默认关闭；不同会话互不影响。按钮只在点击时执行一次 `/learn on|off`，把宿主确认后的状态记在当前窗口的 sessionStorage 里；页面刷新沿用该记录，不再自动向宿主查询——因此不会在会话流里凭空多出命令记录。宿主重启或插件重载会回到关闭。没有课程库或学习进度持久化，插件也不会从日志恢复开关。

## 内置提示词

教学规则位于 `prompt.js`。每次只教一个完整小节，保留真实动手与等待作答的环节，不伪造成绩；要求模型先讲"观察什么、操作什么"，再给组件。滑块与本地判题由 GenUI 完成，需要模型补讲时才使用 action。

**兜底**：如果用户说看不到组件、按钮点不了，或者只看到一段代码/JSON，提示词要求模型从下一条回复起改用文字、列表和表格把同一份内容讲完，并且不再输出围栏。所以在没有渲染器的环境里，教学不会断在半截 JSON 上。

## 开发

无运行时 npm 依赖的原生 JavaScript 插件：`index.js` 是宿主入口（注册 `/learn` 命令与 system-prompt 段落），`client.js` 是宿主 ModuleLoader 直接可用的浏览器包，不需要额外转译。使用 `conversation.input.left`、`remote.commands`、`systemPrompt` 接口；客户端不 require GenUI 的任何模块，因此 `dsh.client.inject` 只列宿主包，dsh-ui 的渲染完全由 GenUI 自己的围栏渲染器接管。

```sh
npm test      # 14 项测试：命令/提示词生命周期 + 客户端交互
npm run build # 逐个检查原生 JS 语法
npm pack
```

高级备用命令：`/learn on`、`/learn off`、`/learn status`。返回 JSON 状态且不启动模型生成；按钮平时不调用它们，只在点击（或点击重试）时执行一次，因此每次都会在会话流留下一条命令记录。

`docs/assets/` 里的截图由 GenUI 的独立渲染器（`standalone-runtime.js`）渲染同一份 `dsh-ui` 规格后截取，与聊天里看到的组件同源。

## 边界

本地判卷不自动等于模型收到错题；提示词要求模型在收到真实提交或用户说明后再反馈。教学质量和组件选择仍依赖所用模型与 GenUI 能力，本插件不保证任意模型都能正确讲解任意学科。

## 安全边界

代码只用宿主公开接口：服务端注册 `/learn` 命令与一段 system prompt，客户端只做一次 `remote.commands.execute(sessionId, "/learn on|off")` 和 `sessionStorage` 读写。

- 不联网：没有任何 `fetch` / `http` 请求，不连第三方服务。
- 不读写用户文件：服务端与客户端都不 import `fs`（`test/` 里的测试读自身源码除外）。
- 不执行子进程、不 `eval`，仓库里没有二进制和压缩代码。
- 不收集数据：没有遥测、没有上报，状态只存在当前窗口的 `sessionStorage`。
- 安装期不跑脚本：见上方「这两条命令是什么，不是什么」。

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: Exa/Tavily/Jina search and Jina/Tavily fetch providers for DeepSeek Harness ctx.web, with fallback chains
plugins.readme_text:
# @wjunhere/dsh-web-providers

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）`ctx.web` 的搜索与抓取 provider，内部是**有序兜底链**：

- 搜索：`exa → tavily → jina-search`，注册为 provider id `dsh-search`；
- 抓取：`jina → tavily extract`，注册为 provider id `dsh-fetch`。

链对外仍是单个 provider，`web_search` / `web_fetch` 工具不变，模型无感知；前一后端失败
（403/404/超时/空正文）自动换下一个。

## 解决什么问题

- DSH 内置 `web_fetch` 走 DeepSeek Fetch API，目标站点不可达或被反爬时统一返回 HTTP 404；
  Jina Reader 由 Jina 侧抓取并转 Markdown，能覆盖维基百科、GitHub raw、Hacker News 等站点。
- 官方 DeepSeek 搜索是一次完整模型调用；Exa 是纯检索 API，语义召回更适合英文技术内容。
- 官方 Exa provider 用精确 peer 版本，DSH 小版本升级就会在启动时被禁用；本包用范围 peer + 兜底链，
  不再依赖单一后端是否可用。

## 安装

在 DSH profile 目录（例如 `~/.dsh/profiles/<name>`）安装：

```sh
npm install @wjunhere/dsh-web-providers
```

把包加进 `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`：

```json
{
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["...", "@wjunhere/dsh-web-providers"] } }
}
```

再在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里 pin 两个 provider：

```yaml
- id: web
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web"
  config:
    searchProvider: dsh-search
    fetchProvider: dsh-fetch
```

重启 DSH 生效。

## 配置

凭据默认从启动环境的 `EXA_API_KEY` / `TAVILY_API_KEY` / `JINA_API_KEY` 读取，也可以写在
`config` 里（优先级高于环境变量）。

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: web-providers
      name: '@wjunhere/dsh-web-providers'
      config:
        search:
          order: [exa, tavily, jina]   # 搜索链顺序
        fetch:
          order: [jina, tavily]        # 抓取链顺序
        exa:
          apiKey: ''                   # 空则读 EXA_API_KEY
          baseURL: https://api.exa.ai
          proxyUrl: ''
          searchType: auto             # auto / keyword / neural
          highlightsPerResult: 1
          timeoutMs: 20000
        tavily:
          apiKey: ''                   # 空则读 TAVILY_API_KEY
          baseURL: https://api.tavily.com
          proxyUrl: ''                 # 大陆网络通常需要
          searchDepth: basic           # basic / advanced
          extractDepth: basic
          numResults: 5
          maxContentChars: 100000
          timeoutMs: 20000
        jina:
          apiKey: ''                   # 空则读 JINA_API_KEY
          baseURL: https://r.jina.ai
          searchBaseURL: https://s.jina.ai
          proxyUrl: ''
          timeoutMs: 30000
          maxContentChars: 100000
          minContentChars: 50
          allowAnonymous: false
```

## 行为

- 搜索链：Exa 返回 `sources[]`（无 highlight 的结果被丢弃）；Tavily 返回 title/url/content
  （content 截 500 字符当 snippet）；Jina Search 返回 title/url/description。
  任一成功即返回，全部失败时报 `WEB_PROVIDER_ERROR` 并附每段失败原因。
- 抓取链：Jina 返回 `{ url, statusCode: 200, body: { kind: 'text', content } }`，正文前带标题；
  失败（非 2xx、空正文、正文过短、拦截页）后回退 Tavily Extract 的 `raw_content`。
- 两链都遵守调用方 `AbortSignal`，每段有独立超时。

## 限制

- Tavily Extract 对反爬站点同样可能失败（如 Reddit）；这类只能走浏览器路径。
- Exa 需要 API key；Jina 匿名模式只有 20 RPM（带 key 500 RPM）。

## 开发

```sh
npm install
EXA_API_KEY=... TAVILY_API_KEY=... JINA_API_KEY=... \
JINA_PROXY_URL=http://127.0.0.1:7897 TAVILY_PROXY_URL=http://127.0.0.1:7897 \
node test/providers.mjs
```

测试直接打真实 API，覆盖每个后端和两条兜底链，没有 mock。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: 把本机 WorkBuddy 账号发布为 OpenAI 兼容的 HTTP 服务，供 WSL / Windows 上的其他 Agent 工具复用其模型
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH WorkBuddy Broadcast

[English](./README.en.md) | 中文

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-workbuddy-broadcast.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-workbuddy-broadcast)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-workbuddy-broadcast.svg)](./LICENSE)

把本机已登录的 WorkBuddy 账号发布为一个 **OpenAI 兼容的 HTTP 服务**，供同一台机器上的其他 Agent 工具复用它的模型——Windows 上的、WSL 里的、macOS 与 Linux 上的都可以。

## 它解决什么问题

[`dsh-workbuddy-connect`](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect) 让 **DSH 自己**能用 WorkBuddy 的模型。但这个能力只属于 DSH。

如果你同时用别的 Agent 工具——Codex、Claude Code、Cursor、或者自己写的脚本——它们没法共用这份模型额度。本插件把 WorkBuddy 的账号能力以标准 OpenAI 协议暴露出来，那些工具只要支持「自定义 OpenAI Base URL」，就能直接接入。

```
任意 Agent 工具
      │  http://127.0.0.1:18731/v1  (标准 OpenAI 协议)
      ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  DSH: dsh-workbuddy-broadcast           │
│    ├─ Bearer 鉴权                        │
│    ├─ GET  /v1/models                   │
│    └─ POST /v1/chat/completions  (SSE)  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────┘
      │
      ▼
   WorkBuddy 账号（读取 App 自身的登录态）
```

## 前置条件

1. 已安装 **DSH（DeepSeek Harness）** 并能正常运行
2. 已安装并**登录** WorkBuddy 桌面 App（国内版）
3. 已安装 [`dsh-workbuddy-connect`](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect) 插件，且版本与 DSH 内核匹配

> 第 3 条是**运行时依赖**，不是安装依赖。本插件不会在你安装时强制检查它；但缺少它时插件会进入 `missing-peer` 状态、不监听端口，并在设置页给出提示。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add dsh-workbuddy-broadcast
```

装完后重启 DSH，在**设置**里会多出一个「WorkBuddy 广播」页面。

## 使用

### 1. 拿到端点与 API Key

打开 **设置 → WorkBuddy 广播**，页面会显示：

- **WSL 端点**：`http://<vEthernet 地址>:18731/v1`
- **本机端点**：`http://localhost:18731/v1`
- **API Key**：点「复制」即可

首次启用时 API Key 是**随机生成**的（不写盘）。想固定下来，就在页面的输入框里填一个自己的值并保存。

### 2. 在别的工具里配置

任何支持「自定义 OpenAI 兼容端点」的工具都可以：

```text
Base URL : http://localhost:18731/v1
API Key  : <设置页里复制的那个>
Model    : deepseek-v4.1-flash
```

**重要**：本服务**只支持流式（SSE）**。请求会强制 `stream: true`，不支持一次性返回完整响应。如果你的工具只做非流式调用，它无法使用本服务。

### 3. 在 WSL 里使用

WSL 无法通过 `127.0.0.1` 访问 Windows 上的监听端口（NAT 模式下 `127.0.0.1` 指向 WSL 自己），而 Windows 的 vEthernet 地址会变化，因此需要一个转发脚本。

> **脚本不在 npm 包里。** 它只对 Windows + WSL 有用，其他平台用不到，因此单独放在仓库中，避免让所有安装都背上这个体积。请从
> [`scripts/wb-bridge`](https://github.com/zk-wz/dsh-workbuddy-broadcast/blob/main/scripts/wb-bridge)
> 下载（页面右上角 Raw），或在 WSL 里直接取：

```sh
# 在 WSL 内
mkdir -p ~/scripts ~/.local/bin
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zk-wz/dsh-workbuddy-broadcast/main/scripts/wb-bridge \
  -o ~/scripts/wb-bridge
chmod 755 ~/scripts/wb-bridge
ln -sfn ~/scripts/wb-bridge ~/.local/bin/wb-bridge
```

然后：

```sh
wb-bridge start     # 后台启动（不注册开机自启）
wb-bridge status    # 查看状态
wb-bridge stop      # 停止
wb-bridge port 8080 # 运行中改端口
wb-bridge log       # 查看最近日志（仅内存，不落盘）
wb-bridge help
```

启动后，WSL 里的工具用 `http://127.0.0.1:18731/v1` 即可。

> **端口必须两边一致**：WSL 侧的 `wb-bridge` 把本地端口转发到 Windows 的**同一个端口号**。如果你改了插件端口，`wb-bridge` 也要跟着改。

## 配置项

在插件管理页的原生表单，或设置页里都能改：

| 项 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `port` | `18731` | 监听端口 |
| `apiKey` | 空（随机生成） | Bearer token；填了才会持久化 |
| `allowLocal` | `true` | 是否额外监听 `127.0.0.1`，供 Windows 本机工具使用 |

改完需要**重启 DSH**（或重新加载插件）才生效。

## 支持的模型

模型列表在启动时从 WorkBuddy 实时拉取，因此**跟随你账号的实际可用集合**，不同账号可能不同。可随时查询：

```sh
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" http://localhost:18731/v1/models
```

若实时拉取失败，会退回插件内置的静态列表（可能与你账号的实际可用集合有出入）。

### 推理强度

支持标准的 `reasoning_effort` 参数，会**原样透传**给上游。各模型支持的档位不同，常见的：

| 模型 | 支持档位 |
|---|---|
| `deepseek-v4.1-flash` | `low` / `high` / `max`（默认 `high`） |
| `kimi-k2.8-preview` | `low` / `high` / `max` |
| `glm-5.3` / `glm-5.3-flash` | `low` / `high` / `max` |
| `space-bunny` | `low` / `medium` / `high` / `xhigh` / `max` |
| `step-5-preview` | `low` / `medium` / `high` |

少数模型（如 `glm-5.1`）**要求必须显式传** `reasoning_effort`，不传会被上游拒绝。

## 安全说明

- **API Key 会以明文形式**保存在你的 DSH profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里（这是 DSH 配置持久化机制决定的）。如果你的配置目录有被他人读取的风险，请留意。
- 默认只监听 `127.0.0.1` 与 WSL 的 vEthernet 网卡，**不监听 `0.0.0.0`**，因此默认不在局域网内暴露。
- 想关闭本机监听，把 `allowLocal` 设为 `false`。
- 本插件读取的是 WorkBuddy App 自身的登录态，**不修改、不复制**它的凭据文件。凭据解密用的密钥只在内存中存在。

## 平台支持

| 平台 | 状态 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows** | ✅ 完整支持 | 可同时服务 Windows 本机与 WSL 内的工具 |
| **macOS** | ✅ 支持 | 只监听本机地址；凭据解密走 Spotlight 发现 App |
| **Linux / WSL** | ⚠️ 部分支持 | 只监听本机地址。若 WorkBuddy 的凭据是加密存储的（`$wbEncrypted`），则**无法解密**——上游 [`dsh-workbuddy-connect`](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect) 在 Linux 上同样不支持。此时需要用未加密的凭据文件（`WORKBUDDY_AUTH_FILE`） |

**WSL 端点**（`http://<vEthernet 地址>:18731/v1`）只存在于 Windows 上。其他平台没有 vEthernet 网卡，插件会自动降级为只监听 `127.0.0.1`，设置页会说明原因。

## 限制

- **只支持流式（SSE）**，不支持非流式。
- 只能服务**当前登录的那一个** WorkBuddy 账号。
- 依赖上游 [`dsh-workbuddy-connect`](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect) 的公开导出。若该插件发生不兼容改动，本插件需要同步更新。
- **没装 WSL 也能用**：Windows 上会自动降级为只监听本机地址，此时工具用 `http://localhost:18731/v1`。

## 免责声明

- 使用本插件消耗的是**你自己的** WorkBuddy 额度
- 请遵守 WorkBuddy 的服务条款

## 许可

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: explain Windows game crashes from Event Log, WER reports and crash dumps.
plugins.readme_text:
# game-crash-doctor

DeepSeek Harness 插件：游戏崩溃后，用 Windows 事件日志、WER 报告和转储文件告诉你**为什么崩**、**怎么修**。

> Windows only · DSH `0.1.2`+ · 所有分析都在本机完成，不联网、不上传数据。

## 功能

- **自动监控**：每 45 秒检查一次事件日志，发现新的游戏崩溃时在当前会话里推送一条通知（原因摘要 + 3 条建议）。
- **按需诊断**：随时调用 `diagnose_game_crash`，可指定回溯小时数和游戏名。
- **数据来源**：
  - 应用程序日志：Application Error 1000、Windows Error Reporting 1001、Application Hang 1002、.NET Runtime 1026
  - 系统日志：显示驱动 TDR 4101、Kernel-Power 41、BugCheck 1001、意外关机 6008
  - WER 报告 `Report.wer`（异常代码、故障模块、Bucket）
  - 崩溃转储：`%LOCALAPPDATA%\CrashDumps`、`C:\Windows\Minidump`、`C:\Windows\LiveKernelReports`
- **原因归类**：ACCESS_VIOLATION、C++/.NET 异常、堆破坏、栈溢出、显卡 TDR、DXGI 设备丢失、反作弊、蓝屏 BugCheck 等，并给出置信度和排查顺序。
- **重复崩溃识别**：同一程序/异常/模块在时间窗内反复出现时会单独提示。

## 安装

### 从 npm

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add game-crash-doctor
```

### 从本地源码

```powershell
# 1. 把本目录放到 profile 的 plugins 下
#    %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\plugins\game-crash-doctor
# 2. 注册到 profile
dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:./plugins/game-crash-doctor
```

安装后重启 DSH（或在插件市场里点重启），工具和后台监控才会生效。

## 使用

直接对 Agent 说：

- “刚才游戏为什么崩了？”
- “帮我看看最近 3 天的崩溃记录”
- “只查 Wuthering Waves 的崩溃”

Agent 会调用 `diagnose_game_crash`：

| 参数 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `hours` | 回溯小时数，1–168，默认 24 |
| `game` | 只看可执行文件名/路径包含该关键词的记录 |

## 配置

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中给插件加 `config`：

```yaml
- id: game-crash-doctor
  name: game-crash-doctor
  config:
    notify: true              # 是否自动推送崩溃通知
    pollSeconds: 45           # 轮询间隔（15–600 秒）
    gameOnly: true            # 只对“像游戏”的崩溃推送
    notifyAllSessions: false  # true = 通知所有打开的会话
    maxNotificationsPerHour: 3
```

## 判断逻辑示例

| 信号 | 典型结论 |
|---|---|
| `0xC0000005` @ 游戏模块 | 模组/补丁越界、文件损坏、内存不稳 |
| `0xE06D7363` @ `KERNELBASE.dll` | 未捕获的 C++ 异常：游戏 bug、模组/汉化、反作弊注入 |
| `0xC0000374` / `0xC0000409` | 堆破坏 / 栈溢出：优先查内存超频、XMP、注入 DLL |
| `0x887A0006` 或 4101 TDR | 显卡驱动超时：DDU 重装驱动、恢复默认频率、查供电/温度 |
| Kernel-Power 41 | 异常断电/死机：电源、散热、超频、BIOS |
| BugCheck `0x124` | WHEA 硬件错误：CPU/内存/电源 |
| Application Hang 1002 | 主线程卡死：驱动、覆盖层、资源加载 |

## 隐私与安全

- 只读取本机 Windows 事件日志、WER 报告和转储文件，**不发起任何网络请求**。
- 不收集、不上传崩溃内容、路径或用户信息。
- 需要执行的唯一外部程序是系统自带的 `powershell.exe`（只读采集）。
- 事件日志查询不需要管理员权限；`C:\Windows\LiveKernelReports` 和部分 WER 目录可能需要管理员权限，读不到会自动跳过。

## 限制

- 仅支持 Windows 10/11。
- 不解析转储里的调用栈（没有符号表）；转储只用于定位和关联。需要更深的栈分析时，用 WinDbg 打开报告里给出的 `.dmp`。
- 如果游戏是“直接断电/死机”且系统来不及写日志，可能只能看到 Kernel-Power 41，插件会明确说明“没有应用崩溃记录”。
- 自动通知要求 DSH 正在运行；DSH 关闭期间发生的崩溃，会在下次启动后的第一次轮询补报。

## License

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
DSH Mobile — DeepSeek Harness Remote

An open-source Android companion that puts your DeepSeek Harness in your pocket.
Drive sessions, review plans and goals, answer approvals and questions, and get notified when the harness finishes — from your phone, over your network or a relay.

English · 中文 · हिन्दी · Español · Français · ไทย

DSH Mobile is an **unofficial companion app** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (MIT). It mirrors the web GUI feature for feature and uses the harness's own visual language. Android only, Kotlin + Jetpack Compose. Its companion on the other end is [**dsh-relay**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-relay), a harness plugin that adds the authentication layer the harness says it lacks, so this app can reach a harness with a real credential and a pinned key instead of an open port. See [Relay](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Relay). **[dshm.zyphite.com](https://dshm.zyphite.com)** is the project site: what the app is, what it looks like, and how to get it running, on one page. The [**wiki**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki) is the user-facing guide: [getting started](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Getting-Started), [connecting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Connecting), [troubleshooting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Troubleshooting), a [feature tour](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Feature-Tour) and an [FAQ](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/FAQ). --- ## Screenshots | Connect | Chat | Trajectory | |:--:|:--:|:--:| | | | | | Recent harnesses with live reachability, LAN discovery, manual `host:port`, auto-connect. | Streamed turns, a glyph per tool, expandable tool cards, permission picker. | The same session as a per-turn ledger with usage totals. | | Session details | Subagents | |:--:|:--:| | | | | Context breakdown, goal, plan mode, background jobs, queued turns, host info, session-log export. | The subagent catalog — open a child's transcript, follow up, or interrupt it. | ## Features - Connecting — finds a harness on your Wi-Fi with an active subnet scan and a readiness handshake, remembers hosts and probes them for liveness on the way in, takes a manual `host:port`, handles loopback for same-device setups, and auto-connects when you tell it to (last used, LAN, or same device). - Navigation — the drawers work like Discord's: swipe right from the left edge for the workspace-grouped chat list, swipe left to close it, swipe left from the right edge for the session details panel. - Chat — streamed turns with reasoning disclosure, markdown, terminal/diff/read/search/web tool cards, a queue dock where you can edit, remove or steer a queued turn, history paging, and multi-photo and file attachments. Drafts are kept per host and session. - Workspace panels — tabbed text, Markdown, image, PDF and isolated HTML previews; native terminal controls with a bundled xterm renderer; archived-session restore in Settings. - Message feedback — confirmed ratings and retraction, with version-conflict handling. - Slash commands and skills — typing `/` lists the session's commands and skills above the composer. The composer checks a `/` line against the session's own command catalog and runs it through the harness's command gateway. Anything the catalog does not claim is sent as a prompt, which is how skills get invoked. With the dsh-rewind plugin on the host, `/rewind` opens a picker. - Everything the GUI does — goals (phases, rounds, pause/resume/edit), plan mode and plan review, permission approvals, user questions, todo dock, subagents (catalog, follow-ups, interrupt), background jobs, workflow runs, skills, model selection, agent presets, session search, trajectory ledger, session export, message feedback. - Notifications — turn complete, goal complete or blocked, review or question waiting for you. A foreground service keeps the connection alive in the background. - Harness look — the exact DeepSeek Harness design tokens (colors, type, radii, disclosure rows, shimmer, ink buttons), with light, dark and system themes. - 11 languages — English, 中文, हिन्दी, Español, Français, العربية, বাংলা, Português, Русский, اردو, ไทย (RTL aware). ### Added in 0.15.0 - A Check now button for updates in Settings > About. The automatic check also runs again when you come back to the app after a few hours. - Workspace links in replies drawn as file and folder pills; a folder opens in Files. - A redesigned Details panel, Workspace screen and Settings, with archived sessions on a tab of their own. ### Added in 0.14.0 - A `/` menu above the composer with the session's commands and skills. - A picker for the dsh-rewind plugin's `/rewind` and `/undo` that asks for confirmation before it restores files. The transcript hides what a rewind withdrew and marks the cut. ### Added in 0.13.0 - Automation catalog, timing edits, delivery history and session shortcuts. - Plugin installation, updates, toggles, removal, progress and recovery. Create plugin stages an unsent draft with the Creator preset when the host offers it. - Timed questions, continued replies, saved answer drafts and reopenable plans. - Draft text and file, folder and session references saved across app restarts. - Model search, YAML document properties and multiline goal editing. - Reverse-proxy path support and tool argument previews while the model is writing. ## Requirements - Android 8.0+ (minSdk 26). - A running [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) at `0.2.1-alpha.2`, the protocol baseline for DSH Mobile `0.16.0`. Existing protocol fallbacks remain for `0.2.0-rc.1`, `0.1.7-rc.x` and `0.1.6-alpha.x`; new management features need host support. See [compatibility](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) and the [0.13.0 validation status](docs/VALIDATION-0.13.0.md) for what has been checked on this baseline. ## Quick start 1. Install the latest APK from [Releases](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/releases/latest). 2. Open the app and choose how to connect. plugins.description: DSH plugin — free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Free LLM API, no API key needed. 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，无需 API key
plugins.readme_text:
# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click install. **From npm**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh.git cd opencode2dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode2dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencode2dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencode2dsh name: '@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencode2dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only, plugin 0.3.7+: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`muse-spark-*`, Responses-only on Zen) ▼ https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 ← Authorization: Bearer public with CLI-identical headers: user-agent: opencode/… x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-session-affinity, X-Session-Id, x-opencode-request, x-opencode-project ``` - **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the conversation's first user turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible), and each request gets a fresh random id, mirroring the CLI. - **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev pricing metadata decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list. A disk cache (~7-day TTL) covers upstream outages. - **Resilience** — the adapter registers immediately at startup; if the first catalog fetch races your network (VPN/TUN reconnects, DNS), the plugin retries on a short cadence (~1 min) before settling into the periodic refresh. - **Sidecar mode** (`mode: sidecar`, legacy) — spawns a local Go agent (a single-tenant port of [opencode2api](https://github.com/jasonxu114514/opencode2api)) on `127.0.0.1:`, token-authenticated, and registers a standard `llm-pi-ai` route. **Not part of the published package**; build it from `legacy/agent` (`go build ./cmd/agent`) and point `agentPath` at the binary. ## Health & troubleshooting The plugin writes a health snapshot after every refresh round: ``` ~/.opencode2dsh/adapter-status.json ``` ```json { "status": "ready", "total": 64, "exposed": 9, "lastError": "", "writtenAt": "2026-08-29T07:01:54.915Z" } ``` | Symptom | Likely cause & fix | | --- | --- | | `403 FreeTierError` / "OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode" | The upstream restricts free-tier clients. The plugin preserves the explanation instead of reporting an invalid API key. Use the supported OpenCode client or an official API service. | | Boot screen shows `Failed to load plugins … list slot "plugins.item" requires options.id`, or the IP 池 entry has no configuration page | Your DSH predates the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract. Upgrade DSH to 0.1.7 (latest recommended). On 0.1.6 and older the page never mounts (it is gated on `configForms.whileServed`) — model routing is unaffected. | | DSH 0.1.7/0.2 cannot start after plugin installation (`pending … settingsScope`) | Upgrade the plugin to 0.3.5. On DSH 0.2, configure IP pooling through the installed opencode2dsh row on the Plugins page. | | Only 3 models | Startup fetch raced your network; retries land within ~1 min. Check `adapter-status.json` for `lastError`. | | `lastError: "fetch failed"` persisting | Outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` blocked; check proxy/VPN rules. | | Rate-limit errors in chat (`429 … Endpoint is unavailable`) | The anonymous lane is quota-per-IP and free models are contended. Since the fix for [#51](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/issues/51) the plugin's provider retry policy rides out 429 bursts silently (8 retries, ~1s→20s backoff, ≈90s worst case per step) instead of sur

plugins.description: Fork of jeffcwj/dsh-preset-switcher updated for DSH 0.2.1: switch the current session agent preset (mode) at any time, plus repair for sessions whose preset was deleted.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-preset-switcher > [English](#english) | **中文** > **Fork 说明**：上游 `jeffcwj/dsh-preset-switcher` 最后提交是 2026-08-17，未适配 > DSH 0.2.1。该版本移除了宿主 `webRuntime` 服务（现在提供 `webApp`），而上游插件 > `inject: ['webServer', 'webRuntime']` 因此永远不挂载、`/preset-switch/api` 404， > 前端下拉菜单随之失效。本 fork 只做兼容修复（见 CHANGELOG.md），功能与上游一致。 > 已在 **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2** 上验证：插件正常挂载，`list` / `switch` / `repair` 三个方法 > 均按预期返回。安装方式见下方「安装 / 更新」，一条 `dsh plugin add` 即可。 --- ## 概述 DSH Web 插件：在**任何时候**切换当前会话的代理预设（模式），包括对话已经开始之后 — 原生 UI 不允许这样做（"已开始的对话的代理预设已固定"）。 ### 核心功能 - **顶部下拉菜单**：会话标题操作栏中的「当前模式 ▾」按钮，列出所有预设（如 `standard`=标准模式、`code`=PTC 模式、`minimal`=极简模式、`cordis`=创造模式），用 ✓ 标记当前预设，点击即切换。 - **失效预设修复**：如果会话记录的预设已被删除（自定义预设被移除），恢复将失败导致会话不可用。下拉菜单中的「修复失效模式会话」操作（及 `repair` API）会扫描所有会话日志并重写失效引用 — 最后一个 `agent-preset/selected` 事件，否则是标题 — 重置为默认预设，操作前自动备份日志并跳过活跃会话。切换未加载的会话时若引用失效也会自动修复。 - **受控路由**：`POST /preset-switch/api`，参数 `{ method: 'list' | 'switch' | 'repair', sessionId, presetId, target? }`（回环/可信主机限制，与 dsh-sounds 相同）。 ### 工作原理 原生 API（`agentPresets.select`）通过空白会话检查来保护切换操作。本插件底层调用同一原子原语 — `agentPresets.recompose(agent.ctx, presetId)` — 将代理的作用域重新链接到目标预设的常驻挂载点。新组合在链接移动前确保完成，因此损坏的预设不会影响会话。成功后插件追加与代理记录相同的 `agent-preset/selected` 会话事件，使投影和标题标签同步更新。 **限制**：仅已加载的活跃会话可切换；子代理拥有的会话将被拒绝；新的工具集/人设从下一个模型步骤生效。 ## 安装 / 更新 需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2（或同代 0.2.x）。插件是纯 JavaScript，没有构建步骤，装完即用。 ```powershell # 方式一（推荐）：直接从 GitHub 仓库安装 dsh plugin --profile web add github:neutronslime/dsh-preset-switcher-fork # 方式二：克隆到你自己选的目录，再从该目录安装（不依赖作者机器上的任何路径） git clone https://github.com/neutronslime/dsh-preset-switcher-fork.git dsh plugin --profile web add .\dsh-preset-switcher-fork ``` 安装或升级后重启 `dsh web`（profile 启动时会合并 `cordis.patch.yml`），刷新页面， 会话标题栏右侧就会出现「当前模式 ▾」按钮。 `dsh plugin` 把参数转交给 profile 目录里的 pnpm，不需要全局 npm；想自己检查打包内容， `npm pack --dry-run` 也可以（node 20.17+ 或 22.9+ 即可，npm 11 实测无碍）。 ## 文件结构 | 文件 | 说明 | |------|------| | `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle 补丁：将插件行插入 profile 的 cordis 树（`dsh.bundle.patch`） | | `lib/index.js` | 服务端：受控 `/preset-switch/api` 路由（list / switch / repair）及会话日志修复逻辑 | | `lib/client.js` | 浏览器端：顶部下拉菜单（ClientModuleSystem bundle，React 通过 module-table externals） | | `scripts/` | `restart-web.ps1`（通用版重启+探测，路径自动推导）、`inspect-session.mjs` / `repair-session.mjs`（独立日志工具） | ## 许可证 MIT --- # dsh-preset-switcher > **English** | [中文](#概述) > **Fork note**: upstream `jeffcwj/dsh-preset-switcher` was last committed on 2026-08-17 and does not run on DSH 0.2.1: that release dropped the host `webRuntime` service (the web runtime now provides `webApp`), so the upstream `inject: ['webServer', 'webRuntime']` never mounts, `/preset-switch/api` answers 404, and the header dropdown is dead. This fork is the compatibility fix only (see CHANGELOG.md) — same features as upstream. Verified on **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2**: the plugin mounts and `list` / `switch` / `repair` all answer as expected. Install is a single `dsh plugin add`; see "Install / update" below. --- ## Overview DSH web plugin: switch the current session's agent preset (mode) at **any time**, including after the conversation has already started — the stock UI refuses that ("a started conversation's agent preset is fixed"). ### Features - **Header dropdown**: a "当前模式 ▾" button in the session header action row lists every preset (e.g. `standard`=标准模式, `code`=PTC 模式, `minimal`=极简模式, `cordis`=创造模式), marks the session's current one with ✓, and switches on click. - **Stale-preset repair**: if a session's recorded preset was deleted (a custom preset removed), resume fails and the session becomes unusable. The dropdown's "修复失效模式会话" action (and `repair` API) scans every session log and rewrites stale references — the last `agent-preset/selected` event, else the header — to the default preset, backing up the log first and skipping live sessions. Switching a not-loaded session whose reference is stale auto-repairs it too. - **Fenced route**: `POST /preset-switch/api` with `{ method: 'list' | 'switch' | 'repair', sessionId, presetId, target? }` (loopback/trusted-host fence, same as dsh-sounds). ### How it works The stock API (`agentPresets.select`) guards its swap with a blank-session check. This plugin calls the same atomic primitive underneath — `agentPresets.recompose(agent.ctx, presetId)` — which re-links the agent's scope to the target preset's standing mount. The new composition is ensured before the link moves, so a broken preset leaves the session untouched. On success the plugin appends the same `agent-preset/selected` session event the proxy records, so projections and the header label follow. Limits: only live (currently loaded) sessions can switch; subagent-owned sessions are refused; the new toolset/persona applies from the next model step. ## Install / update Requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 (or another 0.2.x build). The plugin is plain JavaScript — there is no build step. ```powershell # Option 1 (recommended): install straight from the GitHub repository dsh plugin --profile web add github:neutronslime/dsh-preset-switcher-fork # Option 2: clone into a directory of your choosing, then install from it git clone https://github.com/neutronslime/dsh-preset-switcher-fork.git dsh plugin --profile web add .\dsh-preset-switcher-fork ``` Restart `dsh web` after installing or upgrading (the profile boot merges `cordis.patch.yml`), reload the page, and the "当前模式 ▾" button appears in the session header. `dsh plugin` forwards to the pnpm inside the profile directory, so no global npm is needed; `npm pack --dry-run` works too if you want to inspect the tarball (node 20.17+ or 22.9+; npm 11 is fine). ## Layout | File | Description | |------|-------------| | `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch: inserts the plugin row into the profile's cordis tree (`dsh.bundle.patch`). | | `lib/index.js` | Host half: the fenced `/preset-switch/api` routes (list / switch / repair) and the session-log repair logic. | | `lib/client.js` | Browser half: the header dropdown (ClientModuleSystem bundle, React via module-table externals). | | `scripts/` | `restart-web.ps1` (port-agnostic restart + probe; all paths derived at runtime), `inspect-session.mjs` / `repair-session.mjs` (standalone log tools). | ## License MIT

plugins.description: Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.
plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

## Three things worth knowing before you edit this

Each of these cost real

plugins.description: Android companion for DeepSeek Harness | chat, goals, approvals & notifications from your phone, over your LAN. Kotlin + Jetpack Compose.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Mobile — DeepSeek Harness Remote

An open-source Android companion that puts your DeepSeek Harness in your pocket.
Drive sessions, review plans and goals, answer approvals and questions, and get notified when the harness finishes — from your phone, over your network or a relay.

English · 中文 · हिन्दी · Español · Français · ไทย

DSH Mobile is an **unofficial companion app** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (MIT). It mirrors the web GUI feature for feature and uses the harness's own visual language. Android only, Kotlin + Jetpack Compose. Its companion on the other end is [**dsh-relay**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-relay), a harness plugin that adds the authentication layer the harness says it lacks, so this app can reach a harness with a real credential and a pinned key instead of an open port. See [Relay](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Relay). **[dshm.zyphite.com](https://dshm.zyphite.com)** is the project site: what the app is, what it looks like, and how to get it running, on one page. The [**wiki**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki) is the user-facing guide: [getting started](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Getting-Started), [connecting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Connecting), [troubleshooting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Troubleshooting), a [feature tour](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Feature-Tour) and an [FAQ](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/FAQ). --- ## Screenshots | Connect | Chat | Trajectory | |:--:|:--:|:--:| | | | | | Recent harnesses with live reachability, LAN discovery, manual `host:port`, auto-connect. | Streamed turns, a glyph per tool, expandable tool cards, permission picker. | The same session as a per-turn ledger with usage totals. | | Session details | Subagents | |:--:|:--:| | | | | Context breakdown, goal, plan mode, background jobs, queued turns, host info, session-log export. | The subagent catalog — open a child's transcript, follow up, or interrupt it. | ## Features - Connecting — finds a harness on your Wi-Fi with an active subnet scan and a readiness handshake, remembers hosts and probes them for liveness on the way in, takes a manual `host:port`, handles loopback for same-device setups, and auto-connects when you tell it to (last used, LAN, or same device). - Navigation — the drawers work like Discord's: swipe right from the left edge for the workspace-grouped chat list, swipe left to close it, swipe left from the right edge for the session details panel. - Chat — streamed turns with reasoning disclosure, markdown, terminal/diff/read/search/web tool cards, a queue dock where you can edit, remove or steer a queued turn, history paging, and multi-photo and file attachments. Drafts are kept per host and session. - Workspace panels — tabbed text, Markdown, image, PDF and isolated HTML previews; native terminal controls with a bundled xterm renderer; archived-session restore in Settings. - Message feedback — confirmed ratings and retraction, with version-conflict handling. - Slash commands and skills — typing `/` lists the session's commands and skills above the composer. The composer checks a `/` line against the session's own command catalog and runs it through the harness's command gateway. Anything the catalog does not claim is sent as a prompt, which is how skills get invoked. With the dsh-rewind plugin on the host, `/rewind` opens a picker. - Everything the GUI does — goals (phases, rounds, pause/resume/edit), plan mode and plan review, permission approvals, user questions, todo dock, subagents (catalog, follow-ups, interrupt), background jobs, workflow runs, skills, model selection, agent presets, session search, trajectory ledger, session export, message feedback. - Notifications — turn complete, goal complete or blocked, review or question waiting for you. A foreground service keeps the connection alive in the background. - Harness look — the exact DeepSeek Harness design tokens (colors, type, radii, disclosure rows, shimmer, ink buttons), with light, dark and system themes. - 11 languages — English, 中文, हिन्दी, Español, Français, العربية, বাংলা, Português, Русский, اردو, ไทย (RTL aware). ### Added in 0.15.0 - A Check now button for updates in Settings > About. The automatic check also runs again when you come back to the app after a few hours. - Workspace links in replies drawn as file and folder pills; a folder opens in Files. - A redesigned Details panel, Workspace screen and Settings, with archived sessions on a tab of their own. ### Added in 0.14.0 - A `/` menu above the composer with the session's commands and skills. - A picker for the dsh-rewind plugin's `/rewind` and `/undo` that asks for confirmation before it restores files. The transcript hides what a rewind withdrew and marks the cut. ### Added in 0.13.0 - Automation catalog, timing edits, delivery history and session shortcuts. - Plugin installation, updates, toggles, removal, progress and recovery. Create plugin stages an unsent draft with the Creator preset when the host offers it. - Timed questions, continued replies, saved answer drafts and reopenable plans. - Draft text and file, folder and session references saved across app restarts. - Model search, YAML document properties and multiline goal editing. - Reverse-proxy path support and tool argument previews while the model is writing. ## Requirements - Android 8.0+ (minSdk 26). - A running [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) at `0.2.1-alpha.2`, the protocol baseline for DSH Mobile `0.16.0`. Existing protocol fallbacks remain for `0.2.0-rc.1`, `0.1.7-rc.x` and `0.1.6-alpha.x`; new management features need host support. See [compatibility](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) and the [0.13.0 validation status](docs/VALIDATION-0.13.0.md) for what has been checked on this baseline. ## Quick start 1. Install the latest APK from [Releases](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/releases/latest). 2. Open the app and choose how to connect.
