plugins.description: 目录插件：让 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端「新建工作区」的文件夹选择框从你设定的默认目录开始（Windows）｜Start the DSH new-workspace folder picker in your own directory.
plugins.readme_text:
# 目录插件 · dsh-directory-plugin **让 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端「新建工作区」永远从你自己的目录开始。** [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) ![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%2010%2F11-0078D4) ![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-desktop-4D6BFE) --- DSH 桌面端新建工作区时会直接弹出系统文件夹选择框，起点永远是系统默认位置（通常是下载 文件夹），而且这个对话框不接受任何调用参数。本插件把它换成「**默认打开在你设定的目录**」 的原生选择框：你只需要在设置里指定一次，之后每次新建工作区都从那里开始，具体子目录仍然 由你自己挑。 中文名「目录插件」，仓库/包名即英文 id：`dsh-directory-plugin`。 > 只支持 Windows：起始目录依赖 Win32 COM 的 `IFileDialog::SetFolder`。 ## 预览

同一操作，不同起点：默认从系统下载目录出发，插件从你设定的目录出发（示意图）

## 功能 - **接管目录选择流程**：替换「新建工作区」弹出的文件夹对话框，从一个可配置的目录开始。 - **设置页**：DSH 设置里新增「新建工作区目录」，可输入路径、点「浏览…」选择、保存或一键 恢复系统默认。 - **安全回退**：插件不可用、目录被删除或对话框出错时，自动退回 DSH 内置行为，不会报错、 不会挡住新建工作区。 - **诊断日志**：每次弹框都会记录起始目录是否生效，方便排查。 ## 安装 前置条件：Windows 10/11 + DeepSeek Harness **桌面端**。 1. 把仓库克隆或下载到本地，例如 `D:\Plugins\dsh-directory-plugin`； 2. 用 DSH 自带的插件命令行把它登记进 `desktop` 配置档（`link:` 表示直接引用本地目录， 不复制文件）： ```powershell # 按实际情况修改这两个变量 $DSH_EXE = 'C:\Program Files\DSH\DSH NEXT.exe' # 你的 DSH 桌面端安装位置 $PLUGIN = 'D:\Plugins\dsh-directory-plugin' # 本仓库所在的本地目录 $CLI = Join-Path (Split-Path $DSH_EXE) 'resources\app.asar\lib\plugin-cli.js' $env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE = '1' $env:DSH_HOME = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh" & $DSH_EXE --expose-internals $CLI desktop add "link:$PLUGIN" ``` 3. **重启 DSH 桌面端**（插件组合在启动时读取）。 4. 打开 设置 →「新建工作区目录」，选一个目录并保存，然后试一次「新建工作区」。 ## 使用 1. 设置 →「新建工作区目录」； 2. 点「浏览…」选目录，或手动输入路径，点「保存」； 3. 之后每次「新建工作区」，选择框都会从该目录开始； 4. 「恢复系统默认」清空配置，回到 DSH 原来的行为。 设置页：

设置 →「新建工作区目录」：输入框、浏览…、保存、恢复系统默认（示意图）

配置示例（`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\workspace-directory.json`）： ```json { "directory": "D:\\Projects" } ``` 旧版本（`workspace-anchor.json` / `default-workspace-directory.json`）的配置会在首次读取时 自动迁移，无需手动处理。 ## 工作原理 插件同时挂在两个平面上： | 平面 | 文件 | 作用 | | --- | --- | --- | | 宿主（host） | `lib/index.js` | 注册两个同源 HTTP 路由：`/dsh-directory-plugin/config`、`/dsh-directory-plugin/pick` | | 浏览器（client） | `client/client.js` | 接管 `conversation.hero.workspace.directoryFlow` / `sidebar.workspaces.directoryFlow` 槽位，并注册设置页 | | 核心 | `lib/core.js` | 配置读写、目录校验、拉起对话框子进程 | | Worker | `lib/dialog-worker.cjs` | 一次性 Node 子进程，用 koffi 直接调 Win32 COM | 弹框链路：客户端槽位 `open` → `POST /pick` → `core.pickDirectory()` 拉起 worker → `CoCreateInstance(FileOpenDialog)` → `SHCreateItemFromParsingName` 造 `IShellItem` → `IFileDialog::SetFolder`（vtable 第 12 槽）→ `Show()`。失败时客户端回退到桌面端内置的 `__DSH_DIRECTORY_PICKER__`。

从点击「新建工作区」到原生选择框打开（示意图）

koffi 3.1.1 已随仓库放在 `vendor/`，安装时不需要联网。 ## 排错 诊断日志：`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\workspace-directory.log` | 日志 | 含义 | | --- | --- | | `host-routes-registered /dsh-directory-plugin` | 宿主侧已加载、HTTP 路由就绪 | | `pick D:\Projects\demo initial={"applied":true,...}` | 选择框确实以配置目录为起点 | | `pick (cancelled) ...` | 用户取消了 | | `pick-failed ...` | 对话框进程出错，界面会回退到系统默认行为 | 判断是否生效： 1. 重启后日志出现 `host-routes-registered` → 宿主侧已起来； 2. 新建工作区时日志新增 `pick ... initial={"applied":true}` → 走的是本插件的对话框； 3. 若日志没有新增 `pick` 行、弹出的还是旧对话框，说明浏览器侧接管没生效：功能退化为 DSH 原生行为，不会报错。请附上日志和现象提 issue。 ## 兼容性 - Windows 10 / 11，x64（`vendor` 内置的是 win32-x64 的 koffi 二进制）。 - 依赖 DSH 桌面端（Next 内核）的槽位与客户端插件加载机制；如果未来版本移除或重命名这些 槽位，插件会静默回退，不影响 DSH 本身。 - 插件不会改动 DSH 安装目录里的任何文件。 ## 卸载 ```powershell $env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE = '1' $env:DSH_HOME = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh" & $DSH_EXE --expose-internals $CLI desktop remove dsh-directory-plugin ``` 然后重启 DSH。配置文件与日志会留在 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh` 下，可手动删除。 ## 目录结构 ``` package.json 插件清单（宿主入口 + 浏览器入口 + cordis 层） cordis.patch.yml 往组合里插入本插件的那一行 lib/index.js 宿主插件：HTTP 路由 lib/core.js 配置读写 + 拉起对话框子进程 lib/dialog-worker.cjs Win32 文件夹对话框 worker（支持起始目录） client/client.js 浏览器 bundle：接管目录流程 + 设置页 vendor/ 随包携带的 koffi 3.1.1 docs/images/ README 示意图（overview / settings / how-it-works） LICENSE MIT ``` ## English **Directory Plugin** (`dsh-directory-plugin`) is a plugin for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app on Windows. It replaces the folder chooser used by *New Workspace* with a native dialog that opens at a directory you configure (DSH's built-in picker always starts at the system default). It adds a settings page, falls back silently to the stock picker when anything goes wrong, and ships koffi so no network install is needed. ## License [MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 milu7

plugins.description: 在 DSH Web UI 的会话「…」菜单中增加红色“删除会话”，二次确认后从磁盘删除会话记录。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-remove-session

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.x-4B6BFF)
![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Web%20UI-2ea44f)

**给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的会话「…」菜单加一项红色“删除会话”：二次确认后，会话从侧栏和磁盘上真正消失。**

> 能力分类：**会话与消息** · 许可证：**MIT** · 无外部服务 · 不收集遥测

---

## 一句话价值

安装后，你可以像删除聊天记录一样删除不再需要的 DSH 会话：不用再让无用的会话日志一直堆在 `$DSH_HOME/sessions` 里，也不用为了“眼不见”而先归档再翻筛选器。

---

## 安装

### 方式一：npm（推荐）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-remove-session
```

- `--profile web` 是插件市场模板里的示例 profile 名，请换成你实际使用的 profile（例如本机是 `desktop`）。
- 已发布到 npm，因此 DSH 内置的「插件中心」可以直接搜索并一键安装。
- 安装完成后刷新一次 DSH Web 页面，侧栏会话的「…」菜单末尾就会出现红色“删除会话”。

### 方式二：源码安装（GitHub）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:NN-0101/dsh-remove-session
```

本插件没有构建步骤，GitHub 上的源码可以直接安装；适合想跟最新提交或自己二次开发的情况。

### 方式三：本地目录

打开 **设置 → 插件**，选择安装本地 bundle，指向本仓库目录（或已解压的目录）即可；加载器会读取 `cordis.patch.yml` 并挂载插件。

---

## 使用

1. 在侧栏把鼠标移到任意会话行，点击右侧的「…」。
2. 菜单最后一项是红色的 **删除会话**（在“复制 Session ID”之后）。
3. 点击后弹出确认框，标题是“删除这个会话？”，正文会显示会话标题，并说明聊天记录会从磁盘移除、无法恢复。
4. 点 **删除**：会话从侧栏消失，磁盘上的会话目录、Workspace 归属、置顶/归档记录一并清理。
5. 点 **取消**、按 `Esc` 或点击遮罩：不做任何修改。

菜单和弹窗均支持中文与英文界面。

---

## 效果演示

菜单（新增项在最后，红色显示）：

```text
┌─────────────────────────────┐
│ 置顶会话                     │
│ 重命名                       │
│ 分叉会话                     │
│ 归档会话                     │
│ 复制 Session ID              │
│ ──────────────────────────  │
│ 🗑 删除会话                  │  ← 红色
└─────────────────────────────┘
```

确认框：

```text
删除这个会话？
“帮我优化一下聊天”将被永久删除，聊天记录会从磁盘移除，且无法恢复。
                                          [取消]  [删除]
```

> 仓库暂未附带界面截图。上面的菜单/弹窗文字来自实际实现；下面的“验证”一节给出了真实的接口输出。欢迎通过 PR 补充截图。

---

## 功能

- **红色删除入口**：注册在 `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` 槽位，`order: 500`，排在官方“复制 Session ID”（450）之后，默认是菜单最后一行。
- **二次确认**：自定义弹窗，红色危险按钮；确认前不会执行任何删除。
- **真正的删除**：删除该会话独占的 JSONL 日志目录（`$DSH_HOME/sessions/--<项目>--/<会话ID>/`），并从 Workspace registry 中移除它的归属、置顶和归档记录。
- **即时反馈**：删除成功后客户端会话列表立刻移除该行；侧栏不会残留“幽灵会话”。
- **打开会话时先切走**：如果删除的是主视图正在显示的会话，客户端先切到一个新会话，再执行删除，避免停留在已删除的对话上。
- **安全拒绝**：正在运行的回合、进行中的子智能体/后台任务/定时提醒、尚未落盘的空白新会话，都会被拒绝并给出提示。
- **中英双语**：`locale/zh.json`、`locale/en.json` 以及客户端内嵌字典。
- **图标可替换**：插件卡片使用 `icon.svg`；菜单行的删除图标取自同一份图标（以 data URL 内嵌在 `client.js`，按行内文字颜色着色），替换后运行 `npm run sync-icon` 即可同步。

---

## 安全与权限

| 项目 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 读取/写入范围 | `$DSH_HOME/sessions` 下该会话自己的目录；Workspace registry 中该会话的归属、置顶、归档记录 |
| 网络 | 不访问任何外部服务；只注册两个同源本地 HTTP 接口 |
| 遥测 | 无 |
| 删除范围 | 仅该会话目录；**不会**删除附件、其他会话、Workspace 目录本身 |
| 请求校验 | `Origin` 与 `Host` 对比的同源校验；删除只接受 `POST` + JSON |
| 运行中保护 | Agent 回合仍在运行、或 `workspace/session-activity` 报告有工作时，返回错误且不写盘 |
| 不可恢复 | 删除是永久的，没有回收站；需要保留请使用“归档会话” |

> 本插件会执行**不可恢复的删除**，请只用它清理确定不需要的会话。

---

## 兼容性

| 项目 | 要求 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | 已在 `0.2.1-rc.2` 上实测；依赖 `webServer`、`sessionPersistence`、`sessions`、`agents`、`workspaceRegistry`，同代 0.2.x 预期可用 |
| Profile | 带 Web UI 的 profile（`web` / `desktop`），需要 `workspace` 与 `ui-workspace` 已挂载 |
| 平台 | 实测 Windows；实现只使用 Node 文件 API 与同源 HTTP，macOS / Linux 设计上同样适用 |
| Node | `^22.15.0 || >=24.0.0` |
| 安装形态 | 源码安装（GitHub）或本地目录；无构建步骤 |

---

## 工作原理

| 半边 | 职责 |
| --- | --- |
| Host（`index.js`、`host/session-files.js`） | 注册同源接口 `POST /plugin/dsh-remove-session/delete`；校验会话状态与进行中的工作；flush 待写事件；删除 JSONL 会话目录；从 Workspace registry 摘除归属/置顶/归档；发出 `api-session/removed` |
| Client（`client.js`） | 在 `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` 注册红色菜单行，在 `shell.overlay` 注册确认弹窗；确认后调用 Host 接口，并从客户端会话列表移除该行 |

删除动作必须由 Host 完成：DSH 的 JSONL 持久化后端没有删除 API，会话日志以目录形式存放在 `$DSH_HOME/sessions` 下，因此插件直接删除该会话独占的目录，不触碰共享存储。

### 目录定位

```
$DSH_HOME/sessions/
  --<规范化后的项目路径>--/
    <转义后的会话 ID>/          # 该会话独占，整个目录被删除
      session.v4.jsonl.zstd
```

插件使用与后端相同的 id 路径转义（单射），在每个项目目录下探测该目录，因此不依赖会话启动时的工作目录是否仍然存在。

---

## 诊断接口

只读、同源：

```http
GET /plugin/dsh-remove-session/inspect?sessionId=<会话ID>
```

返回该会话是否 live、磁盘目录、是否置顶/归档、归属的 Workspace。用于排查“为什么删不掉”。

---

## 验证

Host 接口的真实输出（路径与 ID 已脱敏）：

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "version": "0.1.2",
  "root": "C:\\Users\\<user>\\.dsh\\sessions",
  "liveSessionIds": ["session-<id>"],
  "session": {
    "id": "session-<id>",
    "live": true,
    "directories": ["C:\\Users\\<user>\\.dsh\\sessions\\--C-0101-developer-project-DSH--\\session-<id>"],
    "archived": false,
    "pinned": false,
    "workspaces": ["<workspace-id>"]
  }
}
```

已实测：

- 不存在的会话 → `{ "ok": true }`（幂等，便于重试）；
- 正在运行的会话 → `{ "ok": false, "error": { "code": "session-running" } }`，且会话目录保持完好；
- 跨源请求 → `403`；非 `POST` → `405`；
- 临时目录单测：只删除目标会话目录，兄弟会话目录保留。

---

## 已知限制

- **不级联删除子会话**：subagent 会话仍保留在磁盘上（它们默认不出现在侧栏）。
- **投影缓存可能残留**：`$DSH_HOME/storages` 中该会话的检查点文档不会被清理；它按会话 id 读取，删除后不会被展示，也不会让会话“复活”。
- **替换图标需要同步**：`icon.svg` 是插件卡片图标；菜单行使用由它生成的 `client.js` 内嵌副本，修改图标后需运行 `npm run sync-icon`，否则菜单行仍是旧图标。
- **空白新会话不能删**：尚未落盘、仅存在于内存的“新会话”没有文件可删，插件会拒绝而不是假装成功。
- **极端情况下的重影**：如果会话仍被后台标签页持有，删除后本页刷新前它可能仍出现在内存中的列表里；重新加载页面即彻底消失。
- **删除不可恢复**：没有回收站。

---

## 卸载

在 DSH 的插件管理里停用或移除本 bundle 即可。卸载只移除入口，**不会恢复已删除的会话**。

---

## 开发

```bash
# 语法与模块检查
node --check index.js
node --check client.js
node --check host/session-files.js
node --input-type=module -e "const m = await import('./index.js'); console.log(typeof m.apply)"

# 替换 icon.svg 后，把图标同步到客户端菜单行
npm run sync-icon

# 本地安装（把路径换成你的仓库目录）
dsh plugin --profile web add C:/path/to/dsh-remove-session
```

目录：

```text
index.js                 Host 半边：HTTP 接口、删除编排、Workspace 清理
host/session-files.js    会话目录定位、ID 转义、递归删除
client.js                Client 半边：菜单行、确认弹窗、列表更新
scripts/sync-icon.mjs    把 icon.svg 同步成 client.js 里的内嵌图标
cordis.patch.yml         bundle 配置层
locale/{zh,en}.json      Plugin Manager 元数据与文案
icon.svg                 插件图标
```

需要 Node 22.15+ 或 24+；无第三方运行时依赖。

---

## 收录徽章

插件被 [dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/zh) 收录后，可把下面的徽章放到 README 顶部（若详情页 slug 不同，替换链接中的 `NN-0101/dsh-remove-session`）：

```markdown
[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/NN-0101/dsh-remove-session)
```

---

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 0101

---

## English

**dsh-remove-session** adds a red **Delete session** action to every Session's “...” menu in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. After a second confirmation, it permanently removes the Session's JSONL log directory under `$DSH_HOME/sessions`, plus its Workspace membership, pin and archive entries; the sidebar row disappears immediately.

**Install (npm, recommended):**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-remove-session
```

**Install (source):**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:NN-0101/dsh-remove-session
```

Replace `web` with your profile name (for example `desktop`), then refresh the page. The npm package is also listed in the in-app Plugin Center, so it can be installed in one click from there.

**Safety:** running sessions, sessions with active subagents/jobs/reminders, and unsaved blank sessions are refused. Only the session's own directory is removed; attachments and other sessions are untouched. Deletion is permanent — use Archive if you may need the conversation later.

Requires DSH 0.2.x (tested on 0.2.1-rc.2) with the Web UI; Node `^22.15.0 || >=24.0.0`. MIT licensed.

plugins.description: Cross-session message bus for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): the main conversation and GUI sub-conversations send instructions and reports to each other directly. Zero-dependency host plugin.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-handoff-bus

**English** | [中文](README.zh.md)

A small host plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/harness/) (DSH): it lets the main conversation and the sub-conversations you open yourself send instructions and reports to each other directly, so you no longer have to switch windows and relay messages.

## What it does

- ✅ Main → line: `bus_send(target="rgb", kind="指令", done="…", ...)` — write only the line name and it lands on whichever conversation under that line is alive
- ✅ Line → main: `bus_send(target="main", kind="回报", ...)`
- ✅ Three levels: `main` / line `rgb` / temporary conversations `rgb.1`, `rgb.2`; replacing a conversation never changes what the main conversation writes
- ✅ Scoped by session cwd: each workspace gets its own independent bus
- ✅ Remembers three things for you: a start-up briefing in every new conversation, a context-watermark notice at 40%, and a refusal to unregister without writing the ledger

## What it does not do

- ❌ **It does not create conversations.** You open them in the GUI; the plugin only registers and routes.
- ❌ **It does not close conversations.** It gives you the signal (`suggestHandoff`); closing is your call.
- ❌ **It does not compress context.** Compaction is triggered by the host; the plugin can neither read the water level nor change the threshold.
- ❌ No file watching, no polling, no autonomous work when you are away
- ❌ It does not replace your state files: task files and reports are still written by the conversations; the bus only delivers pointers and wakes the target
- ❌ No cross-workspace addressing (one bus per workspace)
- ❌ No addressing of subagent sessions: only a **top-level GUI conversation** can be a target. A session running as a subagent under another agent is owned by the host router; registering it from inside does not make it reachable, and `bus_send` answers `target_unresolvable`

## How it works

```
you ──open the main conversation──▶ main (bus_register role="main")
                                     │
                                     │ 1. write task files / instruction files
                                     │ 2. bus_send(target="rgb", kind="指令", done="…", message="…")
                                     ▼
                                  rgb line ──▶ rgb.1 (bus_register parent="rgb")  ← woken
                                     │ 3. do the work, write the report file
                                     │ 4. bus_send(target="main", kind="回报", ref="R-…")
                                     ▼
                                  main (woken once per few reports)
                                     │ 5. this task is done: unregister rgb.1, open rgb.2 for the next one
                                     ▼
                                  rgb.2 (bus_register parent="rgb" replaces="rgb.1")
```

Keep the bus message short: summary + file pointers. The authoritative content stays in your files.

## Requirements

- A DSH **web/desktop** profile with the Host session controller and session store. Headless/SDK-only profiles may not provide them; the plugin then stays inactive (it declares `inject`).
- Tested on DSH `0.2.0-rc.x` (desktop, Windows). Host services such as `sessionController.resolveAgent`, `agent.followup/inject`, `sessions.flush`, `session.header.cwd`, the `agent/created` event and the `agent/pre-step` hook are internal APIs, not a public contract; a future DSH release may require a patch. If the hook throws, the plugin degrades to "no advisory" and the turn proceeds untouched.
- No npm dependencies. The plugin imports only Node builtins.
- Tool result messages and relayed message bodies are in Chinese; error codes are stable English identifiers. Role names are lowercase ASCII with dots (`main`, `rgb`, `rgb.1`).
- **No context-length reading**: the plugin does not touch the host's projection API, so `bus_list` reports bus activity (message count, idle minutes), not token water level. Use dsh-context's `/context` for the real number.
- **No session creation or closing**: both are GUI-only actions.

## Install

### From npm (recommended, once published)

1. DSH sidebar → **Plugins** → **Add plugin** → search for `dsh-handoff-bus`
2. Install, then **Enable**
3. **Fully quit the client (including the tray) and reopen it** — this is a host plugin

Or:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-handoff-bus
```

> The CLI command targets a CLI-booted profile. In the desktop app the profile is managed by the app itself, so install through the Plugins page there.

### From source

1. Clone this repository.
2. Plugins page → **Add plugin** → enter the **absolute path of the repository directory**.
3. Enable, then fully quit and reopen the client.

> A linked plugin lives outside the profile's `node_modules` tree and therefore cannot resolve `@deepseek-ai/*`. This package intentionally imports only Node builtins, so both install methods work.

## Quick start

1. Main conversation: `bus_register(role="main")`
2. Each sub-conversation: `bus_register(parent="rgb")` → gets `rgb.1`
3. `bus_list` shows the role tree and where each line would route
4. Main → line: `bus_send(target="rgb", kind="指令", done="…", message="…")`
5. Line → main: `bus_send(target="main", kind="回报", ref="R-001", message="…")`

Role names are lowercase letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens, at most three levels (`main` / `rgb` / `rgb.1` / `rgb.1.worker`).

`ref` is passed through verbatim — nothing validates its format. The convention in the examples is `D-` for instructions and `R-` for reports (`Q-` for status requests), numbered per project. Pick one scheme and keep it consistent; it only lands in the message header, so the receiving conversation is what gives it meaning.

| Situation | Call |
|---|---|
| Main gives work to a line | `bus_send(target="rgb", kind="指令", done="pytest tests/test_rgb.py passes", message="…")` |
| Sub reports back | `bus_send(target="main", kind="回报", ref="R-…", message="…")` |
| Stuck, main must act now | same, plus `urgent: true` |
| Main asks for status (no work) | `bus_send(target="rgb", kind="请求", ref="Q-…", message="Status only, do not start work.")` |
| Queue without waking | add `wake: false` |

## Three-level roles

| Level | Examples | Who maintains it | Rotate? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 main | `main` | Registered once by you in the main conversation | No. There is exactly one per bus |
| 2 line | `rgb`, `world`, `scene`, `reward` | Appears automatically as a *virtual node* the first time a child registers under it | **No.** It is only a name; no session is attached |
| 3 temporary conversation | `rgb.1`, `rgb.2` | Numbered by the plugin when a new conversation registers | **Yes**: one task per conversation, unregister when done, open a new one next time |

### Registering

```
bus_register(parent="rgb")                        → role: "rgb.1"
bus_register(parent="rgb", note="calibration")    → role: "rgb.2"
bus_register(role="main")                         → the main line
bus_register(role="rgb")                          → one conversation owns the line itself (optional)
```

All you say in each new sub-conversation:

> Take work on the rgb line: call `bus_register(parent="rgb")` first, then read `handoff/rgb/STATE.md`.

### How a target is resolved

1. `target="rgb.2"` → that exact conversation, no guessing.
2. `target="rgb"` → inside the `rgb` subtree, sorted by most recent traffic, each candidate is opened in turn and **the first one that opens wins** (at most `routeMaxAttempts`, default 3).
3. None opens → `no_live_session`, with the hint to open a fresh conversation and `bus_register(parent="rgb")`.

The result carries `routedFrom` / `routedTo`, so nothing is a black box. `bus_list.routeTo` tells you where it would land before you send.

> **Keep one live conversation per line.** Most-recently-active is not "best suited": if `rgb.2` is busy with task A and you send B to `rgb`, it lands on `rgb.2` behind A. Unregister the old conversation when its task is done, then open a new one — then `target="rgb"` is never ambiguous.

### Handing a line over

```
bus_register(parent="rgb", replaces="rgb.1")
```

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-btw-live

DeepSeek Harness の `/btw`。**いま動いているターンも含めて**セッションに横から質問でき、答えは会話履歴にもモデルのコンテキストにも残りません。

## 特徴

- 実行中のターンのツールコールと結果も読む（`session.snapshotEvents()`）。フォーク型のサイド質問と違い、ターンを止めずに「いまの状態」を聞ける
- 1回きりの LLM 呼び出し。ツールは実行せず、履歴にも書き込まない
- 答えはトランスクリプト内の「BTW カード」で表示。Markdown、長い回答はカード内スクロール、ヘッダクリックで折りたたみ
- 回答待ちの間は「考えています…」、失敗は赤字。回答が届くと自動で開く

## 必要なもの

| | |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek Harness | 0.2.1-rc.2 で確認（`conversation.chat.commandview` スロットを使う） |
| Node.js | 22 以上 |

## インストール

```bash
cd "${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/profiles/web"
pnpm add link:/path/to/dsh-btw-live
```

`package.json` の `dsh.profile.bundles` に追加:

```json
"bundles": [
  "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
  "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app",
  "@local/btw-live"
]
```

`dsh web` を再起動してページを再読み込み。クライアント側は起動時にしかスキャンされないので、初回は再起動が必要です（2回目以降の `client.js` 編集は HMR が拾います）。

## 使い方

```
/btw いまどこまで進んだ？
```

## 設定

`cordis.patch.yml` の `config`（既定値）:

| キー | 既定 | 意味 |
|---|---:|---|
| `maxEvents` | 80 | 読むイベント数（末尾から） |
| `maxChars` | 16000 | トランスクリプト文字数の上限 |
| `toolArgChars` | 300 | ツール引数の表示文字数 |
| `toolResultChars` | 900 | ツール結果の表示文字数 |
| `maxTokens` | 4096 | 回答の最大トークン |
| `timeoutMs` | 120000 | 1回の呼び出しのタイムアウト |

## 仕組み

- `index.js`（ホスト側）— `commands` に `btw` を登録する。セッションログからトランスクリプトを組み、`llm` で1回だけストリームする。答えは `command/done` の `text` として返る
- `client.js`（ブラウザ側）— `conversation.chat.commandview` の `btw` キーだけを差し替える。他のコマンドは汎用の行のまま。`locale` で ja / en / zh の辞書を持つ

## ライセンス

[MIT](<LICENSE>)

plugins.description: 运行中按一下只停当前回合，再按一下锁住注入闸门：后台任务、子代理汇报、定时提醒全部扣住，直到你发消息时一起送进模型。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-composer-hold

**发送键与停止键分开**，并且给"绝对停止"配一道**注入闸门**：你按下绝对停止之后，
后台任务完成、子代理汇报、定时提醒、webhook、目标续轮、hooks 注入——**全部被扣住**，
直到你发出下一条消息，它们与那条消息**在同一次请求里**送进模型。

## 按键的五个面

| 状态 | 图标 | 何时出现 | 点它 | 此时 Enter |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 执行中 | 蓝 ‖ | 主回合在跑 | 软停：只中止当前回合（＝原来的停止键） | 走系统的繁忙提交策略 |
| 软暂停 | 蓝 ▶ | 你按过 ‖ 之后 | 进入绝对停止（锁定） | 走系统默认提交（本机是插话模式） |
| 绝对停止 | 灰蓝 ■（不可点） | 锁定中，且还有子代理/后台任务在跑 | 无动作 | — |
| 锁定＋有草稿 | 蓝 ↑ | 在 ■ 状态下打字 | 发送：本条 + 期间扣住的全部注入一次进模型 | 同左 |
| 静止 | 灰 ↑（不可点） | 空闲、无草稿、**且没有子代理/后台任务在跑** | 无动作 | 发送（有字时） |

- **▶ 是"模式"**：软暂停期间，注入仍可把模型唤醒继续执行，图标保持 ▶；你发消息（或回合重新开始）才回 ‖。
- **■ 没有点击出口**：唯一出路是打字（例如输入"继续"）再回车。
- **尘埃落定**只看子代理 + 后台任务（该会话 `/state` 里 `running` 的 job 行数为 0）。
- 右上角**橙色数字**＝此刻被扣住的注入条数。

## 它怎么工作

**宿主半**（`index.js`）——唤醒投递只有一个收口：`Agent.send(message, target, wakeup)`。
`followup()` / `steer()` / `inject()` 全部转发到它，所有外部生产者都经由它，所以插件只
需要在 agent 实例上覆盖一个 `send`：

- 锁定期间、`source.kind !== 'user'`、且 `wakeup === true` → 降级为 `('next-step', false)`：
  **消息留在收件箱，驱动不会被唤醒**。
- `source.kind === 'user'` → 解锁并**原样投递**（唤醒），于是驱动的第一步在**同一次请求**里
  claim 掉整批 `next-step` 加上你这条 `next-turn`。

**浏览器半**（`client.js`）——在 `conversation.input.right` 槽位渲染自己的键，并用产品图标的
几何特征（上升箭头 `path` / 停止方块 `rect 3,3,10,10`）把产品那颗发送键移出布局；
点击**委托**给那颗隐藏的键，所以发送/排队/插话/附件/斜杠命令全部沿用产品实现。
**回车路径完全不受影响**——这也是安全垫：按键坏了，回车照样能发。

子代理会话（`subagent !== null`）**不接管**，保留产品自己的独立停止键。

## 状态存哪

`locked` 是**宿主进程内**状态（`globalThis[Symbol.for('dsh-composer-hold.state')]`，故意不放
实例闭包：热重载会分叉），通过两个端点与浏览器同步：

```
GET  /plugin/dsh-composer-hold/state?sessionId=…   → { locked, parked, running, diagnostics }
POST /plugin/dsh-composer-hold/mode  { sessionId, mode: "lock" | "unlock" }
```

刻意不写进会话日志：外部插件**无法**写自定义持久事件——`Session.append()` 不接受 envelope 的
`ignorable` 标记，而未知的必需事件类型会让持久化读取**拒绝重建整个会话**。所以宿主重启后锁定不保留。

## 安装

作为**正经 bundle** 装进 profile（这样插件页才会列出它，并带开关）：

```jsonc
// profiles/<name>/package.json
{
  "dependencies": { "dsh-composer-hold": "link:D:/…/dsh-composer-hold" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ /* … */ "dsh-composer-hold" ] } }
}
```

**不要再在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里手插同一行**：bundle 自带的
`cordis.patch.yml` 已经插入行 id `composer-hold`，两行同 id 会让 id 定向补丁（插件页开关）
只命中其中一个。

## 已实测（2026-10-16，3080 实例）

| 项 | 证据 |
|---|---|
| 锁定期间定时提醒被扣住 | 宿主日志 `hold … <- schedule\|… (next-turn -> next-step, no wake)` |
| 用户消息放行 | 日志 `release … <- user\|…`；`parked` 归零并开新回合 |
| 连续两条注入都被扣住 | 自测：`schedule` followup 与 `plugin` steer 后 `parked` = 2，agent 仍 idle |
| 与用户消息同批放行 | 上一条实测：提醒文本与用户消息出现在同一次请求里 |

判定闸门是否生效，只看两件事：**锁定时 `parked` 有没有涨** + **模型有没有在用户没说话时自己开新回合**。

## 已知边界

- 产品那颗键是靠 **SVG 几何指纹**识别的。产品换图标/结构时的症状是"冒出两颗键"——可见、好修，不会静默失效。
- 锁定**不跨宿主重启**（见上）。
- 锁定会对该会话执行 `agent.cancel({kind:'user'},{keepInbox:true})`，等同于一次停止；
  **不要对正在跑重要任务的会话上锁**。
- 其他停止入口（Esc 等）不经过本键，因此不会进入 ▶ 模式（当前行为，未接）。

plugins.description: A portable memory protocol for AI agents — load it as standing rules; a curation discipline + reference spec + optional cap hook.
plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# Engramory

[![CI](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

**An opinionated, zero-infrastructure memory *protocol* for small-scale, local,
file-based agent memory** — a strict curation discipline plus a validator
(`tools/engramory_doctor.py`), loaded as **standing rules** (`CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` / your host's rules file). It is not a database, a framework, or a
relevance-loaded skill. Memory is a folder of small, human-readable markdown files
plus one always-loaded index. No database, no embeddings, no server — just
plain-text files you can open, read, edit, and diff in any editor (the live store
itself stays git-ignored).

> *Engramory* — coined from *engram* (the physical trace a memory leaves in the
> brain) + *memory*. Here: one file = one fact.

> ⚠️ **Unrelated projects share this name.** *engram + memory* is an obvious
> coinage and at least one other repository arrived at it independently. This
> project is only ever `tinqiao-oss/engramory` (npm: `dsh-engramory`); a same-named
> repo under a different owner is not a fork, a mirror, or a newer version of it.

> 🤖 **Are you an AI agent, asked to install or check this?** Start at
> **[AGENT-SETUP.md](AGENT-SETUP.md)**, not at the install steps below. It is the
> procedure for working out what your host can actually enforce, whether a store
> already exists, what you must not touch, and what to tell the user — the parts
> agents reliably get wrong when improvising.

> **Status: 0.12.1 — experimental.** The hard index cap (a `PreToolUse` hook) is
> deterministic for the matched direct-edit tools (`Edit | Write | MultiEdit`) but
> NOT a global write guard (shell tools — Bash, PowerShell, a background Monitor
> command — plus MCP file tools, external editors, and sync clients bypass it);
> the discipline loads as standing rules the model follows, so it's
> best-effort, not guaranteed on every task (see [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) §8). Assumes a
> single writer / serialized writes. Don't rely on it as a "mandatory, reliable,
> cross-agent" memory layer yet.

---

## What this is — and is NOT

Engramory is **not a new memory architecture**. The "markdown files + a small index
loaded into context + the model curates it" pattern is now the mainstream shape
for agent memory, and it ships in several places already. Engramory stands on:

- **Claude Code native auto-memory** — the same markdown-`MEMORY.md`-index +
  lazy detail-file pattern; its system prompt even uses the same
  `user | feedback | project | reference` type vocabulary (per
  [anthropics/claude-code#58840](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/58840);
  the *public docs* describe only the index + topic files). Engramory is a
  disciplined superset of this default.
- **[basic-memory](https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory)** — markdown
  source-of-truth, YAML frontmatter `type`, `[[wikilink]]` graph, local-first.
- **[obsidian-second-brain](https://github.com/eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain)**,
  **[claude-memory-compiler](https://github.com/coleam00/claude-memory-compiler)**
  ("a loaded index beats vector search at personal scale"), and the broader family
  of markdown-memory skills.

What Engramory contributes is the **opinionated bundle + the discipline**, not the
primitives. Do not claim novelty on markdown, frontmatter, wikilinks, a loaded
index, one-file-per-fact notes, or curation hygiene — all are prior art.

## What's actually differentiated

1. **A role/purpose ontology, headed by `feedback` = procedural memory.** The
   semantic / episodic / **procedural** split is established prior art — the CoALA
   taxonomy, and a named procedural type in LangMem and mem0 — so Engramory does not
   claim the category. What it does is make procedural `feedback` the *spine* of a
   deliberately tiny, hand-authored, human-readable set, with required **Why:** /
   **How to apply:** lines, instead of auto-extracting it into a vector/graph store.
   The contribution is the packaging and discipline, not the ontology.

2. **The curation contract as concrete behaviour** the protocol applies (model-followed, not a hard gate): dedup-before-write,
   update-don't-duplicate, delete-when-wrong, and a negative-scope rule ("don't
   store what git/CLAUDE.md/the code already records"). Surveys consistently name
   *modify/delete/forget* as the most under-implemented memory operation — Engramory
   makes it the spine.

3. **A bounded index designed not to silently rot.** The index loads every session and
   Claude Code reads the first 200 lines / 25 KB (documented behavior), so an unbounded index silently
   drops memories off the end. Engramory warns at 150 lines / 20 KB, compacts-or-asks
   before 200 / 25 KB, and ships a hard `PreToolUse` hook backstop (it blocks only
   *growth* past the cap — shrinking/compaction edits always pass). Both the line and
   byte caps apply — whichever is hit first triggers (an index can be under the line
   count yet over on bytes when the lines run long).

   Claude Code has since followed up on this natively: v2.1.186 (released
   2026-06-22) reminds the agent to compact the index when it nears the cap, and
   v2.1.210 (released 2026-07-14) turned an over-cap write into an explicit error
   instead of a silent truncation. Both are after-the-fact alerts, though — the
   write still lands, and entries past the cap stay invisible until someone
   compacts. Engramory's hook denies the write *before* it happens, so a write
   through the matched edit tools never leaves the index over-cap in the first
   place (writes outside them — a shell, an MCP file tool — are not gated; see the
   status note above and SKILL.md §8). The native alerts validate the direction
   and make a welcome second layer — and older versions and other hosts still
   have neither.

## How it compares

| | storage | recall | human-readable | typed ontology | curation discipline | bounded index | infra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Engramory** | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ role-based (4) | ✅ contract (model-run) | ✅ 150/200 + hook | none |
| CC auto-memory | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ same 4 types | partial (auto) | ~200-line window* | none (built-in) |
| basic-memory | md + SQLite | semantic/FTS search | ✅ | ✅ freeform type | schema + overwrite checks | ❌ (no loaded index) | SQLite + embeddings |
| obsidian-second-brain | md vault | index-first + search | ✅ | folder-typed | ✅ reconcile/lint | partial | none |
| mem0 / Zep | vector/graph DB | semantic | ❌ (DB) | typed (prefs/episodic/proc.; Zep custom) | auto-extract | n/a | DB + embeddings |
| [agentmemory](https://github.com/rohitg00/agentmemory) | SQLite + vector index (+opt. graph) | hybrid BM25+vector (+opt. graph), RRF | ❌ (DB/engine) | ✅ 4-tier lifecycle (work./epis./sem./proc.) | auto (capture + dedup + decay) | n/a | iii engine (local) + opt. embeddings |

Engramory's lane: **minimalism + actionable role typing + curation discipline, zero
infra.** It does *not* try to out-search basic-memory, out-scale mem0, or
out-capture agentmemory — those solve a different problem (auto-capture /
auto-ingest at volume) at a different cost point. agentmemory is the closest
heavyweight foil: also local-first, but it bets on automatic capture (lifecycle
hooks) + hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vectors + optional graph) on a SQLite/`iii`
engine, where Engramory bets on hand-curation + a tiny always-loaded index and
ships no engine at all.

\* Claude Code's [memory docs](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/memory)
document this exactly: *"the first 200 lines of `MEMORY.md`, or the first 25KB,
whichever comes first, are loaded at the start of every conversation."* Other hosts
vary, so the window stays configurable via the hook's env vars.

## Where it fits — and the goal

Engramory is a **portable memory *discipline*, not a

plugins.description: Runtime evidence that helps agents trace, profile, and burn down hotspots in application and native code, GPU kernels, and inference stacks.
plugins.readme_text:
flameox

Bounded local runtime evidence for coding agents.

Flameox coordinates profilers, benchmark tools, trace processors, and direct local targets. It turns an explicit artifact or command into bounded evidence while keeping durable preservation optional. The agent chooses hypotheses and experiments; Flameox records observed inputs, execution provenance, typed evidence, coverage, and limitations. There is no workspace to initialize or project configuration to maintain. Pass exact artifact paths to analysis and an explicit argv plus absolute working directory to capture. Flameox does not search parent directories, edit project files, or provide a hosted service. ## Quick start Configure an MCP client with the global setup command: ```console npx flameox@latest setup ``` Setup detects supported clients and asks which configurations to update. For automation, select clients explicitly, for example `--client codex --yes` or `--all --yes`; `--dry-run` reports the paths and actions without writing. Setup preserves unrelated client configuration and does not change project files. See [the npm package guide](npm/README.md) for details. Update existing MCP registrations with: ```console npx flameox@latest update ``` `update --check` reports available updates without changing configuration. Updates preserve each client's provider extras and settings, verify the new environment before changing release pins, and report which clients need a restart or reconnect. Use `--client codex` to select one client, or `--version 0.2.8` to select a specific release, including for rollback. The Python CLI exposes the same `flameox update` command. For direct CLI use, pass exact artifact paths or an explicit command: ```console uvx flameox analyze preview_artifact /absolute/path/to/artifact.json uvx flameox capture --provider direct --cwd "$PWD" -- python benchmark.py ``` To launch the stdio MCP server manually: ```console uvx flameox mcp serve ``` For local development, clone the repository, install its development dependencies, and inspect the available tools: ```console git clone https://github.com/morluto/flameox.git cd flameox uv sync --extra dev --extra memory --extra trace --extra cpu uv run flameox mcp inspect ``` ## Evidence and storage Analysis and unpreserved capture use bounded session scratch. Session `analysis_id` values expire when evicted or when the server stops. Explicit preservation creates the user-level Flameox data directory and stores native bytes and a canonical evidence bundle by SHA-256. Set `FLAMEOX_DATA_DIR` to choose another location. Preservation is optional; it does not imply full console-output retention. Flameox distinguishes observed, derived, and inferred claims. Profiles guide exploration but do not establish causality or performance improvement. Confirmatory claims require representative workloads, declared metrics and estimands, compatible identities, preserved samples, and a semantic oracle. ## MCP The MCP server has no workspace binding. It exposes named analysis and capture tools through the same operation registry as the CLI. Analysis tools accept explicit sources; capture tools accept a typed target and provider. Tool schemas expose operation-specific fields directly. Inspect the catalog with `flameox mcp inspect`; use `--tool TOOL_NAME` for focused schemas and examples. The complete contract and current tool catalog are in [the interface guide](docs/interfaces.md). Tools return their full bounded results inline, including failures and recovery actions. Preserved evidence has a durable `evidence_id`; `inspect_evidence` returns its redacted metadata and replay sources inline. Capture takes argv, not a shell string. A direct target supplies an absolute working directory and bounded environment overrides. Results may include `next_page`; replay its named analysis tool and arguments unchanged. Capture continuations read collected artifacts and do not rerun the target. MCP work belongs to the live request, so cancellation applies directly and no detached job survives a restart. ## Documentation - [Architecture](docs/architecture.md) describes process and package boundaries. - [Storage and evidence](docs/storage-and-evidence.md) defines preservation and provenance. - [Investigations](docs/investigations.md) covers experiments, comparison, and evidence quality. - [Adapters](docs/adapters.md) documents provider compatibility and integration policy. - [Runtime safety](docs/runtime-safety.md) covers limits, recovery, integrity, and privacy. - [Interfaces](docs/interfaces.md) defines CLI and MCP contracts. - [Testing](docs/testing.md) describes test selections and known proof gaps. ## Development Flameox requires Python 3.12 or newer and uses the committed `uv.lock`. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for development setup and contribution guidance. ```console uv run ruff check src tests tools uv run ruff format --check src tests tools uv run mypy src tests tools uv run pytest -q ``` Flameox is licensed under the MIT License.

plugins.description: 金铲铲同人风格的 DSH Web 主题：原创海克斯竞技场背景、金色铲影、四套强化色、氛围光效与圆润/锐利棱角。 Unofficial Golden Spatula fan theme for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# 金铲铲 · 海克斯核心

**dsh-jcc-theme** — 给 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面换一副金铲铲同人外观：原创海克斯竞技场背景、
金色铲影、四套强化配色与可开关的氛围光效，右下角一枚「海克斯核心」，点开就能换强调色、
调棋盘纹理与棱角，或者一键关掉。

> 非官方同人作品，与腾讯、Riot Games 无关。不含任何游戏素材：图标与底纹都是本仓库用
> CSS / SVG 画的几何图形，配色来自公开的设计令牌。「金铲铲之战」「Teamfight Tactics」
> 是其各自权利人的商标。

![深色 · 海克斯金](assets/screenshot-dark.png)

## 它做了什么

- **两套明暗外观**：浅色是羊皮纸棋盘地图，深色是奥术蓝黑竞技场；跟随 DSH 的「浅色 / 深色 /
  跟随系统」设置，无需单独开关。
- **原创背景图**：夜场是六边形看台、金色铲影与漂浮海克斯晶体；浅色是旧地图等高线、罗盘与
  同款铲影。两张都以内联 SVG data URI 提供，不额外请求任何图片。
- **四枚强化符文**：海克斯金、奥术青、狂暴紫、星界蓝。切换后边框、品牌色、链接、焦点环、
  侧栏选中态一起换；切换是纯 CSS 属性，不重载页面。
- **棋盘纹理**：淡 / 标准 / 浓烈三档，控制界面底层那层六边形网格与两团环境光的强度。
- **氛围光效**：一层缓慢呼吸的极光，加两层速度不同的金色浮尘，全部在应用画布之后；
  面板里可以关掉，`prefers-reduced-motion` 下自动停止动画。
- **界面棱角**：圆润 / 锐利。锐利会同时收紧面板和产品自己的圆角令牌，卡片、按钮、
  输入框一起变成 HUD 方角。
- **海克斯核心**：右下角悬浮的六边形按钮。面板里可以启用/关闭主题、换强调色、调纹理、
  切棱角、开关氛围光效、恢复默认；选择记在本机 `localStorage`，刷新后还在。
- **关闭即还原**：所有页面级样式都挂在 `<html data-jcc="on">` 下。关掉开关（或从插件市场
  停用）后，原生界面立刻回来，不用卸载。

浅色：

![浅色 · 海克斯金](assets/screenshot-light.png)

星界蓝 + 锐利棱角 + 浓烈纹理：

![深色 · 星界蓝 · 锐利](assets/screenshot-sharp.png)

## 安装

要求 **DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 或更新**（含桌面端）。插件只带浏览器半边，没有宿主服务、没有配置
schema、没有终端命令。

### 从插件市场安装

收录后，在 **设置 → 插件市场** 里搜索「金铲铲」或 `dsh-jcc-theme`，一键安装。

### 从命令行安装

```sh
# 预构建 tarball（推荐，装完不用构建）
dsh plugin --profile web add "https://github.com/liuyaguang8023/dsh-jcc-theme/releases/latest/download/dsh-jcc-theme.tgz"

# 或直接从源码装（仓库里已带构建产物，无需 npm install）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:liuyaguang8023/dsh-jcc-theme
```

装完按市场的提示刷新页面；如果宿主在启动时组合 bundle，重启一次 `dsh web` 即可。

## 使用

1. 页面右下角出现六边形「海克斯核心」按钮。
2. 点开面板：
   - **启用主题** — 总开关，关掉完全还原原生界面；
   - **强化符文** — 金 / 青 / 紫 / 蓝四种强调色；
   - **棋盘纹理** — 淡 / 标准 / 浓烈；
   - **界面棱角** — 圆润 / 锐利；
   - **氛围光效** — 极光与金色浮尘的开/关；
   - **恢复默认** — 回到海克斯金 + 标准纹理 + 圆润 + 氛围开。
3. 点面板外面或按 `Esc` 收起。

选择存储在 `localStorage` 的 `dsh-jcc/v1` 键里，格式是
`{"on":true,"accent":"gold","texture":"normal","ambience":true,"corners":"soft"}`。不上传、不联网。

## 兼容性

| 项目 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`（`engines.dsh`） |
| 明暗 | 浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统，跟随 DSH 令牌 |
| 窄屏 | 面板上移并限制宽度，避免压住输入框 |
| 字体 | 不改字体栈；标题字距、按钮样式也只作用于主题自己的面板 |
| 网络 | 零请求。没有图片、字体、脚本来自外部 |
| 权限 | 不读写文件、不执行命令、不调用宿主 API |

## 工作原理

- **颜色**：在 `src/client.js` 里按「强调色 × 明暗」生成 `--dsw-alias-*` 令牌，选择器写成
  `:root[data-jcc="on"][data-jcc-accent="gold"] body[data-ds-dark-theme]`，比产品自身的
  `body[data-ds-dark-theme]` 更具体，所以能稳定覆盖、也能随时撤回。
- **背景**：两张原创 SVG 场景在构建时编码成 data URI，作为 `body` 的第一层背景，再叠三条
  `repeating-linear-gradient`（0° / ±60°）的棋盘网格与两层径向光。`background-attachment: fixed`
  让整层背景不随消息滚动。应用框架和各个页面根节点会用 `--dsw-alias-bg-base` 盖住这层画布，所以客户端会在运行时找出「覆盖整个视口」的画布层并把它们变透明；粘性标题、卡片、附件这类同样用该令牌的小元素保持不透明。
- **氛围**：一个 `z-index: -1` 的固定层，两层浮尘用 `background-image` + `transform` 漂移，
  极光用径向渐变呼吸；画布层透明，所以它只出现在界面背后，不挡文字。
- **棱角**：锐利模式同时覆写 `--dsw-radius-*` 与面板自己的圆角变量，保证卡片、按钮和
  面板一起变方，而不是只有面板。
- **面板**：纯 DOM + CSS，不依赖 React、不使用 `slots`，所以宿主升级换掉组件类名也不会
  把面板弄坏；唯一耦合的是稳定的 `data-ds-dark-theme` 属性与设计令牌。
- **构建**：`client/index.js` 由 `src/client.js` + `src/theme.css` 拼成，提交进仓库，所以从
  源码安装不需要构建步骤。

## 开发

仓库零运行时依赖，只需要 Node 20+。`test/dom.mjs` 会调用本机 Chrome（找不到时自动跳过）。

```sh
npm run build      # 重新生成 client/index.js
npm test           # manifest + 调色板契约
npm run test:dom   # 真 DOM 里把交互跑一遍（headless Chrome）

# 本地预览：preview/index.html 用产品的真实 token 快照搭了一个 DSH 外壳
open preview/index.html
node scripts/shoot.mjs   # 重新生成 assets/ 里的截图
```

`preview/tokens.css` 是从 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 的 `dsh-client-ui-theme` 抽出的令牌快照，只用于
本地预览，不参与发布。

## 许可

MIT。见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: One-click full frontend reload button in the DSH conversation session header.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ui-reload

A "reload the whole frontend" button in the DSH conversation session header, immediately left of the share button.

Clicking it reloads the entire page — the one operation that reliably picks up anything the frontend can be out of sync with: client plugin bundles rebuilt under the running page, plugin-list changes, stale CSS, and the shell's own code.

## Requirements

| | |
|---|---|
| DSH | `0.2.1-rc.2` (developed and tested against it) |
| `@deepseek-ai/cordis` | `~4.0.5` |
| Mode | Web UI (`web` or `desktop` profile) — there is no CLI surface |

Earlier DSH releases are untested. The button mounts into the slot `conversation.session.header.utilities`; a release that renames or removes that slot leaves it unrendered.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add github:minhaoli/dsh-ui-reload
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so the row is appended to `dsh.profile.bundles` and the loader mounts it on the next start. Reload the page once after installing — the client half is served as a separate module.

Manual install:

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml
- insert:
    - id: ui-reload
      name: 'dsh-ui-reload'
```

## Why a full reload and not HMR

DSH already ships `dsh-client-hmr`, which republishes a plugin the moment its bundle changes. This button exists for the residue that path cannot reach — a page whose shell or bootstrap predates a change, or state that only a real document load clears. Reloading the document is the only thing that covers all of it.

**What survives a click:** conversation, workspace and connection state — they live on the host.

**What does not:** anything held only in the page — scroll position, open panels, in-flight composer text, running client-side timers.

## How it works

The package has two halves and the bundle patch mounts both:

- `lib/index.js` — the host half. It exports an empty `apply()` and registers no route, service or watcher, because a plain page reload needs nothing from the host. It exists only so the bundle row has something to mount; dropping it would stop the package from being composed at all, taking the client button with it.
- `lib/client.js` — the browser half, injected through `dsh.client.inject: ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots"]`. It registers the button into `conversation.session.header.utilities` and calls `window.location.reload()` on click, after a 400 ms acknowledgement so the click registers visually before the load takes over.

## Companion plugins

- [`dsh-session-tree`](https://github.com/minhaoli/dsh-session-tree) — sidebar with tags, grouping and drag-to-move.
- [`dsh-session-manager`](https://github.com/minhaoli/dsh-session-manager) — agent tools and REST API for session housekeeping.
- [`dsh-session-search`](https://github.com/minhaoli/dsh-session-search) — in-conversation find bar.
- [`dsh-session-query-vector`](https://github.com/minhaoli/dsh-session-query-vector) — semantic session search backend.

## License

MIT — see [LICENSE](./LICENSE).

plugins.description: DSH plugin — free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Free LLM API, no API key needed. 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，无需 API key
plugins.readme_text:
# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click install. **From npm**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh.git cd opencode2dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode2dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencode2dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencode2dsh name: '@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencode2dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only, plugin 0.3.7+: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`muse-spark-*`, Responses-only on Zen) ▼ https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 ← Authorization: Bearer public with CLI-identical headers: user-agent: opencode/… x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-session-affinity, X-Session-Id, x-opencode-request, x-opencode-project ``` - **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the conversation's first user turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible), and each request gets a fresh random id, mirroring the CLI. - **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev pricing metadata decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list. The plugin preserves the explanation instead of reporting an invalid API key. Use the supported OpenCode client or an official API service. | | Boot screen shows `Failed to load plugins … list slot "plugins.item" requires options.id`, or the IP 池 entry has no configuration page | Your DSH predates the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract. Upgrade DSH to 0.1.7 (latest recommended). On 0.1.6 and older the page never mounts (it is gated on `configForms.whileServed`) — model routing is unaffected. | | DSH 0.1.7/0.2 cannot start after plugin installation (`pending … settingsScope`) | Upgrade the plugin to 0.3.5. On DSH 0.2, configure IP pooling through the installed opencode2dsh row on the Plugins page. | | Only 3 models | Startup fetch raced your network; retries land within ~1 min. Check `adapter-status.json` for `lastError`. | | `lastError: "fetch failed"` persisting | Outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` blocked; check proxy/VPN rules. | | Rate-limit errors in chat (`429 … Endpoint is unavailable`) | The anonymous lane is quota-per-IP and free models are contended.
