# dsh-ottosmother（中文）

给 DeepSeek Harness 的插件，把一份私人词表写进 system prompt：用户写
「滚木」要理解成「没有」，写「棍母」要理解成「不存在」；模型要表达「没有 /
不存在」时，用这些词把整句改写得自然通顺，而不是机械扣掉两个字再塞一个词。

插件只加一个 **system prompt 段落**：不改用户输入、不包装模型输出、不注册任何
消息钩子。

- **理解用户**：「这里有滚木」→ 理解为「这里什么也没有」；「说了个棍母」→
  理解为「什么也没说」。
- **模型回复**：要表达「没有 / 不存在」时，自己把整句改写通顺，例如
  「这里没有东西」→「这里有棍母」，而不是「这里滚木东西」这种生硬结果。
- 代码、命令、路径、URL、报错信息要求原样保留。

模型是否真的使用这些词，是模型自己的判断——这是提示词层面的规则，不是硬替换。

## 生效方式

| 扩展点 | 做什么 |
| --- | --- |
| `systemPrompt.section` | 注入「固定用语」说明（词典 + 理解规则 + 表达规则 + 代码原样规则） |

段落名 `dsh-ottosmother/glossary`，order 50。文本由函数提供，每次组装 prompt
时现读配置；插件关闭或词表为空时返回空串，等价于不注入。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-ottosmother
```

或从 GitHub 安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:hj9178/dsh-ottosmother
```

安装后重启 harness 生效。

## 配置

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里调整：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-ottosmother
      name: 'dsh-ottosmother'
      inject: [systemPrompt]
      config:
        enabled: true
        terms:
          - word: '滚木'
            meaning: '没有'
          - word: '棍母'
            meaning: '不存在'
```

- `enabled`：总开关，关掉后不注入任何内容。
- `terms`：词表，`word` 是用户写的自造词，`meaning` 是它代表的含义。

## 已知行为

- 模型是否用「滚木 / 棍母」表达由模型自己判断，可能偶尔说成「没有」。
- 代码没有被代码保护——规则只是要求模型自己保持原文。

## License

MIT。

plugins.description: DSH 桌面通知：所有前端失焦时把决策 / 授权 / 中断 / 完成发到 Windows 通知中心；点击复用已有页面切回对话。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-desktop-notify

> 所有 DSH 前端都失焦时，把「需要你决策 / 需要你授权 / 意外中断 / 任务完成」发到 Windows 通知中心；通知标题是会话标题，点击通知复用已打开的 DSH 页面切回对应对话。

![Windows 通知截图](docs/notification.png)

![自绘通知卡片](docs/card.png)

## 安装

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add @carbonzhao/dsh-desktop-notify
```

重启 `dsh web`，然后硬刷新页面（Ctrl+Shift+R）。也可以从源码安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add github:CarbonZhao-02692/dsh-desktop-notify`。

## 能力分类

界面与体验。

## 它能做什么

| 事件 | 触发点 | 通知内容 |
|---|---|---|
| 需要你选择决策 | `user-questions/request`（含方案确认 plan-review） | `需要你选择决策：<问题>` |
| 需要你授权 | `approval/request` | `需要你授权：<工具名> — <原因>` |
| 意外中断，请重试 | `turn/end` reason=`error` / `interrupted` / `max-tokens`，以及 `api-session/error` | `任务意外中断：<错误>，请重试` |
| 任务已完成 | `turn/end` reason=`completed` | `任务已完成（用时 X）` |

通知标题取自**对应会话的标题**（`sessionTitle` 服务折叠出的标题）；标题还没生成时回退到该会话第一条用户消息。通知正文是对应提示。

## 焦点判定：所有 DSH 前端都失焦

每个 DSH 页面每 3 秒向 `/dsh-desktop-notify/focus` 上报：

```json
{ "id": "页面 id", "focused": true, "visible": true }
```

`focused = document.visibilityState === 'visible' && document.hasFocus()`。浏览器窗口失焦、切到其他标签页、焦点在地址栏，都会使 `focused` 为 false。

host 的门控只有一条：

- **任意一个页面 `focused=true` → 不是“所有前端失焦”，静默不发。**
- **所有已上报页面 `focused=false` → 发通知。**
- 页面关闭时通过 `sendBeacon` 上报 `closed: true`，立即从汇总移除。
- 后台标签页的定时器可能被浏览器节流，所以 3 分钟内没有心跳才按已关闭处理；所有页面都关闭时视为“全部失焦”。

`visible` 只用于状态展示，不参与门控。

## 通知模式与点击回到对话

配置项 `enableCard` 决定通知形态：

### `enableCard: false`（默认）

只显示正常的 Windows toast，不显示自绘卡片：

1. toast 带 `activationType="protocol"` 和 `launch="dsh-desktop-notify://open?session=<id>&origin=<origin>"`；Windows 调用协议 helper `assets/open.ps1`。
2. 同时启动 `assets/toast-listener.ps1`，在隐藏 PowerShell 进程里保持 `ToastNotification` 存活；如果 `Activated` 事件被投递，也会调用同一个 helper。
3. helper 把会话 id POST 到 host 的 `/dsh-desktop-notify/activate`，用 `ShowWindow` / `SetForegroundWindow` 恢复并置前 Edge/Chrome 窗口（只有最小化时才 `SW_RESTORE`，最大化保持不变）。
4. helper 通过 UI Automation 把标题匹配的 DSH 标签页切到前台；已打开的 DSH 页面每秒轮询 `/dsh-desktop-notify/activation`，收到后调用 `uiWorkspace.openSession(sessionId)`。
5. host 只把请求投递给**用户最后使用的那个页面**，多标签不会一起跳。

### `enableCard: true`

只显示右下角原生 WPF 卡片，不发送任何 Windows toast：

1. host 启动 `assets/notify-card.ps1`，显示应用名、鲸鱼图标、会话标题和正文，不抢焦点，20 秒后自动关闭。
2. 点击卡片调用 `assets/open.ps1`，后续的激活、窗口恢复、标签页切换与上面相同。
3. 不使用浏览器通知；通知中心不会留下记录。

**没有页面时的兜底**：如果 host 发现没有任何已连接的 DSH 页面，会让 helper 在默认浏览器打开一个引导页；引导页把会话 id 写入 `localStorage` 并跳回 DSH，新页面加载后自动打开对应对话。

## 设置页与测试

DSH 设置 → 通用 → **桌面通知**：

- 显示当前上报页面数和焦点汇总状态（有前端聚焦 = 静默中 / 全部失焦 = 会通知）。
- “自绘卡片”开关：切换 `enableCard`，立即生效并持久化到 `%DSH_HOME%\super-injector\dsh-desktop-notify-config.json`；关闭则只发 Windows toast，打开则只显示可点击卡片。
- “发送测试通知”按钮：强制发一条通知，忽略焦点门控，用来验证当前模式、应用名、图标与点击行为。

也可以直接调用 HTTP 接口：

```powershell
# 查看焦点状态与最近通知
Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing http://127.0.0.1:3080/dsh-desktop-notify/status

# 强制发一条测试通知（force 忽略焦点门控；带 sessionId 时点击会回到该对话）
$body = @{ kind='complete'; force=$true; sessionId='session-...'; body='测试通知' } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Method POST -ContentType 'application/json' `
  -Body ([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($body)) `
  http://127.0.0.1:3080/dsh-desktop-notify/test
```

## 配置

默认值在 `lib/index.js` 的 `DEFAULTS` 里；通过 loader 行的 `config` 覆盖：

```yaml
- id: dsh-desktop-notify
  name: '@carbonzhao/dsh-desktop-notify'
  config:
    onlyWhenUnfocused: true   # false = 页面聚焦时也发
    clickToOpen: true         # false = 通知不可点击回会话
    enableCard: false         # true = 仅自绘卡片；false = 仅普通 Windows toast
    ignoreSubagent: true      # 后台子代理会话不提醒
    notifyOnDecision: true
    notifyOnApproval: true
    notifyOnInterruption: true
    notifyOnComplete: true
    minTurnDurationMs: 0      # 完成提醒的最短轮次时长（毫秒）
    toastAppId: 'DeepSeek.DSH.Notify'
    toastAppName: 'Deepseek Harness Notification'
    toastIconPath: ''         # 默认 assets/deepseek-harness.png
    toastAppIconPath: ''      # 默认 assets/deepseek-harness.ico
```

## 兼容与运行要求

- DSH `web` profile；实测 `0.2.1-rc.2`（当前 checkout）。
- Windows 10 / 11，Windows PowerShell 5.1（WinRT toast）。
- Node.js >= 20。
- 页面必须保持打开才能上报焦点；没有页面时点击通知会走兜底新开页。
- 浏览器 / DSH Desktop 需要允许 Windows 通知；系统“专注助手”可能拦截。
- 仅实现 Windows toast；其他平台只写日志、不发通知。

## 权限与外部服务

- 写入 `HKCU\Software\Classes\dsh-desktop-notify`（自定义协议 helper）。
- 写入 `HKCU\Software\Classes\AppUserModelId\DeepSeek.DSH.Notify`（应用名与图标）。
- toast 模式会注册 `HKCU\Software\Classes\dsh-desktop-notify` 协议；卡片模式不发送 toast，也不注册协议。
- 通过 `powershell.exe` 显示 toast 或卡片，并在临时目录写一个 `.ps1` 脚本。
- helper 使用 Windows UI Automation 查找并切换浏览器标签页（不需要管理员权限）。
- 本机 HTTP 路由：`/focus`、`/status`、`/test`、`/activate`、`/activation`、`/open`；其中 `/activate` 和 `/open` 只接受 loopback 请求，`/open` 还需要每次进程随机生成的密钥。
- 没有外部服务、没有上传、没有网络请求（除本机 DSH 地址）。

## 真实输出

### toast 模式（`enableCard: false`）

```xml
<toast activationType="protocol" launch="dsh-desktop-notify://open?session=session-...&origin=http%3A%2F%2F127.0.0.1%3A3080">
  <visual><binding template="ToastGeneric">
    <text>示例会话标题</text>
    <text>点击通知应回到对应对话</text>
    <image placement="appLogoOverride" src="file:///.../assets/deepseek-harness.png"/>
  </binding></visual>
  <audio src="ms-winsoundevent:Notification.Default"/>
</toast>
```

### 卡片模式（`enableCard: true`）

```text
shown
clicked
start uri=dsh-desktop-notify://open?session=session-...
activate hwnd=... minimized=False maximized=True foreground=True
tab selected: 示例会话标题 — DeepSeek Harness ...
activation queued session=session-... target=dsh-... live=1
activation delivered session=session-... client=dsh-...
```

## 已知限制

- 后台子代理会话默认不提醒（它们的完成由主对话那一轮覆盖）。
- `enableCard: false` 时通知中心里的 toast 点击是否触发协议/Activated 取决于 Windows 环境；当前这台 Windows 10 上两者都未触发。
- `enableCard: true` 时可点击的是右下角原生卡片；卡片 20 秒后自动关闭。
- 窗口恢复/置前对 Edge/Chrome 使用 Win32 `ShowWindow` + `SetForegroundWindow`；只有最小化时才 `SW_RESTORE`，最大化窗口保持最大化。系统前台锁定、虚拟桌面切换等极端情况仍可能失败。
- 标签页切换 / 窗口激活目前针对 Edge / Chrome；DSH 在 Firefox 中时不会自动切回该标签页。
- 标签页切换按标题匹配；多个标签页标题相同时，可能选中同标题的另一个 DSH 标签页（仍会落在对应会话）。
- helper 日志：`%TEMP%\dsh-desktop-notify-helper.log`；卡片日志：`%TEMP%\dsh-desktop-notify-card.log`；toast listener 日志：`%TEMP%\dsh-desktop-notify-toast.log`。
- Windows 可能缓存 AUMID 的应用名/图标；重启 Explorer 或清空通知历史后会刷新。

## 开发

插件是纯 ESM/CJS JavaScript，无构建步骤、无第三方运行时依赖。

- host：[lib/index.js](lib/index.js)
- client：[lib/client.js](lib/client.js)
- 协议 helper：[assets/open.ps1](assets/open.ps1)
- toast listener：[assets/toast-listener.ps1](assets/toast-listener.ps1)
- 原生通知卡片：[assets/notify-card.ps1](assets/notify-card.ps1)
- 图标：[assets/deepseek-harness.png](assets/deepseek-harness.png)、[assets/deepseek-harness.ico](assets/deepseek-harness.ico)
- 条目：[cordis.patch.yml](cordis.patch.yml)

本地修改后重新加载插件或重启 DSH。

## License

MIT。见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

图标来自官方 DSH 前端资源（MIT）；DeepSeek Harness 与鲸鱼标识归各自所有者，本插件非官方出品。见 [NOTICE](NOTICE)。

plugins.description: Draws mermaid code blocks in DSH replies as diagrams, including while the reply is still streaming.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-mermaid Draws ```` ```mermaid ```` code blocks in DSH replies as diagrams — **including while the reply is still streaming**.

> dsh-plugin-mermaid — 把回复里的 ```mermaid 代码块画成图表，边流式输出边画
中文说明（点开） —— 不用等一轮回复结束才看到图 **它是什么**：模型在回复里写 ```` ```mermaid ```` 围栏，你看到的是图，不是代码。图上方一条细栏写着 `Mermaid`，右边是 **复制** 和 **源码/图表** 开关。 **为什么不是"等回复结束再画"**：DSH 渲染流式回复时，**已完成的块只解析一次、React 元素被缓存**，每个 token 只重建尾部那一块。所以规则只有一条：**源文本静止 220ms 才画**。token 在流 → 计时器一直被重置 → 什么都不画；围栏一闭、后面的正文开始到达 → 块冻结 → 图立刻出现。模型在围栏里停顿时不会画出半张图。 **复制**：图模式复制一张 PNG（2–3 倍尺寸、铺了代码块自己的底色，粘到文档里就是一张图）；源码模式复制 Mermaid 文本。浏览器剪贴板不收 SVG，所以图是先栅格化再写的 —— 这也是 Mermaid 跑在 `htmlLabels: false` 的原因：`` 里的 HTML 在"SVG 当图片"时会消失。 **认不出来就不画**：Mermaid 解析失败的块原样保留，不插任何东西。 **装法**：Plugin Manager 的 Add plugin 填 `github:kjx-talesofai/dsh-plugin-mermaid#v0.2.1`，或指向本地目录。装完**重启 app**（Host 半边开机才加载资产路由），页面再 **⌘R**。 **它没有做什么**：不改 Markdown 渲染器、不占槽位、不加工具。只在代码块的 `data-code-block-content` 里加一个节点，用一条 `:has()` 规则把源码 `
` 藏起来。
## What it does The model writes a fenced block: ````text ```mermaid flowchart LR A["工作区"] --> B["暂存区"] --> C["仓库"] ``` ```` You see the diagram, under a small bar that names it and offers **源码** (source) and copy. The block's own "Code block" banner is hidden while the diagram is shown, because the plugin never touches the `
` React owns — it
adds a sibling and hides the original with CSS.

**Copy follows the view.** With the diagram on screen the button puts a PNG on
the clipboard (2–3× the drawn size, on the block's own surface colour, so it
pastes into a document without a transparent-background surprise); with the
source on screen it copies the Mermaid text. Browser clipboards will not take an
SVG reliably, so the diagram is drawn through a canvas first — which is also why
Mermaid runs with `htmlLabels: false`: `foreignObject` HTML does not survive that
trip.

## Why this is not a Markdown plugin

There is no slot between "Markdown" and "code block". The only seat a plugin can
take is the whole `assistant-step` node, and taking it would mean re-implementing
Markdown — file links, image lightboxes, KaTeX, syntax highlighting, copy
buttons, sticky banners — to add one block type.

So the plugin decorates the primitive's own markup instead:

```
div.md-code-block
  div.bannerWrap                   ← hidden while a diagram is shown
    div[data-code-block-banner]    ← language label + copy
  div[data-code-block-content]
    pre                            ← the source (left in place, hidden by CSS)
    div.dsh-mermaid                ← the one node the plugin adds
```

The coupling is that markup. `tests/dom.test.mjs` drives a stand-in with the same
shape in a real browser, so a change to it fails loudly here instead of silently
drawing nothing.

## Why streaming needs care

DSH renders a live reply with an incremental Markdown renderer: every completed
block is parsed once and its React elements are cached, so only the growing tail
is re-rendered on each token. That gives one precise rule:

> never draw the tail; draw only a source that has stopped changing.

A block is drawn after its source has been unchanged for 220 ms. While tokens
flow the timer keeps resetting; when the fence closes and the next prose starts,
the block freezes, and the diagram appears mid-reply — no waiting for the turn to
end. A pause *inside* an open fence that lasts longer than 220 ms will draw
whatever has arrived; if the source then keeps growing, the panel is dropped and
redrawn, and a source Mermaid rejects leaves the code block exactly as it was.

Rendered diagrams are cached by source + theme, so a re-render (React rebuilding
the message, a theme switch) costs no Mermaid work.

## Where Mermaid comes from

The browser half asks the Host for `/api/mermaid.asset.js`; the Host serves the
`mermaid.min.js` from this package's own dependency tree over the same
authenticated, same-origin channel as the rest of the Web UI. The build is found
by Node's own resolution (`createRequire`), not by a fixed
`./node_modules/…` path: pnpm — which the Plugin Manager uses — keeps a
package's dependencies *beside* it, so a fixed path would 404 on every install
from Git while working perfectly in a linked checkout. It is a 3.4 MB
script, so it is fetched the first time a diagram is seen, not on every page
load, and revalidated with an ETag.

## Limits

- Diagrams are rendered in the browser only. A DSH client without the plugin (a
  phone on an old tab, `--no-client` tooling) shows the code block.
- Mermaid's `strict` security level is used: HTML labels are sanitized, and
  click-to-activate links are not available.
- A diagram Mermaid rejects is not decorated at all. The reason is logged to the
  browser console (`[mermaid] …`); there is no inline error row, because during
  streaming an incomplete diagram would flash one.
- No per-block history: the panel is a view of the file's Markdown, not a record.

## Install

Use DSH's own **Add plugin** dialog. No npm account, no publishing.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| GitHub | `github:kjx-talesofai/dsh-plugin-mermaid#v0.2.1` |
| Local directory | an absolute path, e.g. `/path/to/dsh-plugin-mermaid` |

Restart the desktop app afterwards: the Host half owns the asset route and is
only loaded at startup. The browser half reloads with the page (`⌘R`).

This plugin is **not published to npm**, and `npm install` is not the install
path. Its one runtime dependency (the Mermaid build the Host serves) is installed
from the repository's `package.json`.

## Tests

```bash
npm ci
npm test           # 18: classifier, loader contract, patch/manifest consistency, the Host route, module resolution
npm run test:dom   # 33 in headless Chrome over CDP: `:has()`, real Mermaid output, the streaming sequence, both clipboard flavours
```

`test:dom` skips when no Chrome or Chromium is installed.

## Licence

MIT.

plugins.description: Codex-style file-based long-term memory for DSH: two-stage extraction, consolidated MEMORY.md handbook, prompt-injected summary, and search/read/list/note tools.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-codex-memories

Codex-style **long-term memory** for DSH: cross-session memory that ingests finished sessions, consolidates them into a searchable handbook, and injects a compact summary before every turn.

It reproduces the two-stage structure of the Codex memory system rather than approximating it: per-session extraction first, then a consolidation pass over many raw memories.

## Why

DSH sessions are isolated by default. A correction you made yesterday, a command that only works in one repo, a symptom/cause/fix you already paid for — none of it carries over unless you restate it. This plugin makes the agent remember:

- how you want it to work, without being told twice
- where the truth lives in a specific repo, and which commands actually run
- which failure has which fix

## How it works

```
session goes idle for N seconds
   └─ Stage 1  one model call per session -> session_summaries/<slug>.md + raw_memories.md
        └─ Stage 2  once enough memory accumulates -> MEMORY.md + memory_summary.md
             └─ before each turn, memory_summary.md is injected into the prompt
```

All durable artifacts are plain Markdown you can read, edit, version, or move. `index.json` holds the extraction cache, job records, and the consolidation watermark.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @lushdawn/dsh-codex-memories
```

Local development:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add link:<absolute path to this directory>
```

Restart DSH, or let a live profile hot-load it.

## Commands

| Command | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `/memory status` | memory root, extracted sessions, pending consolidation, last timestamps |
| `/memory show` | print the current `memory_summary.md` |
| `/memory extract` | extract the current session immediately |
| `/memory backfill` | scan stored sessions and extract the ones never processed |
| `/memory consolidate` | merge pending memory into `MEMORY.md` now |
| `/memory forget <sessionId\|all>` | drop extraction records (handbook content is kept) |
| `/memory on` / `off` | toggle automatic extraction for this process |

## Tools

Exposed to the model when `dedicatedTools` is on:

| Tool | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `memory_search` | line-level keyword search across memory files (`any` / `all` / `on_same_line`) |
| `memory_read` | read one memory file by line range |
| `memory_list` | inventory of the memory folder and pending work |
| `memory_note` | append one ad-hoc note — the only write path the model is offered |

The model is instructed to cite memory as `MEMORY.md:12-14|note=[...]`.

## Configuration

Every field has a safe default; override in your profile patch:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-codex-memories
      name: dsh-codex-memories
      config:
        storageDir: ''            # default $DSH_HOME/memories
        generate: true
        use: true
        dedicatedTools: true
        model: ''                 # e.g. deepseek-official/deepseek-flash
        extractModel: ''          # falls back to model
        consolidationModel: ''    # falls back to model
        idleSeconds: 120
        maxSessionsPerRun: 3
        maxSessionAgeDays: 30
        consolidationThreshold: 2
        maxInjectChars: 9000
        minSessionMessages: 4
        extractMaxTokens: 8000
        consolidateMaxTokens: 16000
```

When `model` is empty the plugin reads the current default model, then falls back to `deepseek-official/deepseek-flash`.

## Data layout

```
$DSH_HOME/memories/
├── MEMORY.md                    # durable handbook, Task Group organized
├── memory_summary.md            # prompt-loaded layer; first line must be v1
├── raw_memories.md              # mechanical stage-1 merge, ascending session id
├── session_summaries/<slug>.md  # one structured recap per session
├── extensions/ad_hoc/notes/     # notes written by you or the model
└── index.json                   # extraction cache, job records, watermark
```

## Cost and privacy

- **It spends tokens**: one Stage-1 call per session and one Stage-2 call per consolidation. Sessions under 4 messages are skipped; at most 3 sessions are processed per sweep.
- **Local files only**: no network access beyond the model API it calls.
- **It enters your prompt**: `memory_summary.md` is injected every turn, which is why it is capped by `maxInjectChars`.
- **Auditable**: every artifact is readable Markdown.
- **The model cannot rewrite the handbook**: it may only append ad-hoc notes; consolidation is a separate pass, so one turn cannot corrupt durable memory.

## Fidelity to Codex

The behavioral spec comes from reverse engineering Codex itself — the on-disk shape under `~/.codex/memories` plus the prompt templates embedded in `codex.exe`:

| Codex | dsh-codex-memories |
| --- | --- |
| `~/.codex/memories/` | `$DSH_HOME/memories/` |
| `MEMORY.md` / `memory_summary.md` / `raw_memories.md` | same names, same formats |
| `rollout_summaries/*.md` | `session_summaries/*.md` |
| `memories_1.sqlite` | `index.json` |
| Stage 1 extraction prompt | `PHASE1_TEMPLATE` in `lib/prompts.js` |
| Phase 2 consolidation prompt | `PHASE2_TEMPLATE` in `lib/prompts.js` |
| usage guidance + citation format | `USAGE_TEMPLATE` in `lib/prompts.js` |
| rollout scan backfill | `/memory backfill` + boot sweep |

See [docs/mechanism.md](docs/mechanism.md) for the full mechanism and the evidence behind it.

## Known limits

- Stage 2 asks for two complete documents in one reply. On a very large handbook the reply can hit the output cap; the old files are then kept and the pass reports an error instead of writing something corrupt.
- Automatic extraction needs the process alive during the idle window; otherwise the next boot's `backfill` catches up.
- Retrieval is keyword/line based, not semantic — the same tradeoff Codex makes. Route with `keywords` in `MEMORY.md`.

## Contributing

Issues and pull requests are welcome — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). For anything
security-related, follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) instead of opening a public issue. Release
history lives in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DSH plugin: enable permessage-deflate on the WebSocket transport (/api/remote.mux) without modifying the DSH install tree
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ws-deflate

**English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

Turns on `permessage-deflate` for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) web's WebSocket transport, **without modifying the DSH installation**. Measured on one machine: a session transcript that left the server as **1,206,822 B went out as 350,599 B — 70.9 % fewer wire bytes**.

It is a **runtime monkey-patch, not a supported extension point.** Read "Should I install this" before installing it.

## Should I install this?

**Install it if** you open `dsh web` from somewhere that is not your own machine — a Tailscale/VPN link, a reverse proxy over the internet, any path with real latency or packet loss. DSH replays the whole session transcript over `/api/remote.mux` on every reconnect, so on a lossy link those bytes are paid repeatedly.

**Do not install it if** you only ever use `dsh web` on `localhost` or a LAN. The saving is real but you don't need it there, and what you'd be taking on in exchange is a patch against another project's internals that can go quietly stale on every upgrade.

What it costs, measured on a Windows 10 / node v24 box: **+10 ms** to `dsh` startup (alternating 4-run measurement), and zlib level 6 at **42.7 ms per 1.53 MB** of transcript. The compression is per-message above a 1 KiB threshold, so small events are untouched.

## What it actually changes

Nothing on disk. `ws@8.22.0`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-gateway`, and `@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib` were compared file-by-file (sha256) against the pristine registry tarballs: **63 files, 0 mismatches, 0 extra, 0 missing**, and 0 files in the install tree written or created that day.

What it does change is one method, in memory, in the `dsh` process:

```
BEFORE  WebSocketServer.prototype.handleUpgrade = handleUpgrade(req, socket, head, cb) {   ← ws's own
AFTER   WebSocketServer.prototype.handleUpgrade = function (req, socket, head, cb) { try {  ← the wrapper
disk sha256 of ws/lib/websocket-server.js: 6d8dd89a841748c8 -> 6d8dd89a841748c8            ← unchanged
```

The wrapper sets `this.options.perMessageDeflate` at **handshake** time, which works because ws 8.x reads that option inside `handleUpgrade` (`websocket-server.js:299`/`:303`), not at construction — so it reaches the gateway's already-built `new WebSocketServer({ noServer: true })` (`dsh-api-gateway/lib/index.js:179`). It only opts in when nothing else set the option, so **if DSH enables compression itself upstream, this plugin steps aside automatically.**

Why the option can't just be configured: DSH exposes no key for it. The webserver's `compression` is HTTP gzip and does not cover streams.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ws-deflate
```

Then restart `dsh web`. The bundle list is read at startup, so no restart means no effect.

## Verify

```bash
grep 'dsh-ws-deflate' <wherever your dsh web logs>
```

You want three things:

```
[dsh-ws-deflate] permessage-deflate enabled -> …/node_modules/ws [ws 8.22.0] via path (level 6, threshold 1024 B, noContextTakeover on)
[dsh-ws-deflate] self test OK: this process negotiates permessage-deflate
[dsh-ws-deflate] negotiated permessage-deflate with Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_15_7) …
```

The **self test** is the interesting one. DSH's browser auth rejects non-browser handshakes, so you cannot probe a live server from a script — the plugin instead builds its own `new WebSocketServer({ noServer: true })` on an ephemeral loopback port and does a real handshake against it. That proves *this process, with this ws copy, negotiates*, which is the claim no external probe can reach. The `negotiated …` lines then log the first few real browser handshakes (user agent truncated, `maxLog` caps it at 5, `0` disables).

Browser side, if you want it: DevTools → Network → the `remote.mux` request → Response Headers should contain `Sec-WebSocket-Extensions: permessage-deflate; …`.

## Uninstall

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-ws-deflate
```

Restart. Nothing needs restoring, because nothing on disk was ever different.

## Configuration

Add or edit the entry in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: ws-deflate
  name: dsh-ws-deflate
  config:
    enabled: true
    level: 6
    thresholdBytes: 1024
    noContextTakeover: true
    concurrencyLimit: 10
    selfTest: true
    maxLog: 5
```

| key | default | notes |
|---|---:|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | `false` keeps the wrapper installed but opts no handshake in |
| `level` | `6` | measured here: level 6 → ratio 0.176, level 1 → 0.238 on the same payload, at 42.7 ms vs 5.9 ms per 1.53 MB |
| `thresholdBytes` | `1024` | below this, frames go out raw (the median DSH event is ~800 B) |
| `noContextTakeover` | `true` | independent deflate stream per frame: bounded memory, and a dropped frame cannot corrupt later messages. Costs ratio, buys robustness on a lossy link — which is the whole reason to run this plugin |
| `concurrencyLimit` | `10` | cap on simultaneous compress operations |
| `selfTest` | `true` | run the loopback handshake at activation. Not hot-reloadable |
| `maxLog` | `5` | how many successful negotiations to log; `0` is silent |

Everything except `selfTest` is `.volatile()`, so editing the patch and letting the profile hot-reload re-applies it without a restart.

## How it finds the gateway's `ws` copy

A plugin cannot `import 'ws'` and get the gateway's copy. The profile is a pnpm tree that contains no `ws` at all; declaring it as a dependency installs a **second** copy — a different class object, and patching it does nothing. Three routes, tried in this order, all tested:

1. **Ask the process.** The gateway's `ws` is in the CommonJS module cache; the class found there is provably the one the gateway uses (`cached === path-required: true`). Match on `ws/lib/websocket-server.js`, **not** `ws/index.js` — ws routes `import` to `wrapper.mjs`, which goes straight at the lib file, so `index.js` never enters the cache in an ESM host. Note `lib/websocket-server.js` does `module.exports = WebSocketServer`, so the export *is* the class.
2. **Guess the path.** Honours `$DSH_HOME` (precedence: configured path > `$DSH_HOME` > `~/.dsh`) and checks `<home>/profiles/node_modules/ws`, which dsh itself creates as a junction into the install tree — the most portable entry. Plus npm-global prefixes for Windows (`%APPDATA%\npm`), Linux (`/usr/local`, `/usr/lib`) and both macOS locations (`/usr/local`, `/opt/homebrew`).
3. **Retry for ~2 s.** If neither finds anything, retry every 250 ms (unref'd, so it can never hold the process open). This is what covers an install whose prefix is not in the list: by the time the gateway has loaded, route 1 works. Tested by neutralising every candidate (`DSH_HOME` + `APPDATA` + `argv[1]` pointed at empty dirs), activating — nothing patched — then loading the gateway late: `located ws on deferred attempt 2 … via require.cache`, self test OK.

### One thing that will confuse you, on purpose

`import 'dsh-ws-deflate'` from a plain `node` script **fails** with `Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/schemastery'`, even though the plugin loads fine inside `dsh`. That is not a bug to fix: dsh runs its own interception resolver (`dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js:1459` `scope === "installation"`, `:1479` `readPeerNames(...).has(name)`) and supplies declared peers from the installation tree. A fresh profile has no `schemastery` anywhere in it — verified on two platforms — and the plugin still activates. **So don't "verify" this plugin by importing it from a script; verify it by restarting `dsh web` and reading the log.**

## Tested on

| platform | node | dsh | ws | pnpm | result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Windows 10 | v24.20.0 | 0.2.0-rc.2 | 8.22.0 | 10.18.2 | live, 3 browser handshakes logged incl. macOS Safari |
| Linux | v22.19.0 | 0.2.0-rc.2 | 8.22.0 | 12.11.2 | clean-room: fresh profile from the shipped template, installed from a packed tarball, booted on :3099, self test OK |

Both were installed from a local tarball, not from the registry. One combination per platform — treat anything else as untested. The structural guard is `typeof WebSocketServer.prototype.handleUpgrad

plugins.description: DSH 插件：通过 SSH 连接远程主机，定位/拉取二进制或固件，调用 REA 做逆向分析。只分析不利用，支持 POSIX shell 目标，Windows 远端显式拒绝。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-remote-rea

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）生态插件：**远程连接 + 逆向分析** —— 连上远程主机，定位/拉取目标文件，
调用 REA（及其背后的 Ghidra / Hopper / IDA）做静态分析并回收结构化结果。

**只分析、不利用**：本插件不执行目标、不注入、不改写工件、不做任何利用动作。所有远端命令都先过
提权闸门（见「安全边界」）。

## 三个工具

| 工具 | 作用 | 关键入参 |
|---|---|---|
| `remote_hosts` | 主机库 CRUD：登记别名、认证方式、连通性 `test`、从 `~/.ssh/config` 导入 | `action` + `alias` … |
| `remote_fetch_binary` | 预检（存在 / 大小 / 类型 / sha256）→ 拉取 → 本地复算 sha 比对 → 写 JSON 报告 | `alias`、`remotePath`（绝对路径） |
| `remote_rea_analyze` | 拉取之后探测能力面、选 provider/operation、下发分析子命令、Evidence 落盘并出摘要 | `alias`、`remotePath`、可选 `provider` |

用之前必须先在 `remote_hosts` 里有别名 —— 主机库是这两个分析工具的前置条件，本插件不读任何外部口令。

`remote_rea_analyze` 不指定 `provider` 时自动路由，选路范围是
「REA 广告面 ∩ 已用 `--help` 核对过绑定的子命令」，两者取交集，缺一个就不下发。

## 支持范围

| 层面 | 支持 | 不支持时的行为 |
|---|---|---|
| 宿主 OS | Windows / macOS / Linux | 不可能不支持（`ssh2` 是纯 JS 实现，原生加速模块可选） |
| 宿主 Node | `>=18`（建议 20+） | 由 `package.json` 的 `engines.node` 声明；安装器告警，本插件自身不做版本检查 |
| 远程 OS | POSIX shell（Linux / macOS） | 运行时探测 `uname -s`，命中 `MINGW*`/`MSYS*`/`CYGWIN*`/`Windows*` 直接拒：`不支持的目标平台：Windows 远端，请使用 POSIX shell 目标` |
| 远程 Node | 22.19+ / 24.11+ / 26+（不支持 23 和 25） | 走 npx 前先探 `node --version`，不达标报一句话：`远端 <版本>；REA 要求 Node 22.19+ / 24.11+ / 26+（不支持 23 和 25）`，且**不下发任何 rea 命令** |
| 远程工具 | GNU coreutils，或可降级的子集 | 见下面「预检的降级路径」，每条都有兜底而不是直接失败 |

> 宿主 Node 的 `>=18` 是声明值，未在 18 上实测：本项目的开发/回归环境只有 Windows 侧 node 24.x
> 与 WSL 侧 node 22.22.1。用到的语法（ESM、可选链、空值合并、`node:` 前缀内置模块）都在 18 以内。

### 预检的降级路径

- `stat -c %s` 拿不到大小（BSD/macOS 的 `stat` 不认 `%s`）→ 退回 `wc -c <`；两条都失败 → `sizeBytes=null`。
- `file -b` 失败 → `fileType=null`，路由降级为「按扩展名猜类别」，note 里写明「未经格式头证实」；
  扩展名也认不出来就报 `未知类型：file -b 没有输出、扩展名也认不出来；深度分析需指定 provider`。
- 远端既没有全局 `rea` 也没有 `npx` → `远端无 npx，请安装 Node.js 22.19+ 或全局安装 rea`。
- 符号链接：`file -b` 回的是 `symbolic link to …`，而 `stat -c %s` 给的是链接字符串长度、
  `sha256sum`/SFTP 跟随目标 —— 所以链接目标的 `sizeMatches=null` + `sizeSkippedForSymlink=true`，**sha 才是权威**。

## 已知限制

- **Ghidra 路径已接，未实装验证。** 绑定表见 `rea-provider-router.js` 的 `GHIDRA_BINDINGS`（5 条，
  只有 `--help` 证据、没有任何一次真机跑通），因此**不参与自动选路**，只在调用方显式
  `provider:"ghidra"` 且 REA readiness 判它可用时才走。要实装需自备 **Ghidra 12.1.x** 解包目录并把
  `GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR` 指过去，外加 **JDK 21**（便携 JDK 也行，只要 PATH 上有 `java`）。
- **`analyze-javascript-application` 不在 capabilities 广告面**（providers / capabilities / doctor 三处都没有它），
  作为带标记的**手工例外**接入：`surface='manual-exception'`、`marker='manual-exception:not-advertised'`。
  它的 effects 是空的 —— 也就是「读文件还是写文件系统」REA 自己没说，本项目也不替它猜。
- **`rea-artifact-graph` 只做 inventory，`findings=0` 是结构性的**，不是「这个二进制很干净」：它的 Evidence
  方言里没有 `semantic_graph`，摘要层的 `dialect` 计数会把 `unexplored_branches` / `next_probes` 原样透传，
  深度要靠 Ghidra 那一条路。
- **冷缓存预热可能 50s 到 10 分钟不等**，取决于网络。实测区间 50–83s，但同一条路出现过 120s、420s，
  以及 2026-10-17 在 WSL 上实测的 **534s**（清缓存后用默认预算跑通整链）。`npxTimeoutMs` 因此定为 600000，
  可按调用覆盖。
- **`doctor` 原文不是字节稳定的**：`identity.installations.paths[0]` 会随 npx 缓存位置变化，所以本项目
  不对 doctor 原文做逐字节断言，只按 evidence_id / 字段取用。
- **`@latest` 可能漂移**：`npx --yes rea-agents@latest` 每次解析到的版本可能不同。遇到缓存或行为对不上，
  可把远端命令手动锁成 `rea-agents@<版本>`。
- **`pnpm peers check` 的 missing peer 是静态误报**：DSH profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 设了
  `autoInstallPeers: false`，pnpm 只看 profile 自己的 `package.json`，看不到上层
  `profiles/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/`，于是报 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` / `@deepseek-ai/cordis` 缺失。
  实测：那两个 peer 由 DSH 运行时自带 —— `profiles/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/{cordis,dsh-tools}`
  是指向全局 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 内嵌依赖的符号链接（本机解析到 cordis 4.0.2、dsh-tools 0.1.5-rc.2）。
  插件是从 tarball 解出来的**真实目录**，从它内部 `import.meta.resolve()` 向上走就能命中；
  已装的 dsh-dolphin-security 报的是同一类误报。**只要实际版本落在 peer 范围内，这条警告可以忽略。**

## 跨平台说明

- 开发环境用 **WSL 做真机测试**：Windows → WSL2 的 2222 portproxy 需要管理员权限才能修，本机没修，
  所以 Windows 侧只跑离线套件（逻辑层 + 假 engine），真机套件在 WSL 内部跑。
- `cpu-features` 构建失败**不影响功能**：`ssh2` 把它列为可选加速模块，装不上就退回纯 JS 实现，只是性能略降。
  （这条是 ssh2 上游行为 + 本项目 `loadSsh2`/`isSsh2Available` 的容错设计；我们没有专门实测过构建失败的安装。）
- `REVERSE_HOME` 用**当前 OS 的路径风格**：Windows 上是 `D:\...`，POSIX 上是 `/...`，本项目不做路径翻译。

## 安全边界

- **只分析、不利用**：没有执行目标、注入、patch、改写工件的任何入口。
- **提权硬闸门**：每条远端命令下发前过 `assertNoPrivilegeEscalation`，命中 `sudo` 或
  `--break-system-packages` 直接抛错、不下发（`remote-shell-utils.js`）。探测类命令 `attempts` 固定为 1，
  不做重放 —— 下发前无法确认幂等。
- **`mutates_artifact` 的操作不会被选中**，机制要说准：REA 广告面里确实有带它的组
  （`annotate_native_function`、`set_address_name(s)`、`set_bookmark` / `set_comment` / `set_inline_comment` /
  `unset_bookmark`），但选路的必要条件是「该操作有已核对的 CLI 绑定」，而绑定表里一条写类操作都没有。
  也就是说这是**靠白名单实现的，不是运行期按 effects 拦截**；`effects` 只如实透传进 `route.reason` 给你看。
- **口令不进工具参数**：`authKind=password` 只接受一个环境变量名 `passwordEnv`，口令本体留在宿主进程环境里 ——
  作为参数传会进会话记录。列表/详情回的是脱敏投影（`auth.kind`），不回显口令或私钥内容。

## A 路（Ghidra 深分析）绑定表

| operation | 子命令（`--help` 原文形状） | address |
|---|---|---|
| `analyze_function` | `rea function <path> [address] [options]` | 可选 |
| `procedure_pseudo_code` | `rea decompile <path> [address] [options]` | 可选 |
| `procedure_assembly` | `rea instructions <path> [address] [options]` | 可选 |
| `xrefs` | `rea xrefs <path> [address] [options]` | 可选 |
| `read_bytes` | `rea read-bytes <path> <address> [options]` | **必填 → 只登记不下发** |

Ghidra 不可用时，错误信息用的是 REA 自己的原文（`Set GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR to an extracted Ghidra 12.1.x
release directory.` ＋ `install_dir / analyze_headless_path / java_command / java_home` 的诊断原值），
本项目不自己编修法。深分析 provider 的 session 是 ephemeral（导入的 Program 与临时工程在 close 时删除），
所以 Evidence 一解析出来就当场落盘。

## 落盘位置

数据根 = `$REVERSE_HOME`（回退 `$DSH_HOME`，再回退 `~/.reverse`）：

- 报告：`<数据根>/reports/fetch-<alias>-<ts>.json`、`analyze-<alias>-<ts>.json`
- 拉取的目标：`<数据根>/targets/<文件名>`
- Evidence：按 `evidence_id` 落盘（`<数据根>/evidence/<evidence_id>.json`），路径写在报告的
  `analysis.evidencePath`；落的是 stdout 里那一行**原始字节**，不重新格式化。

工具返回体里不放远端原始 stdout，也不放全量 Evidence（真机 5.6KB ~ 75KB），只放摘要与路径。

## 安装与挂载

```bash
cd <DSH home> && DSH_HOME=<DSH home> dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-remote-rea
cd <项目根> && DSH_HOME=<DSH home> dsh --profile web --host 127.0.0.1 --no-open
```

`ssh2` / `cpu-features` 需要构建许可：pnpm 11 的门禁会拦依赖的构建脚本
（`ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS`，退出码 1），要在 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 里加上

```yaml
allowBuilds:
  cpu-features: true
  ssh2: true
```

装完要重启 `dsh web` 并强制刷新浏览器。桌面端（`desktop` profile）由 Electron 独占管理，
命令行装插件会被拒（`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`），
入口是应用内的插件管理器。

## 测试

```bash
node test/run-tests.mjs              # 3a 本地解析层
node test/run-probe-tests.mjs        # 3b 远端能力面探测（--offline 只跑逻辑层）
node test/run-deploy-tests.mjs       # 第 4 步 部署链
node test/run-controller-tests.mjs   # 第 5 步 runFetch
node test/run-analyze-tests.mjs      # 第 6 步 runAnalyze（--cold 额外跑破坏性冷缓存）
node test/run-plugin-tests.mjs       # 第 7 步 插件契约 + 跨平台补丁 + A 路
```

需要真机的套件走 `--alias=<别名> --store=<主机库路径>`，别名先用 `remote_hosts` 或主机库脚本登记。

## 许可与第三方声明

本项目以 MIT 发布（`LICENSE`）。`remote-ssh-core.js` 派生自 dsh-web 的 `dsh-ssh`（Apache-2.0），
`remote-shell-utils.js` 派生自 dsh-dolphin-security（MIT，同作者）—— 逐函数的来源位置、修改内容与
许可证原文见 `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` 与 `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES/`。

技术债与已知限制的单子在同目录 `TECH_DEBT.md`。

plugins.description: DSH Desktop plugin: hold Ctrl and tap Tab to switch between recently viewed sessions; release the modifier to open the highlighted one. Ctrl+Shift+Tab cycles backwards.
plugins.readme_text:
# Session Switcher

English overview below · 完整详细文档为简体中文，见 [中文说明](#中文说明)

Session Switcher (`dsh-session-switcher`) is a plugin for **DSH Desktop** that brings hold-to-switch navigation to your recently viewed sessions. Hold `Ctrl` and tap `Tab` to open a floating list of recent sessions with the next target highlighted; tap `Tab` again to move down, then release the modifier(s) to open the highlighted session (`Ctrl+Shift+Tab` moves backwards and `Esc` cancels). The highlight moves while the modifier is held, so you can skip past sessions before committing on release. It is built for DSH Desktop: in a browser tab `Ctrl+Tab` belongs to the browser, so the plugin won't fire there.

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Hold `Ctrl`, tap `Tab` | Open the list and highlight the next recently viewed session; tap again to move down |
| `Ctrl` + `Shift` + `Tab` | Move the highlight backwards |
| Release the modifier(s) | Open the highlighted session and close the list |
| `Esc` | Cancel without switching |
| `Enter` / click a row | Open that session immediately |
| `↑` / `↓` | Move the highlight while the list is open |
| Click outside / window blur | Cancel |

## 安装 / Installation

### 从插件管理器安装（推荐）/ Install from the plugin manager

The plugin is a normal DSH bundle, so DSH's own plugin manager can install and enable it:

1. Open the **Plugins** page in DSH (the plugin manager page in the sidebar; 中文界面为「插件」).
2. Select **Add plugin** → **Install a third-party plugin**（「添加插件」→「安装第三方插件」）.
3. Enter the repository address and select **Install**:

   ```text
   https://github.com/Yporcupine/dsh-session-switcher
   ```

4. If DSH asks for a restart, restart DSH Desktop. The installer adds the dependency to your profile and enables the bundle for you; no manual configuration is needed.

To disable or uninstall the plugin later, use the same **Plugins** page.

### 命令行安装 / Install with the CLI

The same installation is available from the `dsh` CLI:

```bash
dsh plugin add https://github.com/Yporcupine/dsh-session-switcher
```

Use `--profile <name>` to target a specific profile (for example `dsh plugin --profile desktop add ...`). The CLI may ask you to restart DSH afterwards. You can also install the release tarball — paste the download link of the `dsh-session-switcher-1.3.0.tgz` asset from the [Releases page](https://github.com/Yporcupine/dsh-session-switcher/releases) into the same dialog or command.

### 本地开发安装 / Local checkout (development)

To hack on the plugin, run a checkout as a linked bundle. Prefer DSH's own installer — it writes the `link:` dependency **and** runs the profile's package install, so the checkout is linked into the profile; editing the manifest by hand alone skips that step and the bundle is skipped at startup.

1. Clone the repository into your DSH bundles directory (`~/.dsh/bundles/`; Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\bundles\`):

   ```bash
   # macOS / Linux
   git clone https://github.com/Yporcupine/dsh-session-switcher.git ~/.dsh/bundles/session-switcher
   ```

   ```powershell
   # Windows (PowerShell)
   git clone https://github.com/Yporcupine/dsh-session-switcher.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\bundles\session-switcher"
   ```

2. Install the checkout through the same add-plugin flow, pointing it at the local directory: **Plugins** page → **Add plugin** → **Install a third-party plugin** → enter the absolute path of the checkout (`/home/<you>/.dsh/bundles/session-switcher`, `/Users/<you>/.dsh/bundles/session-switcher`, or `C:/Users/<you>/.dsh/bundles/session-switcher`). Or use the CLI:

   ```bash
   dsh plugin --profile desktop add /home/<you>/.dsh/bundles/session-switcher
   ```

   DSH records a `link:` dependency, installs it into the profile, and enables the bundle.

3. Restart DSH Desktop. After later edits to the checkout, restart DSH Desktop (or disable and re-enable the bundle on the **Plugins** page) to remount the client module.

#### 手动回退 / Fallback: edit the profile manifest by hand

Only if the installer cannot be used. Edit the DSH Desktop profile manifest, `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` (Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json`), to add the dependency and the bundle selection:

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-session-switcher": "link:/home/<you>/.dsh/bundles/session-switcher"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["...", "dsh-session-switcher"]
    }
  }
}
```

Use the absolute path of your clone: `/home/<you>/...` on Linux, `/Users/<you>/...` on macOS, `C:/Users/<you>/...` on Windows (JSON paths use forward slashes on every OS); from the profile directory the relative form `link:../../bundles/session-switcher` resolves to the same location. Then relink and reinstall the profile — without this the linked package never reaches `node_modules` and the bundle is skipped:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop install
```

Restart DSH Desktop afterwards.

> **浏览器 / Browser:** the shortcuts target DSH Desktop. In a browser tab `Ctrl+Tab` belongs to the browser, so the plugin won't fire there.

## 中文说明

DSH Desktop 插件：按住 `Ctrl` 敲 `Tab`，弹出「最近会话」浮动小窗，高亮待切换的会话；
**松开修饰键即打开高亮会话**并收起小窗。

| 操作 | 效果 |
| --- | --- |
| `Ctrl+Tab`（按住 Ctrl 连按 Tab） | 打开浮动窗，高亮「下一个最近查看的会话」；继续按 Tab 依次下移 |
| `Ctrl+Shift+Tab` | 反向移动高亮 |
| 松开修饰键 | 打开高亮会话，关闭小窗 |
| `Esc` | 取消，不切换 |
| `Enter` / 鼠标点击某一行 | 立即打开该会话 |
| `↑` / `↓` | 移动高亮（小窗打开时） |
| 点击小窗外 / 窗口失焦 | 取消 |

- 插件按 DSH Desktop 设计：浏览器里 `Ctrl+Tab` 归浏览器所有，插件不会被触发。
- macOS 同样使用 `Ctrl+Tab` / `Ctrl+Shift+Tab`（`Cmd+Tab` 是系统应用切换，应用收不到）。

### 实现要点：为什么用 fixed 输入而不是可编辑快捷键

DSH Desktop 的**原生键盘桥**会先于页面拦截「可编辑快捷键」的按键组合，然后 Electron
会吞掉随后的**修饰键 keyup**（DSH 官方 shortcuts 文档的 “Understand the implementation” 一节
也说明：Electron 在原生拦截之后可能省略 keyup）。一旦 `Ctrl` 的 keyup 到不了页面，浮动窗就无法知道「Ctrl 已松开」，
只能等下一次按键——这正是早期版本「松开 Ctrl 无反应、要再按一次 Ctrl 才切换」的根因
（已用合成按键 + UI Automation 实测复现：`Ctrl+Tab`、`Ctrl+B` 等任何可编辑快捷键之后
都收不到 `keyup`）。

因此 `Ctrl+Tab` / `Ctrl+Shift+Tab` 注册为 **fixed 输入动作**（`ctx.shortcuts.registerFixed`
+ `ctx.shortcuts.observeFixedInput`）：fixed 动作不走原生桥拦截，留在正常的 DOM 输入路径，
修饰键 keyup 可以正常收到，于是「松手提交」可靠。代价是这两行在
**Settings → Keyboard shortcuts**（`Mod+/`）里显示为只读条目（Application 分组，键帽
`Ctrl + Tab` / `Ctrl + Shift + Tab`），不能改键；不想要时停用/卸载插件即可。

#### 为什么点击行曾「只关窗、不切换」（已修复）

DSH 的 shortcuts 服务在**每个 `pointerdown`** 上都会给 fixed 输入观察者发一次
`{ type: "reset" }`（用于中断多键序列）。早期版本把 reset 一律当作取消：鼠标按下瞬间
小窗就被卸载，行的 React `click` 永远来不及触发——于是「点一下小窗消失，但会话没切换」。
现在的做法是：在 **window 捕获阶段**（早于 shortcuts 服务的 document 捕获 reset）先判断
这次按下是否落在小窗内；**落在窗内的按下不算取消**，只吞掉紧接着的 reset，让行正常收到
click 并切换；点到窗外仍然立即取消。松开指针（`pointerup`/`pointercancel`）后恢复常规
reset 行为。

### 参考实现

当前 ChatGPT / Codex 桌面端（2026，版本 26）把 `Ctrl+Tab` 定义为 **“Next recently viewed chat”**，
`Ctrl+Shift+Tab` 为 **“Previous recently viewed chat”**（另有 `Ctrl+PageDown/PageUp`、
`Ctrl+Shift+]`/`[` 等别名）；Codex 应用更新日志也提到加入了「跳转到最近线程的键盘快捷键」。
本插件按这个语义实现：

- 列表 = **最近查看顺序（MRU）**：当前会话 → 查看历史（最近查看的在前）→ 其余会话按侧边栏
  最近更新排序；每次查看会话都会更新查看历史；
- 按住修饰键时只移动高亮，**松开才切换**（VS Code / Alt-Tab 式 hold-modifier switcher）；
- 列表跳过已归档会话和子代理（subagent）会话；当前未开始的新会话排在最前。

参考链接：

- <https://defkey.com/chatgpt-windows-app-2026-shortcuts>（ChatGPT Windows App 26.x 快捷键表）
- <https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/changelog?type=codex-app>（Codex app 更新日志）

### 样式

面板沿用 DSH 菜单样式：`--dsw-specific-menu` 表面、`--dsw-elevation-prominent` 阴影、
`--dsw-radius-xl` 圆角、`--dsw-alias-state-business-primary` 选中强调色，跟随明暗主题；
行内显示会话标题、所属工作区与相对时间，当前会话带「当前」标记。

某一行的会话**正在运行**（active turn）时，行右侧显示一个 14px 的旋转圆圈，复用 DSH
侧边栏 `StateDot` 的 ongoing 外观：1.5s 线性旋转 + 1.5s 虚线弧动画，描边继承
`--dsw-alias-label-tertiary`；`prefers-reduced-motion` 下两段动画停止、弧固定。运行状态
来自 frame 槽作用域提供的 `useSessionStatus` 钩子（实时订阅），取不到时回退到会话列表
快照里的 `running` 提示；它会和「当前」标记并排显示，但始终位于最右侧。

### 文件

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` | 包清单：`dsh.bundle.patch` 声明 bundle 补丁，`dsh.client` 声明浏览器半体 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 向 profile 配置树插入 Host 行 `session-switcher` |
| `index.js` | Host 半体（无需挂载任何服务，空 `apply`） |
| `client.js` | 浏览器半体：fixed 输入动作 + `shell.overlay` 浮动窗 + 页面级 keyup/keydown 负责「松手提交 / Esc 取消」，并订阅会话列表维护最近查看顺序；window 捕获阶段区分「点中面板」与「点外取消」；运行中的会话行右侧渲染 `useSessionStatus` 旋转圆圈；内置中英文运行时文案 |
| `locale/*.json` | 插件市场/设置页里的标题与描述（中英文） |
| `icon.svg` | 插件图标 |
| `verify-client.cjs` | 本地校验脚本（不参与运行时）：用桩 React/DOM/服务执行真实 `client

plugins.description: Give the whole left column back to the conversation on narrow screens: below 1024px the DSH sidebar leaves the frame entirely and a header button opens it as an overlay drawer.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mobile-sidebar

Give the whole left column back to the conversation on phones.

## What it changes

Below **1024px** — the same breakpoint at which `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout`
auto-collapses the sidebar — the stock web shell still keeps a **56px icon rail**
(`computeColumns()` resolves the collapsed track to `collapsedWidth`, which is 56 on
the web; only macOS desktop and the Windows titlebar shell pass 0). On a 390px
viewport that rail eats 14% of the screen for a column you cannot read anything in.

This plugin, under the same breakpoint:

| | stock | with the plugin |
|---|---|---|
| frame tracks at 390px | `56px 334px 0px` | `0px 390px 0px` |
| collapsed sidebar | 56px icon rail | nothing — no track, no paint |
| opening the sidebar | squeezes the centre to 110px | 300px drawer over a 390px centre, tap outside to close |
| header | no toggle | panel-left button at the header's leading edge |
| ≥ 1024px | — | untouched (`280px 1000px 0px`, button hidden) |

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/dsh-mobile-sidebar
```

`dsh plugin add` appends the package to `dsh.profile.bundles` and hot-mounts it;
the browser only needs a **refresh** to load the new client combo. No `dsh web`
restart is required.

To remove it, delete the `"dsh-mobile-sidebar"` entry from `bundles` in
`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json`, or disable the bundle from the Plugins
page.

## How it works

Everything is browser-side; the Host half is intentionally empty.

1. **Zero the sidebar track.** React writes `grid-template-columns` as an inline
   style, and a media query cannot override one track of it. A `MutationObserver`
   on the frame watches every solve, rewrites the value with **only the first
   track** replaced, and republishes it through the
   `--dsh-mobile-frame-cols` custom property. The centre and right tracks still
   matter between 800px and 1024px, where the right panel solves a real third
   track, so they are carried through untouched.
2. **Hide the rail without leaving the grid.** `visibility: hidden`, *not*
   `display: none`. A `display:none` box is not a grid item, so auto-placement
   slides the centre column into the now-0px first track and the conversation
   renders at zero width.
3. **Open as a drawer.** The column stays a grid item in its 0px track and simply
   overflows it (`position: relative` + an explicit width), so the centre column
   never changes width. A scrim in the `shell.overlay` slot closes it on tap.
4. **The toggle.** On the Conversation it is a primitives `Button` +
   `IconPanelLeftOutlineRegular` in the `conversation.header.leading` slot, calling
   `ctx.layout.toggleSidebar()`.

## Global panels (Plugins, Automation tasks, …)

The Conversation is the **only** panel that declares a header slot. Every other
global panel registers into the keyed `main` slot and builds its own heading —
Plugins renders `<header class="…pageHead">`, Schedules renders
`<div class="…pageHeading">`, and neither exposes anything to inject into.

So the toggle falls back to a fixed control rendered in `shell.overlay`, which
the shell always mounts at root scope. That covers every panel at once, including
panels that do not exist yet. Two rules keep it honest:

- **It steps aside on the Conversation.** `[frame]:not(:has([data-dsh-mobile-sidebar-button]))`
  is what hides it there, so the in-header button and the floating one never
  appear together.
- **It reserves its own lane.** Panel headings all start 28px down and 24px in,
  so the control would sit on the title's shoulder; a rule adds 40px of
  `padding-inline-start` to those headings while the control is present.

| where | control |
|---|---|
| Conversation | `conversation.header.leading` slot |
| Plugins / Schedules / any future panel | fixed control in `shell.overlay` |
| ≥ 1024px | neither |

## Screenshots

Closed on a phone — the rail is gone and the conversation keeps the full width:

![Mobile with the sidebar closed](docs/mobile-sidebar-hidden.png)

Tapping the header toggle opens the drawer over that same full-width conversation:

![Sidebar open as a drawer](docs/mobile-sidebar-drawer.png)

On a global panel the toggle falls back to a fixed control:

![Toggle fallback on the Plugins panel](docs/mobile-panel-toggle.png)

Above the breakpoint nothing changes:

![Desktop layout unchanged](docs/desktop-unchanged.png)

## Upgrades

The plugin targets source-written attributes, not the shell's CSS-module class
names (which are build-hashed and change between DSH releases):

- `[data-shell-overlay]` — the frame is its parent element
- `[data-slot="sidebar"]` — the sidebar column is its parent element
- `[data-sidebar-collapsed]` on the frame — closed vs. open
- `[data-plugin-panel]` — the one global panel that marks its section; the rest
  are matched on the `_pageHead` / `_pageHeading` class fragment

## License

MIT

plugins.description: 让文本模型读懂一首歌：本地音乐分析插件，把音频拆成能量、速度、调性、密度，音频不出本机。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-soundcheck

> 文本模型看不见声音。这个插件把一首歌拆成它能读的东西。

丢一首本地音频给它，它把能量、速度、调性、编曲密度量一遍，
再合成一段人话——哪里最满、哪一下反差最大、收尾是淡出还是硬切。

**它不是让模型"听见"，是让模型"读懂"。** 没有多模态，也能对一首歌说上话；
代价是它只知道结构，不知道声音长什么样——人声、歌词、乐器只给方向，
能说的和不能说的它都会标出来。

说白了：**给一首歌做体检**。时长、响度、有没有削波、拍速、调性这些硬指标它说得比较准。

**音频不出本机。** 没有上传、没有联网、没有云端分析。

---

## 它真能帮上什么

不是吹的，下面这些是从实际对话里试出来的：

**一首老钢琴曲**，它能说出：
> 4 分 10 秒、99 拍；D# 大调但不太稳；前 16 秒几乎空着，之后一路铺满；
> 2:24 之后越往后越密；3:12 抽空 18 dB，3:28 又砸回来；4:00 淡出但底下还有东西。

它报告里说的那三件事，在曲线上就是三个点：

![能量曲线：3:12 抽空、3:28 砸回、4:00 淡出](docs/energy-piano.png)

**一首古筝领奏的器乐**：
> 慢热型：前 32 秒铺垫，1:52 最密，2:24 开始加厚，4:32 塌下去、4:48 硬收尾。
> 和声一直在 D–E–F# 上打转，听感偏五声。

它还押了一句"民族/东方融合、偏配乐或国风电子"——**方向是对的，但这是推断，不是测量**。

**一份只有鼓和贝斯的半成品**：
> 低频占满、中高频空着；峰值 −3.7 dBFS、整体 −21.8 dBFS，还有 6–8 dB 余量。

这种"还差多少电平"的判断，对做混音的人最直接。

它不是在"听懂"，它是把能量、密度、调性这些量出来，再合成一段判断。

---

## 它是怎么做到的

本机解码，然后算几样东西：

- **能量曲线**：16 秒一块，绝对 dBFS，不归一化；
- **节拍**：两条独立算法交叉验证，所以能发现"半速/双倍速"；
- **调性**：Krumhansl 模板 + 候选排序，模板不适用时会直说；
- **和弦**：只到根音级，不硬猜大/小三度和七度；
- **编曲密度**：起音密度、频谱变化率，用来判断"满不满"；
- **声源**：一个 16 MB 的小模型看"像什么"，只当方向。

最后把这些合成三段：`[判断]`（结论）、`[依据]`（数字）、`[可信]`（哪些能信）。

没有大模型，不联网，音频不出本机。

你看到的三个能力，其实是三种问法：

- `audio_analyze` —— 整首
- `audio_section` —— 某一段
- `audio_provision` —— 装运行环境（`/audio-install` 背后就是它，也可以让助手直接调）

---

## 装

**需要**：Windows、Python 3.10+（命令行能跑 `python -V`）、约 550 MB 磁盘、第一次要联网。

**三种装法，选一个：**

1. DSH 插件管理界面 → 从本地文件夹安装
2. 命令行：
   ```
   dsh plugin --profile desktop add "<你解压出来的目录>"
   ```
3. 直接跟 DSH 说："把这个插件装上，目录是 ……"，让它自己装。

装完**重启 DSH**。

然后装运行环境——**这一步不会自己偷偷开始**，得你点一下：

- 在 DSH 里输入 **`/audio-install`**（`/` 菜单里能看到，带说明）
- 它会告诉你：要下约 **470 MB**（librosa + onnxruntime + 16 MB 模型），大概几分钟，走国内镜像
- 装完再输入 **`/audio-status`** 可以确认状态

不想点也行，直接跟 DSH 说："帮我把音频插件的引擎装好"——它会自己从头装到尾，不用你敲命令。

之后每次分析只要几秒。

---

## 怎么问

不用记命令，像跟人说话就行：

- "这首歌怎么样？"
- "副歌在哪？哪一段最满？"
- "2:40 到 3:10 这段怎么回事？"
- "速度多少？什么调？"
- "这歌是什么风格？"

追问 **"为什么"** 会给数字；追问 **"像什么"** 会给方向，并标上"这是推断"。

还有个好用的问法：**"如果我猜错了，应该听到什么？"** —— 它会给你一个反证条件，你听一遍就能否掉。

---

## 一句提醒

这是个**轻量**插件，没有大模型撑着。

结构、速度、响度、调性这些硬信息，它说得比较准；乐器和风格只能给方向——别拿它当严谨鉴定，尤其别拿它断中文乐器和细分流派。

---

## 许可

MIT。

第三方依赖与模型（librosa、scipy、onnxruntime、YAMNet 等）的许可见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

plugins.description: Delete DSH (DeepSeek Harness) sessions and workspace data from the Web GUI — a per-session Delete menu row, a management settings page with sizes, and a restorable trash.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-manager

English | [فارسی](README.fa.md)

**Session deletion for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI.**

DSH can archive sessions but never delete them — the shipped persistence layer
has no deletion API, and workspace deletion keeps every session log on disk.
This plugin fills that gap:

- **Sidebar** — every session's `…` menu gets a **Delete…** row (after the
  shipped *Copy Session ID*), with a confirmation dialog.
- **Settings → Session Manager** — a management page listing every registered
  workspace and every orphaned directory with per-session sizes, event counts,
  and dates: per-row delete, checkbox bulk delete, and *Delete workspace data…*
  (removes the registration **and** its session logs).
- **Trash, not `rm`** — deleted session directories are *moved* to
  `$DSH_HOME/trash/sessions/<timestamp>--<id>/` with a `manifest.json`, so the
  settings page can **Restore** them until you *Empty trash*.

## How it works

```
┌──────────────────────┐  same-origin fetch   ┌─────────────────────────────┐
│ lib/client.js        │ ───────────────────▶ │ lib/index.js (Host half)    │
│  • menu slot row     │  /session-manager-…  │  • authenticated HTTP route │
│  • settings page     │ ◀────────────────── │  • workspaceRegistry        │
└──────────────────────┘      JSON           │  • sessionPersistence       │
                                             │  • archive → move to trash │
                                             └─────────────────────────────┘
```

Third-party client bundles get no package RPC channel in DSH (the Remote
namespaces are fixed at build time), so the two halves talk over the plugin's
own HTTP route registered through `ctx.webServer` — the documented
route-owner pattern. Every request passes the same browser trust fence as the
shipped `/api` route (`ctx.connection.requestRejection`), so only an
authenticated DSH page can call it; the browser's signed cookie rides the
same-origin `fetch` automatically.

Deletion flow per session: refuse if live → archive through
`workspaceRegistry.archiveSession` (so the row leaves the sidebar's default
*Hide archived* view immediately) → `rename` the session directory into the
trash → drop the empty project directory. Workspace purge: refuse if any of
its sessions is live → `workspaceRegistry.delete` → move every session
directory of that path to the trash.

## Install

Install straight from this repository — a Git address is a valid plugin spec:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/mehdinikzad68/dsh-session-manager
```

or paste the same URL into the Web GUI's **Plugins → Add plugin** dialog. For a
local checkout, pass the package directory's path instead. The bundle is
enabled on install: profiles with `patchReload: live` mount it without a
restart, while startup-only profiles (such as the Desktop profile) need one
DSH restart.

## Safety

- A **live** session (present in the in-memory session store or the agent
  registry) is always refused — stop it first.
- Deletion is a move, never an unlink: everything is recoverable from the
  trash until *Empty trash*.
- The HTTP API enforces DSH's browser authentication (401/403 otherwise).

## Limitations

- The sessions root is derived as `$DSH_HOME/sessions` (default `~/.dsh/sessions`).
  A profile that configures a different persistence `root` is not detected
  (v0.1).
- Session titles come from cached projection hints; sessions without hints
  show their id.
- `restore` recreates the directory (and unarchives if we archived it), but a
  workspace whose registration was purged must be re-registered by opening
  the folder again.
- After a delete, the sidebar hides the row via archive; the session summary
  disappears from lists on the next refresh.

## License

MIT © Mehdi Nikzad

plugins.description: Session trash for DeepSeek Harness Desktop: move sessions to a recoverable trash from the sidebar, restore or purge them from a settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-trash — Session Trash for DeepSeek Harness Desktop

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Move a session into a recoverable trash from the sidebar, then restore or permanently purge it from **Settings → Session Trash**.

![Session Trash icon](icon.svg)

## Why

Harness keeps every session log forever. `sessionPersistence` has no deletion API — “Nothing deletes session files” — and the workspace registry only archives (the log stays on disk). This plugin adds the missing capability in the safest shape it can take: a **recoverable** move, a **user-only** trigger, and no path ever crossing the wire.

## What it does

| Where | What |
|---|---|
| Session row → `…` menu | **Move to trash**, using the host's own `MenuItemButton` geometry (same height, padding, icon cell and label rhythm) with its danger colouring; the dialog's destructive confirm is the host's outline-with-red-text pattern, and its cancel is outline |
| Settings → **Session Trash** | List of deleted sessions with **Restore** and **Purge**; **Empty trash** |
| Host startup | Deletes entries older than `retentionDays` (default 30), silently |

A deletion **moves the session's directory** with a single `rename` into `$DSH_HOME/session-trash/<UTC stamp>-<session id>/` and writes a `manifest.json` beside it. Nothing is copied, so an interruption cannot leave a half-deleted session; a failed move leaves both directories exactly as they were.

## Current limitations

- **The client half is not rebuilt for a linked install.** This bundle ships plain JavaScript for both halves (no build step), so a directory install loads it as-is. Editing the installed bundle's files in place is picked up on the next page load; the Host half needs a plugin reload or a Harness restart.
- Sessions are matched by their encoded id inside `$DSH_HOME/sessions/<project>/`, which is the shipped JSONL backend's layout. A different persistence backend would need its own locator.
- Attachments referenced by a deleted log are not reclaimed, and projection-cache rows are left to self-heal; both are documented under *Scope*.

## Install

The plugin is a normal Harness bundle. Install it like any other:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:xxiiiixx/dsh-session-trash
```

Or, from a local checkout, point Plugin Manager at the directory (Settings → Plugins → Add, or `plugin_manager` with `install_bundle`). The row it inserts is named `dsh-session-trash`; the plugin is enabled immediately.

Restart Harness if Plugin Manager reports `restart-required`.

## Configuration

The bundle patch resolves both roots from the DSH home, so the defaults below need no editing. Override them in the profile's own patch layer:

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `sessionsRoot` | `$DSH_HOME/sessions` | Where the session backend stores logs |
| `trashRoot` | `$DSH_HOME/session-trash` | Where deleted sessions are moved; must be on the same volume as `sessionsRoot` |
| `retentionDays` | `30` | Automatic purge age; `0` disables the sweep |
| `sweepOnStart` | `true` | Run the retention sweep once per Host start |
| `maxTrashEntries` | `500` | Refuse new deletions above this count; `0` means unlimited |

```yaml
- id: dsh-session-trash
  name: 'dsh-session-trash'
  config:
    retentionDays: 90
```

## Safety model

Deleting a session is destructive, so the implementation spends most of its code on refusals rather than on the delete itself.

1. **Recoverable by default.** A deletion is a move, not an unlink. Purging is a separate, explicit action inside the trash page.
2. **No path crosses the wire.** The client sends `{ op, sessionId }` or `{ op, trashId }`. The Host resolves identifiers against its own roots; there is no `path` field to smuggle.
3. **Identifiers are whitelisted** (`^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$`, ≤ 200 chars, never `.`/`..`) and every resolved path is checked with `path.relative` after `realpath`, so a symlink or a crafted id cannot escape a root.
4. **Directories prove their identity.** Before moving anything the plugin reads the log's header line and refuses unless `header.id` matches the requested session.
5. **Only a running turn blocks a delete.** Liveness is read exactly the way the shipped archive action reads it: the session's Agent counts as busy only while its `status` is `running` (a turn in flight, including one waiting for an approval). An idle Agent that merely stays resident in the registry does **not** block — a session you already stopped is deletable. A session with child sessions yields `has-children` and its directory is untouched. An Agent surface that cannot report a status is treated as running, so the plugin never guesses its way into moving a log that may still be written.
6. **`rename` only, never copy-then-delete.** `EXDEV`, `EPERM`, `EBUSY` are reported as `cross-volume` / `busy`; no fallback exists that could leave a duplicate or a partial copy.
7. **Serialized mutations.** One promise chain per service, plus a re-run of every preflight immediately before the move, which closes the window between the dialog and the action.
8. **No agent tool.** The Host half registers no tool at all. Only a person clicking the UI can delete a session; the model cannot.
9. **One endpoint, behind the standard fence.** `POST /api/session-trash` is mounted on `ctx.connection.fetch`, so it inherits Harness's Host/Origin and browser-credential checks. Bodies are capped at 64 KiB, operations are a closed set, and failures answer with a stable `code` plus a fixed sentence — never a filesystem path.
10. **The Host log is the source of truth.** Deletion drops the session from the workspace pin/archive sets and emits `api-session/removed`, which is the same event the sidebar already listens for; the row disappears immediately without any plugin-private state.

## Scope

- **Allowed:** any session that is not running and has no child sessions.
- **Refused:** a running session, a session with children, a directory that is not provably that session, anything outside the configured root.
- **Not touched:** attachments referenced by the deleted log (the attachment store is global and immutable), and the projection cache rows (they are hints only and self-heal).

## Verify

```bash
npm test     # node --test: paths, config, trash service, HTTP route
```

The suite builds throwaway session roots with real Zstandard logs, then asserts: read-only preflight, identity mismatch refusal, live/child refusals, atomic move, manifest round-trip, restore collision, purge containment (`../../etc` is rejected), corrupt-manifest handling, retention sweep, capacity refusal, serialized concurrency, and every HTTP status/code pair.

## Layout

```text
index.js            Host entry: settings, route, startup sweep
lib/paths.js        Path and identifier safety (pure functions)
lib/config.js       Config resolution and root disjointness
lib/sessions.js     Read-only location, header parsing, blockers
lib/trash.js        The only destructive module
lib/routes.js       The single POST endpoint
client.js           Sidebar row, confirmation dialog, settings page
locale/{en,zh}.json Plugin inventory metadata
```

## License

MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: 小舞 · DSH 桌宠：原创 SVG 手绘兔耳少女，跟随 agent 状态换动作，运行时合成甜声说「做完啦……」。无任何外部素材或录音。
plugins.readme_text:
# 小舞 · DSH 桌宠（dsh-plugin-xiaowu）

一个常驻 DSH Web 界面右下角的桌面宠物插件。她会跟着当前会话里 agent 的工作状态换动作，
任务做完的时候跳起来撒花，并且用一段**运行时合成的甜美声音**说一句「做完啦……」。
声音不是任何录音或采样：全部由 WebAudio 振荡器实时合成（详见下面「声音设计」）。

> 角色形象是按「斗罗大陆里那位兔耳少女」的气质**原创绘制**的 SVG 小人（粉发、兔耳、长辫、
> 白色兔耳发饰、粉色裙装），不是任何动画素材或截图的搬运。

## 原创说明

这是本人（jxboop）的原创作品：

- **形象**：纯手写 SVG 绘制的 chibi 小人。粉发、兔耳、长辫、白色兔耳发饰、粉白连衣裙，
  都是一条条 `<path>` / `<circle>` 画出来的，没有使用任何动画截图、贴图或第三方素材。
  气质上致敬「斗罗大陆」里的兔耳少女小舞，但**不是**该作品的官方形象，也没有搬运其素材。
- **动作**：七个心情各自的 keyframes（呼吸、眨眼、甩辫、抡锤、蹦跳、垂耳、Zzz）为自己编写。
- **状态机**：`PetFollow` 如何把 DSH 会话事件折叠成心情、以及「先补读事件日志再判定
  成功还是报错」的时序，为自己设计。
- **声音**：全部由 WebAudio 振荡器实时合成，没有任何录音或采样文件。四音节旋律动机、
  FM 共振峰、气音瞬态、立体声摆位都是自己调参的。
- **代码**：Host 半边、浏览器半边与测试套件为本项目原创，采用 MIT 许可。

二次创作或商用请遵守 MIT 许可并保留作者署名。

## 目录

- [她长什么样](#她长什么样)
- [她会做什么](#她会做什么)
- [声音设计](#声音设计)
- [原创说明](#原创说明)
- [安装与卸载](#安装与卸载)
- [更新流程](#更新流程)
- [开发与自测](#开发与自测)
- [实现说明](#实现说明)
- [许可](#许可)

-----

## 她长什么样

纯手写 SVG 画的 chibi 小人，约 112px 高，贴在窗口右下角：粉发 + 前额刘海、两条细长兔耳、
一条垂到脚边的长辫（末端系蝴蝶结）、白色兔耳发饰、粉白连衣裙配缎带、脚上小圆靴。
她有一缕很淡的灵光在背后呼吸；眼睛会跟着鼠标转。

`preview.html` / `preview-zoom.html` 是真实浏览器渲染出来的七个心情状态预览页，
用浏览器直接打开就能看到（`preview-zoom.html` 是放大 4.2 倍细看版）。

## 她会做什么

心情由**当前会话**（`ctx.sessions.list.current`）的真实状态推导，不是随机播放：

| 心情 | 触发条件 | 动作 | 声音 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `idle` 待机 | 会话空闲 | 呼吸、眨眼、耳朵轻抖、偶尔甩辫子 | 偶尔一声轻跳 |
| `think` 思考 | 正在跑，但还没发工具 | 左右轻晃、头顶冒「?」 | — |
| `work` 干活 | 最新事件是 `tool/call` | 抡小锤子、火星四溅、汗滴 | 每次新工具一声轻脆 tick |
| `wait` 等确认 | `approval/asked` 尚未 `decided` | 举手、头顶「!」、光圈脉动 | 柔和上行双音 |
| `done` 完成 | 一轮 `turn/end` 成功结束（running 由真变假） | 原地跳起、爱心+星星+音符 | **「做完啦……」** + 收尾闪音 |
| `oops` 出错 | `lastAgentError` 或 `turn/end reason=error` | 耳朵垂下、冒汗、掉泪 | 下行小三度 |
| `sleep` 睡觉 | 90 秒没动静，或还没打开任何会话 | 闭眼、冒 Zzz | 四声下行摇篮曲 |

交互：

- **点她一下**：蹦一下 + 一声「啵」，泡泡里冒出「呼哇～好舒服！」。
- **点右上角小喇叭**：开关声音（选择记在 `localStorage`，键名 `dsh-plugin-xiaowu:audio`）。
- **点状态胶囊 / 悬停**：展开小面板，显示当前心情、正在用的工具名、会话标题。
- 浏览器禁止自动播放音频，所以第一次点击/按键时才会解锁 AudioContext；解锁**之前**她依然会动，只是不出声。
- 尊重 `prefers-reduced-motion`：动画会被压到最短。

## 声音设计

四段「咿呀」的旋律动机对应语音的音节节奏，全部由 `lib/client.js` 里的 `voice` 模块现场合成：

| 时间 | 音高 | 对应 | 音色处理 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.00s–0.24s | G5 (784Hz) | 「做」 | 三角波主音 + FM 调制 + 气音瞬态 |
| 0.20s–0.50s | A5 (880Hz) | 「完」 | 同上，略强 |
| 0.47s–0.77s | G5 (784Hz) | 「啦」 | 同上，稍弱 |
| 0.75s–1.41s | D5 (587Hz) | 「……」 | 长音下滑，收尾 |
| 1.32s–1.82s | G5→C6→E6 | 闪音 | 铃铛式正弦 + 二次谐波 |

每个音节叠了三层：

1. **主音**：`triangle` 振荡器，带 5.4Hz 轻微颤音（`vibrato`），起音有 20–45ms 的滑入（`ramp`）。
2. **FM 调制**：`sine` 调制器以约 1.7 倍基频调制主音频率，做出类似人声共振峰的「唔」感。
3. **气音瞬态**：40ms 白噪声经带通滤波（中心频率约 1.7 倍基频），模拟辅音起音，让音节听起来像「说话」而不是纯音阶。
4. **低八度衬底**：每个音节再加一层低八度正弦，音量约 30%，让声音有胸腔共鸣的暖度，不会太尖。

再加一层立体声：四个音节左右轻摆（-0.22 / 0.06 / 0.24 / 0），闪音尾随其后，听感更「甜甜的」。
整段约 1.9 秒，主输出增益 0.9、单音峰值 0.13–0.20，保证不会突然吓人。

其他提示音（`hop` / `tick` / `chime` / `oops` / `pop` / `lullaby`）用同一套 `bell()` 原语拼出来。
想换音高或换成整句语音朗读，改 `phrase()` 里的 `notes` 数组即可。

## 安装与卸载

### 环境要求

| 项目 | 要求 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | 已在跑 `dsh web`（有 `web` profile） |
| Node.js | ≥ 18 |
| git | 安装时需要 |
| 浏览器 | 支持 Web Audio（Chrome / Edge / Firefox / Safari 都行） |

### 安装

```bash
git clone https://github.com/jxboop/dsh-plugin-xiaowu.git
node dsh-plugin-xiaowu/install.mjs
```

PowerShell（5.1 不支持 `&&`，用分号）：

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/jxboop/dsh-plugin-xiaowu.git; node .\dsh-plugin-xiaowu\install.mjs
```

脚本幂等，做四件事：

1. 把插件放进 `<DSH 主目录>/plugin-src/dsh-plugin-xiaowu`
2. 在 `<profile>/node_modules` 建链接（Windows 用 junction，**无需管理员权限**）
3. 把包名写进 `<profile>/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`（只改这一个字段）
4. 打印重启指引

然后：

1. `Ctrl+C` 停掉 `dsh web`，重新执行 `dsh web`
2. 浏览器 `Ctrl+Shift+R` 硬刷新

**为什么必须重启**：bundle 列表与插件树只在进程启动时组合，热加载覆盖不到新装的插件。

常用参数：

```bash
node install.mjs --profile web            # 指定 profile（默认 web）
node install.mjs --dsh-home D:\dsh-home    # 自定义 DSH 主目录
node install.mjs --source ./本地目录        # 从本地目录安装（改代码时用）
node install.mjs --help
```

DSH 主目录默认按 `$DSH_HOME` → `~/.dsh` 的顺序推断。

### 只想先看看她长什么样

不用装插件：用浏览器直接打开仓库里的 `preview.html`（`preview-zoom.html` 是放大 4.2 倍细看版）。

### 卸载

```bash
node dsh-plugin-xiaowu/uninstall.mjs           # 移除链接与 bundles 注册，保留插件目录
node dsh-plugin-xiaowu/uninstall.mjs --purge   # 连插件目录一起删
```

重启 `dsh web` 生效。

### 改完源码怎么生效

重开 `dsh web`（或重启当前那个进程），再刷新浏览器页面。
profile 的 `patchReload` 是 `live`，所以首页刷新会重新拿配置；但已经在跑的进程不会重新组合插件树。

## 更新流程（不用重启）

如果你的 DSH 装了 `dsh-super-injector`（本机开发常用的可选工具），改完源码可以热重载，不必重启：

1. **改**：动 `lib/client.js`（浏览器半边）或 `lib/index.js`（node 半边）。
2. **自测**：跑下面「开发与自测」里的测试。
3. **推送**：让注入器热重载这个包 ——

```
dev_reload_package  packageName: dsh-plugin-xiaowu
```

它清掉该包的模块缓存、重建 fiber，并把新的客户端 bundle 以新 revision 发布出去（失败会自动回滚保留旧代）。
之后**刷新浏览器页面**即可，不用重启 `dsh web`。

没有注入器也没关系：改完重启 `dsh web` 即可。

### 怎么确认刷新后跑的确实是新版本

bundle 里有一个版本戳常量 `BUILD`（`lib/client.js` 顶部，语义化版本，改完记得 +1）。
载入时它会把 `window.__DSH_XIAOWU__` 挂到页面上并打一行日志：

```
[xiaowu] 桌宠已载入 build 0.1.2 — window.__DSH_XIAOWU__ 可核对
```

刷新后的页面在 DevTools 控制台里敲 `window.__DSH_XIAOWU__.build`，跟文件里的 `BUILD` 对得上，
就说明这一页跑的是磁盘上这一版，而不是缓存的旧 bundle。

## 开发与自测

```bash
node --check lib/client.js      # 语法
node test/harness.cjs           # 无浏览器：挂载 + 状态机（各个心情逐个断言）
```

需要浏览器级渲染的测试要装开发依赖（只有改代码的人需要）：

```bash
npm i                           # jsdom / react / react-dom
node test/dom.cjs               # jsdom + 真 React 18：真渲染、真 DOM、真音频调度、版本戳
node test/preview.cjs           # 生成 preview.html / preview-zoom.html
```

## 实现说明

插件是**双面**的（DSH 客户端插件的标准形态）：

- **node 半边**（`lib/index.js`）：空的 `apply()`。它的唯一作用是让 Cordis 树里出现这一行，
  这样 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules` 扫描 `dsh.client` 声明时能发现本包。
- **浏览器半边**（`lib/client.js`）：手写的懒 CJS bundle，通过 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load`
  注册工厂；不需要任何构建步骤（没有 JSX，用 `React.createElement` 的 `h()` 小助手）。

浏览器半边做了三件事：

1. **占位**：`ctx.slots.inject("shell.overlay", …)` —— `shell.overlay` 是 ui-layout 声明的
   「整框浮动层」，本身是点击穿透的，所以 CSS 里只有 `.dsh-xw-stage` 把自己重新打开
   `pointer-events:auto`，不会挡住下面的界面。
2. **读状态**：`PetFollow` 跟着 `ctx.sessions` 走。它订阅会话列表（当前会话变化）、
   会话快照（`running`、`lastAgentError`、`awaitingFirstTurn`）和事件窗口
   （`turn/start`、`turn/end`、`tool/call`、`tool/result`、`approval/asked`、`approval/decided`），
   把它们折叠成上面那张表里的七个心情。**顺序很讲究**：running 由真变假时先补读一遍事件日志，
   再判断是「做完」还是「出错」，所以一轮报错的 turn 不会被误当成成功来庆祝。
3. **画与响**：React 组件读 store，把心情写到 `data-mood` 上，CSS 里每个心情一套 keyframes；
   `useMoodSounds` 在心情**边沿**触发对应音效（`done` 边沿就是那句「做完啦……」）。

依赖清单写在自己的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里（一行 insert），`package.json` 的 `dsh.client.inject`
声明了必须先在线的客户端插件，剩下的 `react` / `react-dom` 走 DSH 客户端的静态模块表，不需要额外依赖。

## 许可

MIT © 2026 [jxboop](https://github.com/jxboop)

形象、动作、状态机与全部音频合成算法均为原创；二次创作或商用请遵守 MIT 许可并保留署名。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 用の日本語ネイティブ TUI（設計段階 / design phase）
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH-forJP-TUI

DeepSeek Harness (dsh) のための**日本語ネイティブ TUI**。

> **状態: Phase 0（走路骨格）完了。描画は未着手。**
> 自作バンドルが DSH の Cordis 木に載り、自前の入口（C）から起動し、C が壊れれば
> `dsh --profile` 子プロセス（B）へフォールバックし、`session/event` の生イベントを捕捉できる。
> 検証は `node scripts/verify-bundle.mjs`（12検査）。

## これは何か

dsh の TUI サーフェスを、日本語を第一級に扱う形で自作する。
既存の [dsh-TUI](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI) を参考にしつつ、
コードは共有せず、描画層から自分で設計する。

## 目的

| # | 目的 | 設計要求 |
|---|---|---|
| P1 | 見た目を自分で設計できる | 描画層を自前で握る。装飾演出を既定で入れない |
| P2 | 日本語ネイティブ | 文言を最初からカタログ化。日本語を言語パックに追い出さない |
| P3 | 上流更新で崩れにくい | 依存する上流の非公開契約を最小化し、その数を常時計測する |
| P4 | UX 研究の土台 | UI 層とハーネス層を分離し、UI の反復試行を安くする |
| P5 | 将来ハーネスごと差し替える（思想として保持） | ハーネス境界を1箇所に閉じ込める |
| P6 | ハーネスチューニング研究 | ハーネスの挙動を外から差し替え可能に保つ |

## 確定している方針

- **DSH への載せ方**: in-process の Cordis バンドル（`dsh.bundle.patch`）。承認・ユーザー質問・モデル切替を
  人対話で行うには、これ以外の経路が存在しない（公式 SDK / ACP には承認チャネルが無い）
- **起動**: 自前のフル host-entry を持つ。ただし**失敗時は必ず `dsh --profile` 子プロセスへフォールバック**する
- **描画層**: upstream の [Ink](https://github.com/vadimdemedes/ink) **v8.0.0**（commit `26d2c3f8`）を fork し、
  `src/ink/` に置いて自前で拡張する。Ink 本体はマウス選択・ヒットテスト・スクロール固定を持たないため、
  これらは自作する
- **v0 の範囲**: 入力解析 / 差分描画 / 全角幅 / 入力欄 / ストリーム表示 / ツールカード /
  承認パネル / ユーザー質問パネル / セッション結線 / 中断と終了

## ドキュメント

| 文書 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| [`docs/design/0001-architecture-and-roadmap.md`](docs/design/0001-architecture-and-roadmap.md) | **設計書とロードマップ**（決定ログ D1〜D9、Phase -1〜5、リスク R1〜R8） |
| [`docs/reports/2026-10-18-phase0-walking-skeleton.md`](docs/reports/2026-10-18-phase0-walking-skeleton.md) | **Phase 0 完了レポート**（達成項目・設計を変えた発見・やっていないこと） |

調査ノートには**環境依存のローカル絶対パスをマスク**してある（`$HOME/<workspace>/...`）。

## 開発

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build
node scripts/verify-bundle.mjs          # 構造検査（A〜D）
COMMANDCODE_API_KEY=... node scripts/verify-bundle.mjs   # 実モデル実行まで（E）

検証は `$HOME/.dsh` に**一切書き込まない**。`DSH_HOME` をワークスペース内の `.dsh-home/` に向けて
プロファイルとバンドル解決を完結させる（[理由](docs/research/2026-10-18-sandbox-and-dsh-home.md)）。

入口は `lib/bin.js`（`dsh-forjp`）。環境変数で挙動を切り替えられる:

| 変数 | 値 | 意味 |
|---|---|---|
| `FORJP_ENTRY` | `auto`（既定） | C を試し、失敗したら B へフォールバック |
| | `in-process` | C のみ。失敗したら異常終了 |
| | `child` | B を強制 |
| `FORJP_PROFILE` | 既定 `forjp` | プロファイル名 |
| `DSH_FORJP_HOST_PACKAGE` | 未設定 | ホスト `@deepseek-ai/dsh` のパッケージディレクトリを明示 |

## ライセンス

MIT（[`LICENSE`](LICENSE)）。

fork 元の [Ink](https://github.com/vadimdemedes/ink) も MIT であり、`src/ink/` に取り込む時点で
Ink のライセンス表示を同梱する。

## TUI を起動する（縦切り v0.1）

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build
pnpm profile:install                 # $DSH_HOME（既定 ~/.dsh）へプロファイルを設置
COMMANDCODE_API_KEY=... dsh --profile forjp-tui
```

- 入力して `Enter` で送信、`Ctrl+C` または `Esc` 2回で終了
- 動作確認（PTY 上で起動→入力→応答→終了までを実測する）: `pnpm test:ui`
- **別の版の DSH で動くか**: `pnpm verify:host --host <dsh のパッケージディレクトリ>`
- 作業用の隔離環境へ入れる場合: `pnpm profile:install --home .dsh-home`
